izzyondroid:com.afkanerd.sw0b.name: swob
izzyondroid:com.afkanerd.sw0b.summary: Communicate with online services using SMS messaging
izzyondroid:com.afkanerd.sw0b.description:
SWOB ("SMSWithoutBorders", AKA "SMS Sithout Borders") is a platform which enables users with a smartphone to communicate with online third-party platforms using SMS messages.
 A typical use-case of the platforms is sending out emails from platforms such as Gmail accounts. This becomes a useful tool in cases where access to the internet is limited or completely unavailable. Usage of SWOB entails having a proactive approach to maintaining your communications; the features that SWOB supports require the users to take delebrate actions prior to usage.
 Our goal is not to replace the internet; for the most part, the internet is an already efficient method of communication with many abilities that surpass what's possible with simple SMS. Unfortunately, we still have a good portion of telecom users in the world who will have to rely on SMS for tasks built for the internet. Based on value, internet based communications are cheaper than SMS based communications. We are using SWOB on the basis of accessibility of a communication medium.

izzyondroid:com.github.umer0586.droidpad.name: Droid Pad
izzyondroid:com.github.umer0586.droidpad.summary: Build control interfaces for WebSocket, Bluetooth/LE, MQTT, TCP & UDP protocols.
izzyondroid:com.github.umer0586.droidpad.description:
Create custom control interfaces easily with a simple drag-and-drop and transform your Android device into a remote control for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), WebSocket, MQTT, Bluetooth, TCP, and UDP protocols.
 Key Features: 
 Drag-and-Drop Control Pad Creation: 
Design your control pads by dragging and dropping components like buttons, sliders, and switches.
 Multi-Protocol Support and Flexible Connectivity: 
 For WebSocket, MQTT, TCP, UDP and Bluetooth , the app acts as a client, connecting to servers and enabling real-time interaction through control pad components.
 For Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) , the app acts as a peripheral (GATT server) , notifying interactions such as button presses, slider changes, and switch toggles via BLE notifications.
 Switch Connection Type Anytime You can change the connection type of a control pad at any time without creating a duplicate for a different connection.
 Update UI From your Script You can change the state of SWITCH,SLIDER,LED and GAUGE from your script 
 For complete guidance please visit https://github.com/UmerCodez/DroidPad

fdroid:com.mooneva.app.name: Mooneva Cycle – Period Tracker
fdroid:com.mooneva.app.summary: Private period & cycle tracker. Offline, encrypted, no account, no ads.
fdroid:com.mooneva.app.description:
Mooneva Cycle is a private, fully offline period tracker and menstrual cycle calendar. Track your period, predict your next cycle, follow your fertile window and ovulation, and log daily symptoms and mood — all without an account, and without a single byte leaving your phone.
 Why offline matters 
Most period tracking apps upload your cycle data to company servers, where it can be sold to advertisers, exposed in a breach, or demanded by law enforcement. Mooneva has no servers at all. Your data is encrypted on your device using PBKDF2 and AES-GCM, and the app does not even request the internet permission — there is nothing to transmit, and nothing to hand over.
 Features 
 Period and menstrual cycle tracking with adaptive predictions
 Fertile window and ovulation estimates
 PMS window warnings
 Daily log: mood, symptoms, flow intensity, discharge, sex and libido
 Pill and contraception reminders — pill, patch, ring, injection, IUD, implant
 Trends, cycle history and symptom heatmaps by cycle day
 Clinical PDF report to share with your doctor
 Birth control mode — hides fertility, tags withdrawal bleeds
 Pregnancy mode — pauses predictions and alerts
 Discrete mode — disguises the app as a task list, icon and name included
 PIN lock with configurable timeout
 Encrypted backup and restore
 Import your history from drip, Flo, Clue and SimpleInnovation
 Persian (Jalaali) calendar and full right-to-left support
 Configurable first day of week
 Dark theme
 Available in 14 languages 
English, German, Spanish, Swedish, Chinese, Persian, Arabic, Turkish, French, Ukrainian, Italian, Hungarian, Russian and Portuguese.
 Privacy 
No accounts. No cloud. No analytics, no crash reporters, no advertising SDKs, no third-party services of any kind. Mooneva cannot see your data, because it never receives it.
 Open Source 
Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Full source code available on GitHub.

fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.name: Library App VideLibri
fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.summary: Renews books borrowed from libraries and searchs in OPACs
fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.description:
VideLibri protects one from missing the due date when borrowing books from public libraries by downloading the list of borrowed books from the library webpage (WebOPAC), renewing all renewable books, and notifying you about non-renewable books, so you do not have to pay late fees to the librarians. Furthermore, the app has all the usual functions of an OPAC.
Features:
- Tested with 200 public and academic libraries in Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.
- Supports 20 different kinds of OPACs from different vendors out of the box.
- Custom XPath expressions can be entered in the app to select any data from any website, so any library can be added without compiling the app.
- It shows all borrowed books from all library cards from different libraries in a single list, so you can always see which book needs to be returned next.
- The list of borrowed books can be sorted by the due date, lending date, lending library, author, title, and other criteria.
- The notification about a dooming due date is more reliable than reminder emails sent by the library OPAC since you can never know if an email actually arrives in time. VideLibri on the other hand stores all data on your smartphone, so the due date is always already there and does not need to arrive.
- Renewing of borrowed books, manually or automatically before the due date to extend the lending period.
- History of all borrowed books, so you can always look back at the books you had borrowed in the past, even after the books were returned to the library and are not shown anymore in the library OPAC.
- Turing-complete XQuery search in the history that can answer arbitrary complex queries, like which borrowed book had the longest title and was borrowed more than once? 
- Search in the OPAC for non-lent books as well as ordering and reserving of non-lent books in some libraries.
- Developed since the year 2006, it is the world's first universal library app and any other library app is a VideLibri copycat.
- Open-source
Some larger public libraries that were tested successfully are for example in the cities Augsburg, GGG Basel, Berlin, Bielefeld, Cologne, Düsseldorf, Lübeck, or Linz, or Munich.
The entire list of all tested libraries and OPACs is too long for the app store page, but you can find it at https://videlibri.de/bibliotheken.html . 
The Android part of VideLibri has been translated into English. However, since most libraries in the list are German, they have German books with German titles. Additional resources like documentation and changelog written for the original VideLibri Windows app in 2006 remain in German. The Windows and Linux app are currently being translated.

fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.name: Be nice
fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.summary: Modern aesthetics. Open-source soul. Your Android launcher.
fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.description:
Be nice is an open source launcher for Android, made for phones, foldables and tablets.
It puts what you use most on your home screen: your favorites, two app widgets and a dock, laid out in Material 3 Expressive and adapting to the size of your screen. Tap the search bar, type a few letters of a name, for example ffx, and Firefox is one tap away.
Features
- Favorites and widgets: Keep your favorite apps, app pairs and folders on one page, with two app widgets, and each widget slot can stack two widgets. Long-press a widget to change, reconfigure or remove it. Swipe down or up to open an app or start the search, as you choose in Settings.
- Made for large screens: On foldables and tablets, additional widgets get their own pane, and Settings arranges its cards in two or three columns.
- Search: Find apps, app pairs, favorites and folders by typing a few letters. If a name matches exactly, only that item is shown, and the Go key opens it.
- App pairs: Launch two apps side by side with a single tap, on phones, tablets and foldables, when the system allows split-screen.
- Folders and favorites: Organize your apps in folders. Long-press an item for favorites, folders, custom labels and more.
- Grouped apps: Apps with several launchers can be shown as one entry. Tap to pick an activity, and favorite whole apps or single activities independently.
- Hidden items: Hide apps from the list and manage them in Settings.
- Dock: Show or hide a dock with up to five slots for phone, messages, browser or your own choices, and pick its color.
- Private space and work profile: Their apps get their own tabs, clearly badged.
Be nice is free, open source and contains no ads or trackers.

fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.name: Why am I here?
fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.summary: Set a goal before opening distracting apps
fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.description:
Use your apps with intention. Choose the apps you want to be more mindful about, then enter a goal and a time limit before using them.
• Set a duration of 5, 15, 30 minutes, or your own value.
• Keep your goal and remaining time visible in a draggable, collapsible widget.
• Use independent timers for different apps and finish sessions early.
• Get a warning before time runs out, then return to the home screen.
• Reuse recent goals stored locally on your phone.
• English, Spanish and Russian follow your system language.
The accessibility service detects the active app, shows the reminder and returns you home when time expires. It does not read screen text, passwords or messages. No internet permission, account, root or separate overlay permission is required. Your settings, goals and sessions stay on your device; Android backup is disabled.
This is a voluntary reminder, not a tamper-proof blocker. An app may appear briefly before the goal form. Background audio can continue after returning home. Background expiry is handled when you return to the app. Changing the phone clock changes the timer. Some manufacturers require battery restrictions to be disabled for the service.

fdroid:dev.corruptedark.diditakemymeds.name: Did I Take My Meds?
fdroid:dev.corruptedark.diditakemymeds.summary: An app to manage and track medication doses
fdroid:dev.corruptedark.diditakemymeds.description:
Did I Take My Meds? helps keep track of when to take medications. It is designed to help prevent a user from skipping doses and/or overdosing.
Did I Take My Meds? allows a user save multiple medications with complex schedules. Each medication can trigger an independent reminder notification. Additionally, this application allows a user to record when they take a dose. As a part of a medication routine, this app can help prevent overdoses and skipped doses.

fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.name: Linwood Butterfly Nightly
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.summary: Take notes, draw freely, and organize ideas across an endless workspace
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.description:
Butterfly is an open-source app for people who think better with space around their ideas. Instead of writing everything from top to bottom on a fixed page, you get an endless workspace where you can place notes, sketches, diagrams, images, and documents wherever they make sense.
Use it for class notes, meeting notes, research, math, worksheets, planning, whiteboarding, storyboards, product sketches, or any project that starts messy and needs room to grow. Write by hand with a stylus, touch, or mouse, type text and Markdown, add shapes and lines, place images and photos, import PDFs, SVGs, and image files, then export your work as PDF, SVG, images, or portable Butterfly files.
Butterfly tries to stay out of your way while you work. Recent files, quick-start templates, search, folders, imports, page navigation, and tool settings are close when you need them, but the document stays at the center. You can begin with a plain page, ruled paper, a grid, dotted paper, music paper, or your own template.
As your document grows, Butterfly gives you ways to keep it understandable. Split work into pages and page folders, use layers, mark important places with areas and waypoints, save reusable parts in packs, and keep palettes and text styles ready for the next document. Almost everything you add remains editable, so you can move, resize, recolor, reorder, and refine your work later instead of starting over.
Your files stay under your control. Work offline, store documents on your device, choose a different data directory, or connect WebDAV and Nextcloud if you want your own sync setup. There is no required account, no required subscription, and no required proprietary cloud.
Butterfly is free, community translated, available on phones, tablets, desktops, and the web, and developed in public under the AGPL-3.0 license.

fdroid:fr.corenting.convertisseureurofra.name: Inflation Calculator
fdroid:fr.corenting.convertisseureurofra.description:
This inflation calculator allows you to calculate the buying power in a specified year of any amount of money to an equivalent amount in another year by taking into account the inflation rate between these two years.
It supports the following countries:
- USA (from 1913 to 2024)
- UK (from 1800 to 2024)
- France (from 1901 to 2024)
- South Korea (from 1965 to 2024)
To achieve this, this application uses data from various sources:
- USA: Bureau of Labor Statistics (Historical CPI-U), https://www.bls.gov/cpi/
- UK: Office for National Statistics, https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/timeseries/cdko/mm23
- France: INSEE, https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/serie/010605954
- South Korea: Statistics Korea (Consumer Price Inflation Rate - 소비자물가상승률), https://www.index.go.kr/unity/potal/indicator/PotalIdxSearch.do?idxCd=4226&sttsCd=422601&clas_div=&idx_sys_cd=

fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.name: Oubliettes
fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.summary: Dungeon logic puzzle: find the walls from the row and column counts
fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.description:
Oubliettes is a logic puzzle. Each grid hides a dungeon: work out where every wall is from the clues, with no guessing needed. Every grid has exactly one solution.
 Rules 
 The numbers along the edge give the number of walls in each row and column.
 Monsters and chests are never walls.
 Every monster sits in a dead end, and every dead end holds a monster.
 Every chest is in a treasure room: 3×3 open cells, one chest, one opening.
 Elsewhere, hallways are one cell wide and the whole dungeon is connected.
 Features 
 Campaign: 250 levels that are the same for everyone, in five difficulties (6×6 to 14×14), all open from the start.
 Endless: randomly generated grids in the difficulty you pick.
 Daily: one dungeon a day, open on its day only.
 Tutorial: lessons you solve step by step, one technique at a time, then practise alone.
 Hints that teach: where to look, then why, then which cells.
 Share a solved grid as text, without its solution, and dig the one a friend sent.
 Drag to fill a row or column, undo and redo, progress and history saved after every move.
 Screen reader support, a magnifier and two-finger zoom for large grids, plain digits and a calm mode without animation.
 Endless grids are generated on the device. No ads, no tracking, no account.
 Original medieval music loops and sound effects, with volume sliders.
The app never uses the network: it does not ask for the Internet permission.

fdroid:org.electrum.electrum.name: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet
fdroid:org.electrum.electrum.summary: Fast and self-custodial wallet for Bitcoin and the Lightning Network
fdroid:org.electrum.electrum.description:
Electrum is a libre self-custodial Bitcoin wallet with support for the Lightning Network.
It's secure, feature rich and trusted by the Bitcoin community since 2011.
Features:
• Safe: Your private keys are encrypted and never leave your device.
• Open-source: MIT-licensed free/libre open-source software, with reproducible builds.
• Forgiving: Your wallet can be recovered from a secret phrase.
• Instant On: Electrum uses servers that index the Bitcoin blockchain making it fast.
• No Lock-In: You can export your private keys and use them in other Bitcoin clients.
• No Downtimes: Electrum servers are decentralized and redundant. Your wallet is never down.
• Proof Checking: Electrum Wallet verifies all the transactions in your history using SPV.
• Cold Storage: Keep your private keys offline and go online with a watching-only wallet.
Links:
• Website: https://electrum.org (with documentation and FAQ)
• Source code: https://github.com/spesmilo/electrum
• Help us with translations: https://crowdin.com/project/electrum
• Support: Please use GitHub (preferred) or email electrumdev@gmail.com to report bugs rather than the app rating system.

fdroid:org.fossify.calendar.name: Fossify Calendar
fdroid:org.fossify.calendar.summary: Securely plan, schedule, and set reminders with our private calendar app.
fdroid:org.fossify.calendar.description:
Tired of cluttered calendars and privacy concerns?
Fossify Calendar is here to change that. Your open-source powerhouse for managing life, designed with privacy as its core and packed with powerful features to keep you organized.
Here's what makes Fossify Calendar different:
🚫 AD-FREE AND PRIVATE: 
Your events remain yours. No ads, no tracking, no intrusive permissions.
⏰ FLEXIBLE AND CUSTOMIZABLE: 
Craft events precisely with times, durations, reminders, and advanced repetition rules.
🔄 SEAMLESS SYNCING: 
Sync effortlessly with Google Calendar, Outlook, Nextcloud, Exchange, and more.
🎨 PERSONALIZE YOUR PLANNER: 
Set custom sounds, looping audio streams, vibrations, and themes to match your preferences.
🌈 VIBRANT WIDGETS: 
Brighten your day with beautiful calendar widgets and themes for your home screen.
📅 EFFORTLESS DAY MANAGEMENT:
Plan your day with ease, whether you're a busy professional or a family organizer.
🎉 IMPORT CELEBRATIONS: 
Never miss a birthday or anniversary! Easily import holidays and special dates.
🔍 FILTER VIEWS:

apple-itunes:1400866497.description:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.
SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES
Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allowing your TV to stream videos directly from the web.
• Google Cast (Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in)
• DLNA devices like Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs, etc.

• Fire TV and Fire TV stick

SUPPORTED MEDIA
• HLS live streams in M3U8 format (Chromecast, most DLNA devices lack support for it)
• Authenticated videos including movies and TV shows
• MP4 videos
• Live news and sports
• Any HTML5 videos*
*Your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video you are playing. Web Video Caster doesn't perform any video/audio decoding or transcoding.
HOW IT WORKS
Web Video Cast™ is a browser, which allows you to stream videos of movies, TV shows, and other media from the internet to a streaming device or smart tv. Web Video Caster grabs the video URL inside the web page, sends it to the streaming device (i.e. Chromecast or DLNA device), and then plays the video directly from the content provider. This ultimately saves your mobile device’s battery. It also detects subtitles on the web page. Web Video Cast™ does not host these videos. This is not a mirroring app.
GET STARTED
Follow these simple step-by-step instructions to start streaming:
1. Find a video online that you want to watch.
2. Make sure this video can play on mobile browsers without Flash.
3. Connect to your streaming device.
4. Play the video as you normally would. Or, click the play button on the toolbar.
PREMIUM FEATURES**
• No in-app advertising
• Most visited sites
• Bookmarks
• Set homepage
**This functionality does not apply universally to all streaming devices. 
LIMITATIONS & DISCLOSURES
As with all apps, there are some limitations we are aware of and want you to know about up front.
• We are in no way associated with any web media providers and we do not have control over the content they provide.
• Web Video Caster does not support nor play Flash or FLV videos.
• The app does not support tab casting, like the Chromecast extension for the PC web browser.
• We cannot do anything to fix issues that arise on the server side (media content provider) such as failure to play or buffering, which is especially common during heavy load times and weekends.
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK
We are committed to open communication with our users. Please contact us first with any questions or support issues before leaving a review. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website http://www.webvideocaster.com/contactForm

Sable's Grimoire tells the story of an aspiring magic researcher who begins to attend an academy filled with demi-humans.
 When Sable is accepted into Amadronia Magic Academy, a prestigious academy famous for its resources and curriculum, he believes that he has crossed an important milestone in his life.
 As an aspiring magic researcher, not to mention one of the few pure-blooded human beings capable of using magic, Sable has high hopes for his time at Amadronia. 
 His dream of becoming a world-renowned magic researcher is finally within his grasp, and with the assistance of the much-lauded teaching staff at Amadronia, 
 he is sure that the next few years of his life will be as productive as they are enlightening.
 Unfortunately for Sable, his first day at Amadronia quickly proves to him that this will not be the case.
 Arrogant elves, a ravenous rokurokubi, a poison-tongued mandragora, a pyromaniac dragon, unenthusiastic teachers - Amadronia is nothing like Sable envisioned. 
 The students in his class are unruly, his "teacher" has no interest in teaching, the principal willfully breaks academy rules, and it seems like everywhere he turns, 
 Sable finds one more reason to doubt Amadronia's proud legacy.
 Will Sable manage to survive at this clearly dysfunctional academy? Or will he, like so many others, leave Amadronia feeling utterly disillusioned?

fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-oc.name: dogtag-pki-ocsp
fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-oc.description: Dogtag PKI Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) Manager is an optional subsystem that can act as a stand-alone OCSP service. The OCSP Manager performs the task of an online certificate validation authority by enabling OCSP-compliant clients to do real-time verification of certificates. Note that an online certificate-validation authority is often referred to as an OCSP Responder. Although the Certificate Authority (CA) is already configured with an internal OCSP service. An external OCSP Responder is offered as a separate subsystem in case the user wants the OCSP service provided outside of a firewall while the CA resides inside of a firewall, or to take the load of requests off of the CA. The OCSP Manager can receive Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) from multiple CA servers, and clients can query the OCSP Manager for the revocation status of certificates issued by all of these CA servers. When an instance of OCSP Manager is set up with an instance of CA, and publishing is set up to this OCSP Manager, CRLs are published to it whenever they are issued or updated.

firefox-addons:981853.name: Redirect Bypasser (WebExtension)
firefox-addons:981853.summary: Avoid redirects and has direct access to the sites you want to visit.
firefox-addons:981853.description:
Useful to avoid frame pages (e.g., Google images, Yahoo, Bing...) , ads, surveys, unwanted redirects...
Features:
* Extract links recursively (every URL found are added to a pop-up overlay while hovering the link to let the user choose the best option in a fast way).
* Decode obfuscated links as "reverse", base64 and hex. (tricks used by some sites to prevent direct access to the original web address).
* Extract web addresses within tag's attributes (e.g. onclick, onmouseover...), text contents and JavaScript: protocol (mostly used to open pop-ups or to show overlays).
* Extract web addresses from plug-ins (useful to open flash games, videos... in a new tab or to get URL of videos, musics...).
* Can handle dynamic content (links that move or hide...) very well.
* The icons are sorted by file extension and auto-set colors based on algorithm used, for the user identify them quickly. As an example, while browsing any site (e.g. Google images) the blue icon was the desired target, another link that show blue icon is likely to be the desired one too.
Demo : https://mozlima.github.io/redirectbypasser/test/test-redirectbypasser.html 
===================
WebExtension version of https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/redirectbypasser/ 
Original developer https://www.github.com/mozlima/redirectbypasser/ 
I only signed and uploaded it on AMO
No more fixes or new features will come (however I'm using it from months without a single problem)
If at anytime the original developer updated his version on AMO I will remove this.

firefox-addons:3017563.name: Passa - Password Manager
firefox-addons:3017563.summary: A secure, zero-knowledge password manager that saves, generates, and autofills passwords with optional encrypted cross-browser sync.
firefox-addons:3017563.description:
Passa is a zero-knowledge password manager that keeps you in control of your credentials.
Your vault is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before it ever leaves the browser. Passa's servers never see your passwords, usernames, or notes - only you can decrypt your data.
Features:
- Save and autofill logins automatically as you browse
- Generate strong, unique passwords
- Built-in TOTP (two-factor) code generation
- Breach monitoring using Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity (your passwords are never sent)
- Optional encrypted sync to your own Google Drive or Dropbox
- Automatic clipboard clearing after copying
- CSV import and duplicate detection
- Right-click to generate passwords on any field
Zero-knowledge by design: encryption keys are derived from your master password using PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations) and never leave your device. The server stores only a bcrypt hash of a client-derived value - never your master password or vault contents.

firefox-addons:925973.name: Export Tabs URLs
firefox-addons:925973.summary: List open tab URLs and titles, copy them to clipboard or save them to a file. Features: custom format (Markdown, HTML…), RegExp tab filter, group by window/tab group.
firefox-addons:925973.description:
Features
 Include titles : Export Tabs URLs (ETU) provides a default format which displays titles along tabs URLs
 Custom format : optionally, custom patterns can be defined instead of the default "include titles" one (e.g. markdown, html…)
 Group tabs : optionally, exported tabs can be organized into sections grouped by window, by tab group, or by both
 Filter tabs : ETU provides a RegExp-enabled tabs filter
 Limit to current window : optionally, the list can be limited to the current window
 List non-HTTP(s) URLs : optionally, ETU can list each and every tab, including cases where the URL scheme isn't HTTP(s)
 Ignore pinned tabs : optionally, ETU can ignore pinned tabs
Permissions
 Access browser tabs : required to list the tabs
 Storage : required to store settings
How can you help improve this add-on?
 Report bugs and issues on Github : the review section of the Firefox add-ons page is not the right medium to discuss about issues. If you want to make sure that an issue/bug is taken care of, please report it via proper channels.
 If this add-on is useful to you, give it a positive review and spread the word.
If you are not comfortable using Github, drop me a line , any help, in any form is welcome.

bluejetty:00023237:ios.name: Philips Hue
bluejetty:00023237:ios.summary:
The official Philips Hue app is the most comprehensive way to organize, control, and customize your Philips Hue smart lights and accessories. 
Organize your smart lights
Group your lights into Rooms or Zones — your entire downstairs floor
bluejetty:00023237:ios.description:
The official Philips Hue app is the most comprehensive way to organize, control, and customize your Philips Hue smart lights and accessories. 
Organize your smart lights
Group your lights into Rooms or Zones — your entire downstairs floor or all the lights in the living room, for example — that mirror the physical rooms in your home.
Easily control your lights — from anywhere
Use the app to control your lights anywhere you have an internet connection. 
Explore the Hue scene gallery
Created by professional lighting designers, the scenes in the scene gallery can help you set the mood for any occasion. You can even create your own scenes based on a photo or your favorite colors. 
Set up bright home security 
Make your home feel safer, no matter where you are. The Security Center lets you program your Secure cameras, Secure contact sensors, and indoor motion sensors to send you alerts when they detect activity. Trigger light and sound alarms, call the authorities or a trusted contact, and monitor your home in real-time.
Get the best light for any moment of the day
Let your lights change automatically throughout the day with the Natural light scene — so you feel more energized, focused, relaxed, or rested at the right times. Just set the scene to watch your lights change with the sun’s movement, transitioning from cool blue tones in the morning to warmer, relaxing hues for sunset. 
Automate your lights
Make your smart lights work around your daily routine. Whether you want your lights to gently wake you up in the morning or greet you when you get home, setting up customizable automations in the Philips Hue app is effortless. 
Sync your lights to TV, music, and games
Make your lights flash, dance, dim, brighten, and change color in sync with your screen or sound! With the Philips Hue Play HDMI sync box, the Philips Hue Sync for TV or desktop apps, or Spotify, you can create totally immersive experiences.
Set up voice control
Use Apple Home, Amazon Alexa, or Google Assistant to control your smart lights with voice commands. Turn lights on and off, dim and brighten, or even change colors — completely hands-free.
Use Siri Shortcuts for quick control
Use the Shortcuts app to create shortcuts that you can place into widgets on your Home Screen for even faster control of your lights. Turn lights on or off, adjust their brightness and temperature, or set scenes — all without even opening the app.
Learn more about the official Philips Hue app: www.philips-hue.com/app. 
Read the Philips Hue Privacy Notice at www.philips-hue.com/privacy.
Note: Some features in this app require a Philips Hue Bridge.

bluejetty:00035851:ios.description:
Rolly - Your Personal AI Finance Advisor, Money Manager, and Budget Planner
Tired of switching between budgeting apps, logging entries by hand, and still not knowing where your money goes?
Meet Rolly, the all-in-one AI finance tracker and monthly budget planner designed to simplify how you manage money, track spending, and save smarter -- all through an intuitive AI chat.
Whether you are a working professional or managing multiple income streams, Rolly makes money management effortless and fun. Just snap receipts, use your voice, or log expenses through chat. Rolly is the only budgeting app you will ever need.
WHY CHOOSE ROLLY?
Managing money should not feel like a chore. While most budgeting apps just track numbers, Rolly does more -- it talks to you and adapts to your style. Feeling spendy? Let Rolly's Angry Mom personality call you out. Need a push to save? Switch to Wise Friend for practical advice.
TRACK EXPENSES YOUR WAY
- Chat to Track: Type "Coffee 15, Movie 5" and Rolly instantly logs them under the right categories. No dropdowns, no forms.
- Speak to Log: Use voice input to record expenses hands-free.
- Scan Receipts: Snap and upload receipts. Rolly auto-logs each item as a separate transaction in the correct category.
- AI Categorization: Every transaction is instantly sorted with pinpoint accuracy.
POWERFUL MONEY MANAGEMENT
- Smart Budgets: Create monthly budgets with AI-generated suggestions based on your spending patterns.
- Savings Goals: Set targets, visualize progress, and reach financial milestones faster.
- Debt Tracking: Monitor and manage all your debts with clear payoff timelines.
- Multiple Wallets: Separate work, travel, family, and personal spending.
- Shared Wallets: Collaborate with friends or family on group budgets and recurring transactions.
- Bank Connections: Link your bank accounts for automatic transaction imports.
STAY MOTIVATED
- Financial Challenges: Challenge friends to saving or spending goals. Make budgeting social and fun.
- AI Personalities: Switch between sassy, wise, or strict -- Rolly adapts to your vibe and keeps you accountable.
- Analytics Dashboard: Beautiful charts, spending insights, milestones, and calendar views.
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
- Multi-Currency Support: Track finances in any currency, perfect for travelers and expats.
- 9 Languages: Available in English, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and French.
- Import & Export: Bring your data from other apps or export for your records.
- Recurring Transactions: Set up automatic tracking for subscriptions and regular bills.
From coffee runs to car payments, Rolly is your trusted spending tracker, expense manager, money saving tracker, payment tracker, and all-in-one finance companion.
If you have tried money managing apps that overcomplicate things, switch to a smarter, simpler, and more supportive budgeting app. With Rolly, you will spend better, save faster, and finally feel in control of your money.
Start your journey to financial clarity today.

bluejetty:00165109:ios.description:
What is it like to plunge into the primitive world and feel like the ancient inhabitant of our planet?
The life of an ancient man was filled with dangerous adventures: hunting fast reindeer and majestic mammoths, picking mushrooms in dense forests, catching fish in turbulent rivers and battling saber-toothed tigers. As a leader, you have to take charge of the livelihood of the entire tribe, meeting face to face with other tribes. Placing cards on the playing field and expanding the vastness of the ancient world, you will need to think strategically, occupying the most profitable territories. You will earn victory points by exploring mighty forests, conquering uncharted lands and fast flowing rivers.
Opportunities:
For beginners, there are step-by-step instructions, auxiliary animations to follow the progress of the game.
The scoring is automatic, at the end the winner's board is determined.
Opponents can be your friends or a computer that has 4 difficulty levels.
Online game makes it possible to team up with friends from all over the world at one table.
The game has 3 game modes and 4 sets of additional cards that expand the gameplay.
You can play a game alone against the computer, or get together with friends and plunge into the atmosphere of board games.

A World-Class MMORPG

bluejetty:00133154:ios.description:
A World-Class MMORPG
Are you a player or a conquerer? Explore NCSOFT's chart-topping mobile MMORPG from South Korea on a worldwide stage. Test your might and mettle in a wartorn world that spans across two epic continents. NCSOFT's popular Lineage2 franchise comes to mobile on a global scale where thousands of players can battle for supremacy in an immersive open world. Experience a new era for MMORPGs in Lineage2M.
▣ THE NEW ERA OF THE MMORPG HAS ARRIVED ▣
Lineage2M boasts full 3D in 4K UHD, the highest definition available on mobile devices. With thoroughly drawn armor patterns and detailed character expressions, Lineage2M achieved the highest degree of graphics quality. This is the first mobile game that allows more than ten thousand players to gather in one location and fight in one epic battle.
▣ BATTLE FOR SUPREMACY ▣
Play with a rich variety of races and over 31 classes without losing level progress! Humans, Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, and Orcs fight for loot and power across two continents. Lineage2M's classes include the highly adaptable sword-and-shield Knight, a dual-bladed Warrior, a Raider with pinpoint assasin accuracy, an Archer for ranged combat enthusiasts, a Cleric that wields Orbs of holy healing power, and a Wizard with a magical Staff. Upgrade and collect new weaponry and level up with regular individual and clan quests.
▣ EXPLORE A WORLD OF CONQUEST ▣
Explore a vast, stunning, and lush open world that allows thousands of players to simultaneously meet up, go on a variety of quests, and conquer the world. The seamless two continents of Aden can be navigated on foot or with the use of teleporters and flight on majestic wyverns. Confront monstrous world bosses, defeat Etis' hordes on the ramparts of Giran Castle, and socialize with your fellow adventurers in Talking Isle Village.
▣ Lineage 2M Official Community ▣
※ For more Lineage2M news, check the official website!
※ Website: https://lineage2m.plaync.com/naeu/
※ Follow us on social media
https://facebook.com/PlayLineage2M
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZJgH5s-ROC97wXmv5wXDVg
▣ Lineage2M with PURPLE ▣
When connecting from a PC, PURPLE and Lineage2M can be installed together.
▣ Lineage 2M requires the following permissions for smooth gameplay.
* Optional permission
[Optional] Photos: Permission to save files after photo registration, screen capture, and video recording in the community bulletin boards
[Optional] Camera: Upload image/video, change profile picture
[Optional] Audio: Permission to record audio when recording video
[Optional] Notifications: Permission to receive informational notifications and advertising push notifications sent from game apps
[Optional] Tracking: Providing customized advertisements and analyzing service usage
- You can use the game even if you do not agree to the optional rights.
* How to revoke access
- after agreeing to the access right, you can reset or revoke the access right as follows.
- Settings > Lineage2M > Select permission > Agree or withdraw access permission
* Minimum requirements: RAM 3GB
Privacy Policy
https://www.plaync.com/policy/privacy/en
Terms of Service
https://plaync.com/policy/service

bluejetty:00157335:ios.summary: At its core is a fast, reliable two-factor authentication (2FA) authenticator. Scan a QR code to instantly add any account, then get a secure, time-based one-time password (TOTP) that refreshes every 30 seconds — compatible with over 2,500
bluejetty:00157335:ios.description:
At its core is a fast, reliable two-factor authentication (2FA) authenticator. Scan a QR code to instantly add any account, then get a secure, time-based one-time password (TOTP) that refreshes every 30 seconds — compatible with over 2,500 websites and services. No account setup required; your codes work offline, the moment you scan.
Beyond authentication, the Tools tab turns your phone into a full security toolkit:
Password Manager — Store and manage your passwords securely, on-device.
Breach Check — Instantly check if your email has been exposed in a known data breach.
Password Strength — Analyze entropy, estimated crack time, and pattern weaknesses for any password.
Spam Call Protection — Guide to set up iOS call filtering in under 60 seconds.
Safe Browsing — Guide to verify your Safari protections, including fraudulent website warnings and iCloud Private Relay, are active.
Network Inspector — See your public IP, ISP, TLS version, and VPN status at a glance.
Wi-Fi Speed Test — Check your download, upload, and ping in seconds.
Wi-Fi Heatmap — Map signal strength live across your home or office.
Bluetooth Scanner — Detect nearby BLE devices and flag suspicious trackers.
Photo Vault — Hide private photos and videos behind a PIN, stored securely on your device.
Why HackProof:
Bank-Grade Security — All data, including iCloud backups, is encrypted end-to-end for exclusive access.
Protected 2FA Backup — Safely back up encrypted 2FA codes, passwords, and secret keys to iCloud, and restore them seamlessly on a new device.
Everything On-Device — Your codes, passwords, and vault contents are generated and stored locally — no external servers involved.
One App, Total Coverage — Authentication and everyday digital security, in a single streamlined interface.
All subscriptions are via the standard Apple iTunes payment method at specific intervals until manually cancelled by the user in phone settings.
The Privacy Policy is available here: https://hackproofauthenticator.netlify.app/
The End User Licence Agreement is available here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00093781:ios.name: GameBlazers
bluejetty:00093781:ios.summary: Play fantasy sports. Build killer lineups. Win real cash in free contests every week! GameBlazers takes fantasy to the next level: Rip packs for player Items with scoring multipliers (boost those points!), collect stars, trade on the Market
bluejetty:00093781:ios.description:
Play fantasy sports. Build killer lineups. Win real cash in free contests every week! GameBlazers takes fantasy to the next level: Rip packs for player Items with scoring multipliers (boost those points!), collect stars, trade on the Marketplace, and dominate free weekly contests for huge cash prizes.
GameBlazers has given away more than $1.2 MILLION in prizes since 2024 with another $230K up for grabs during the 2026 PGA season. Download and register now for your free starter pack!
At GameBlazers, we go way beyond fantasy… 
Contests:
Each weekly contest has its own prize pool and lineup requirements. Where GameBlazers is different is that each user is choosing Items from their own unique Inventory, not from the same list of all players like in regular DFS.
Player Items:
Every user has an Inventory of Items that can be used in contests, Roster Upgrade Challenges (RUCs), or sold in the Marketplace.
Items can only be used in one lineup per week. However, users can own multiple of the same Item and use those Items in separate contests in the same week.
Every Item is valid for one year unless it comes with a Franchise Tag. 
Non-franchised Items can be used for beyond one year if their contracts are extended. 
Items can be purchased and sold on the Marketplace. Any Item on the Marketplace retains its current expiration status, so be sure to check expiration dates before making a purchase.
Packs:
The thrill of pack rips are part of why our users love playing at GameBlazers. Packs containing Items can always be purchased in the Shop and earned through gameplay. Most packs can be purchased with credit earned through contest results and GB Pass rewards, and all can be purchased with your GameBlazers balance.
GB Pass:
Your GB Pass is like many common mobile game rewards passes or battle passes, where the more XP you earn, the more rewards you unlock. You also have the option to purchase a premium GB Pass to earn higher end and more overall rewards. Rewards include packs, Items, modifiers, credits, Item contract extensions, and more!
Modifiers:
Modifiers that can be found in packs or earned with the GB Pass to improve Items in your Inventory.
Contract extensions allow for an Item to be used for an additional one, three, or six months beyond its initial expiration date.
The Necromancer allows you to revive an Item that has previously expired for one month.
Boosts allow you to increase an Item’s multiplier. Boosts come in 1.0x, 1.1x, 1.2x, 1.3x, and 1.4x. As an example: a 1.4x boost can be used to increase any 1.4x Item already in your Inventory to a 1.5x multiplier. 
The Franchise Tag can be added to any Item in your Inventory, removing its expiration date permanently and making the Item valid throughout the player’s career.
MiniGames:
In-app MiniGames, including Pick ’Ems and Player Props, are free ways to earn XP, level up your GB Pass, and collect rewards. 
Register today to dive into all the exciting fantasy and gaming action GameBlazers has to offer!
At GameBlazers, we believe that fantasy sports should be an enjoyable and positive experience for everyone. We encourage all our users to engage in responsible gaming practices. Contact organizations like the National Council on Problem Gambling (NCPG) for support at https://www.ncpgambling.org or 1-800-522-4700. This app is intended for users 18 years and older. Please verify your age before engaging in any gameplay. Your well-being is our top priority. Let’s play responsibly and keep fantasy sports fun for everyone!

bluejetty:00017573:ios.description:
Plan Singapore MRT and LRT journeys quickly - even without an internet connection.
Choose your starting station and destination to compare the fastest route or a route with fewer transfers. See every station along your journey, where to change lines, estimated travel and waiting times, distance, and fare information.
Check first and last train times using the fully offline timetable. Select any station or quickly view services for your saved Home and Work stations.
#1 Transportation app in Singapore!
Simply select your starting station and destination, and we will do the rest.
A full, up to date Singapore MRT and LRT map is included.
KEY FEATURES
• Works completely offline
• Plan journeys across Singapore’s MRT and LRT network
• Compare fastest and fewer-transfer routes
• View stations, interchanges and direction information
• Check estimated journey and waiting times
• View distance and current fare information
• Check first and last train times
• Separate weekday, Saturday, Sunday and public-holiday timetables
• Save Home and Work stations
• Quickly reuse recent journeys
• Browse the complete station list
• View station exits and nearby landmarks before you arrive
• View the full MRT and LRT system map
• Light and dark mode, with System, Light or Dark appearance controls
• English, Simplified Chinese, Malay and Indonesian support
• Includes SMRT and SBS Transit services
Simple, fast and clear - everything you need to navigate Singapore’s rail network in one offline app.
Timetables and journey times are provided for planning purposes. Special-event, maintenance and temporary service timings may differ, so check with the relevant operator when travelling late.

bluejetty:00133470:ios.description:
Tangle Rope 3D: Untie Puzzle is a brand-new puzzle game that challenges your problem-solving skills with a bunch of ropes. Dive into the fun and relaxing world of 3D puzzles, where you must untangle the knots and solve the brain-training tangles.
Enhance your IQ and untangle the knots of your mind with Tangle Rope 3D: Untie Puzzle. This brainteaser puzzle game will keep you hooked with its easy-to-play but difficult-to-master gameplay. It's perfect for anyone looking to relax while training their brain to solve tangled ropes.
*How to Play:
- Choose ropes carefully to avoid creating more knots
- Drag ropes to move and place them correctly to untangle the knots
- Sort ropes in the correct order
- Think fast and strategize to untie the knotted mess
- Untangle all ropes within the given time to win
- Manage your time effectively to clear each level before time runs out
*Features:
- Stunning 3D graphics and colorful designs for a fun visual experience
- Over 1,000 challenging levels with varying maps and difficulty
- A variety of rope skins to keep things fresh and exciting
- Improve problem-solving skills as you untangle all knots in the knotted mess
- Fun and cute art styles with detailed backgrounds
- Earn daily rewards and powerful boosters as you progress
With responsive controls and flexible gameplay, Tangle Rope 3D: Untie Puzzle offers a fun and immersive gaming experience. This brain puzzle game will test your ability to untie the knots and solve problems.
Are you ready to tackle the multiple knots and knotted mess ahead? Download Tangle Rope 3D: Untie Puzzle now and see how far you can go!

bluejetty:00159586:ios.description:
GalaxyOne is an all-in-one app that brings together banking, brokerage, crypto, staking, and lending services in one technology platform powered by the institutional strength of Galaxy Digital (NASDAQ: GLXY), a market leader in digital assets and AI infrastructure.
UNLOCK 8.00% PREMIUM YIELD*
Earn 8.00% yield* on cash with Galaxy Premium Yield, an investment note issued by Galaxy Digital LP, available to U.S. accredited investors only on GalaxyOne. Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly. Withdraw anytime with 30-day notice.
EARN 3.75% APY** ON CASH
Open a high-yield cash account with 3.75% APY** and FDIC insurance up to $250K Banking services provided by Cross River Bank, Member FDIC. Monthly interest can be auto-invested into a crypto, stock, or ETF of your choice.
BUY, SELL AND TRANSFER CRYPTO
Buy, sell, and transfer BTC, ETH, SOL, and more with transparent pricing. Digital asset services are offered separately from brokerage accounts and are not FDIC or SIPC insured.
TRADE STOCKS & ETFS COMMISSION-FREE
Invest in U.S. stocks and ETFs commission-free through a self-directed brokerage or retirement account offered through DriveWealth, LLC, member FINRA/SIPC. 
STAKE SOL, EARN UP TO 6.50%
Earn up to an estimated 6.50% in variable staking rewards with 0% commission through December 31, 2026. Terms apply. ***
BORROW USD WITH A CRYPTO PORTFOLIO LINE OF CREDIT
Get liquidity without selling your crypto. Your combined BTC, ETH, and SOL back a single revolving line of credit. No origination fee with 8.99% APR.****
SET RECURRING BUYS
Automate recurring buys for crypto and stocks, and access extended trading hours for U.S. equity markets. 
DEDICATED CLIENT SERVICE
Our U.S. based team is available by phone, online, in-app, or by phone. Real people, real support, every step of the way.
Start earning today. Download GalaxyOne.
*Premium Yield is variable and subject to change with a 30-day notice.
**As of 9/16/26. Annual Percentage Yield (APY) is variable and subject to change.
***Reward rate is estimated and not guaranteed. Rewards are variable and may increase or decrease. Actual returns depend on network conditions. Past performance is not indicative of future results. 0% platform commission through December 31, 2026. Platform commission is defined as the fee GalaxyOne charges to access staking on GalaxyOne and applies to Inflation and eligible MEV rewards earned while assets remain actively staked. Validators may retain transaction fees and certain protocol-level rewards associated with block production. Residual MEV rewards that are distributed after your assets are unstaked will not be credited to your account. Network transaction fees for sending and receiving SOL still apply.
****Variable annual percentage rate (APR) subject to change with 30 day notice, APR in select states may be lower. Collateral remains subject to market fluctuations and liquidation risk.
DISCLOSURES
Premium Yield is a private investment note available only to U.S. accredited investors. Yield is variable and subject to change. Investment and securities products are not FDIC insured and may lose value.
Brokerage accounts are introduced by Fin2, LLC and offered through DriveWealth, LLC, member FINRA/SIPC.
Digital assets and staking involve significant risk, are volatile, and are not FDIC or SIPC insured. Staking rewards are variable and not guaranteed.
Banking services provided by Cross River Bank, Member FDIC. Deposits insured up to $250,000.
Consumer lending products are offered by GalaxyOne Lending LLC (NMLS ID: 2741667). Not all applicants may be eligible or approved. All figures are for illustrative purposes only. 
See galaxy.app/legal for full disclosures and program terms.

Get your happy back with the DateMyAge™ app for mature people aged 40 and over. Make meaningful connections again using our global community for meeting people in the prime of their life. Connect afresh and stay young-at-heart!
Search 1 million+ members with real-life experience and let fate draw you together. Viewing profiles rich in detail is a great way to match up based on more than looks alone. Learn about interests, hobbies and personality before you make a connection. New adventures are waiting for you!
Grab your chance with our dynamic and trusted app:
NOT YOUR AVERAGE ‘MATURE’ CHAT SERVICE
Packed with action, cutting-edge features, and members who don’t act their age – we don’t do ‘mature’ communication like anyone else. In fact, we positively encourage members to be themselves and break the mold!
EVERYTHING YOU WANT
Find matches in their 40s, 50s, and 60s globally. Get just what you’re looking for whether it’s conversation, a penpal or friendship. You never know what’s round the corner on DateMyAge!
SAFETY COMES FIRST
Safety, privacy, and member verification are our priority. We use technology and moderation tools to help support a respectful and welcoming community. We're committed to creating a place where people can connect with confidence.
GREAT EASY-TO-USE FEATURES
– Join free & create your profile.
– Precision search for matches based on your preferences.
– Browse member profiles and photos.
– Receive notifications when messages arrive.
– Get help from our customer care team 24/7.
SUBSCRIBE TO GET PREMIUM FEATURES:
– View private photos & videos.
– Chat instantly to build rapport
– Use offline messages to maintain contact
– Video chat: your best way to hit it off.
– Swap photos and build trust.
– Send happy stickers, smilies & gifts.
– Enjoy Advanced Search to find someone special.
– Use Let’s Mingle to message many people at once.
IMPORTANT SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
– Membership is optional – you do not have to subscribe to chat with other members via DateMyAge.
– Your Apple Account will be charged when you confirm your purchase.

bluejetty:00030235:ios.description:
Baker Boyer Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Baker Boyer Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Baker Boyer Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Baker Boyer digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00176255:ios.description:
In a(nother) surprise victory, you have been elected President of the United States. You now wield the power to push your morals and values upon hundreds of millions of Americans. Will you be a benevolent leader or a ruthless dictator?
Make laws, fight wars, commit crimes and change the world, all on the taxpayer's dime! How long can you stay in power?
Use the Deck Editor to create & play custom decks, then save them as Virtual Cartridge images to your camera roll. Share your Virtual Cartridges with your friends by DM or post them publicly on social media!
Note: This game is political satire, and is not meant to be factually accurate. If Impeached 2 isn't funny enough for you, check out the Deck Editor!
I have taken the feedback received by Impeached: Be The President constructively, and have changed many things to make the gameplay experience better. Enjoy!
Impeached 2 includes: 
– 200+ scenario cards, and a free built-in Deck Editor to make and play your own custom cards
– 40+ endings with pixel art graphics. Try to get them all!
– Virtual Cartridges to let you share your custom decks with friends and followers!
– Both chambers of Congress, with bribery & accurate election cycles
– Lots of crime to commit, but avoid being caught!
– Economic "features" like taxes & inflation
– Much, much more!
Will you be a champion of the Constitution, a self-serving politician or a power-hungry tyrant? The choice is yours!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00123244:ios.name: TipRanks Stock Market Analysis
bluejetty:00123244:ios.summary: Join millions of users who use TipRanks to track stocks, manage investment portfolios, access financial business data, improve investment strategy with Wall Street analysts and financial experts' tips, and stay on top of stock market news.
bluejetty:00123244:ios.description:
Join millions of users who use TipRanks to track stocks, manage investment portfolios, access financial business data, improve investment strategy with Wall Street analysts and financial experts' tips, and stay on top of stock market news.
TipRanks is a one-stop finance and stock market app that offers a suite of simplified stock research tools, including:
• Analysis of market trends and opinions from industry analysts
• Data-driven scores based on market factors
• News and research about your Watchlist stocks
• Real-time quotes, stock futures, charts, and data for your favorite stocks and indices
• Stay up to date with stock alerts, stocks tracker, stock signals, stocks to buy, hot stocks, stock prices, trending Stocks, etc.
Whether you are an aspiring investor or an experienced investor, you can leverage investment opportunities and invest like a pro when you have access to the best data and research tools.
RESEARCH TOOLS & REAL-TIME DATA
- Find out what experts think are the best stock picks, based on their top ratings
- Analyze data according to your investment strategy and gain a comprehensive real-time view of stocks
- Utilize our smart, data-driven score, based on different market factors, to gain immediate insight into your portfolio stocks
STOCK PORTFOLIO TRACKER & STOCK WATCHLIST
- Sync or create a portfolio to receive a full analysis and actionable insights
- Build your customized Watchlist and keep track of stock quotes
- You may access your Watchlist at any time for current stock prices, and your Holdings portfolio provides you with a 24/7 view of your total asset value
STOCK MARKET NEWS & ANALYSIS
- Get the latest market news including insightful stock insights, top analysts' recommendations, and Strong Buy and Strong Sell stocks
- Learn which corporate insiders are buying stocks and follow their transactions
- Keep track of top daily gainers or losers, upcoming events, IPOs, earnings, etc.
STOCK ALERTS & CHARTS
- Receive push notifications or email alerts about your favorite stocks and experts
- Keep track of all your notifications with our handy Alert Center
- Obtain key information about stock charts, including statistics, earnings, dividends, stock price targets, and forecasts from expert analysts
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
• Advanced Stock Research - First-class market intelligence, sourced from unique algorithms
• Analysts' Top Stocks - Put the best Wall Street analysts to work for you and get access to the stocks they rate as Strong Buys and Strong Sells
• Smart Score Stocks - Discover stocks, using our data-driven scoring system
• Daily Analyst Ratings - Reviews the daily Buy and sell recommendations of over 7700 analysts
• Stock Screener - Use our simplified screener to search for stocks according to your preferences
• Insiders' Hot Stocks and Trending Stocks - Monitor insider activity and discover best-rated stocks by analysts, from the last 72 hours
• Stock Comparison - Discover each stock’s price target as well as recommendations by top Wall Street experts
Make sure to download the TipRanks app and stay up to date as the stock market moves.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.tipranks.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use
https://www.tipranks.com/terms

bluejetty:00023119:ios.summary:
Build habits that actually stick. HabitMinder turns your goals into daily routines with smart reminders, streaks, and progress stats you can see at a glance.
Track everything from one place — home-screen widgets, Apple Watch, Siri Shortcut
bluejetty:00023119:ios.description:
Build habits that actually stick. HabitMinder turns your goals into daily routines with smart reminders, streaks, and progress stats you can see at a glance.
Track everything from one place — home-screen widgets, Apple Watch, Siri Shortcuts ("Log 15 squats"), and automatic Apple Health sync — plus 50+ ready-made habits and built-in mini-apps for hydration, breathing, and focus sessions. Reminders promptly notify you when it's time to complete a habit.
Free to start. Optional Premium unlocks unlimited habits and advanced stats — no ads, no pressure.
Why do you need HabitMinder, another habit tracker? Here are some sample healthy habits the app will help you form and keep:
• Walking – the most natural movement and fantastic exercise. Try to hit 10,000 steps a day with the help of HabitMinder – you’ll notice a change.
• Hydration – staying hydrated is one of the best habits for your overall health. After all, water makes up 75% of your muscles, 83% of your blood, and 90% of your brain, so you can’t go wrong. Good hydration promotes healthy skin, it makes your brain stronger, and it can help you lose weight.
• Breathing/Mindfulness – relieve feelings of stress and tension through breathing and mindfulness exercises. This will improve your focus and your mood as well as having a positive impact on your physical health.
• Exercise – you need to exercise to stay fit, lose weight, and stay physically and mentally healthy. HabitMinder can't do the exercise for you but it will help you stay on schedule.
• Stretching – stretching is an essential part of being fit and healthy. It can also help you relax so should be part of your daily routine.
• Stand – it will surprise you when you learn just how much of your day you spend sitting down. Your attention will improve, you will feel more energised, and you will improve your physical health by getting into one simple habit – standing up frequently and regularly.
• Squats – your partner will love this habit and so will you. Your muscles will become firmer and more toned, and you will feel stronger. Squats can even help you lose weight.
• Eat healthily – everyone knows the benefits of eating healthily. Getting into a regular and committed healthy eating habit is easier said than done, however. HabitMinder is the solution – it will help keep your healthy eating plans on track.
• Sleep more – sleep is crucial for your physical and mental health and wellbeing. Even 30 minutes more per night will have a positive impact.
Download today, HabitMinder - your daily habit tracker.

bluejetty:00023230:ios.name: Weber Connect
bluejetty:00023230:ios.summary:
The Weber Connect app is your secret ingredient to Smart Grilling!
Weber Connect is the companion app to Weber smart grills and devices. When paired to a Weber Connect grill or device, the app becomes your sensor dashboard, remote control,
bluejetty:00023230:ios.description:
The Weber Connect app is your secret ingredient to Smart Grilling!
Weber Connect is the companion app to Weber smart grills and devices. When paired to a Weber Connect grill or device, the app becomes your sensor dashboard, remote control, and recipe book all in one!
Track temperatures from anywhere
The temperature of your grill is important. Weber Connect grills and devices can track your grill's temperature and alert you when it drops below your target temp due to a flameout or spikes because of a flareup. With the Weber Connect app you can follow its temperature and get alerts for important events.
Even more important is the temperature of your food! A few degrees are all that stand between perfect and overdone. Weber Connect grills and devices let you track your food's internal temperature precisely with connected food probes and transmit them to your app. Watch the temp rise on the graph so you know when it's almost time to head back outside to take the steaks off, or set a target temp and get alerted when it's done no matter where you are.
Adjust the grill without getting up from the couch
Some Weber grills, like the SmokeFire, can have their cook temperature and mode changed by the app. That means you can turn the heat up, go into SmokeBoost mode, or shut down your grill without taking your eyes off the game.
Never wonder what to make for dinner again
The Weber Connect app has over 800 recipes built-in, with more being published every month. Every recipe has been crafted and tested by Weber Grillmasters, and many are fan favorites, so you know you can't go wrong with any of them! And almost half of our recipes are Smart Recipes, which walk you through, step-by-step, with short looping videos and clear instructions so you know when you're doing it right. Grilling has never been easier or more fun!
The new Weber Connect 2.0 app has the important features of the original app:
 • Remote temperature monitoring
 • Temperature limit alerts
 • Temperature range alerts
 • Timers
 • Remote cooking control for grills that support it
 • Smart Recipes
 • Classic Recipes
 • How-To videos for Weber Connect grills & devices
 • Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity
Plus some new tricks:
 • Live graphs
 • Graph sharing
 • Graph data export
 • Grill naming
 • Recently-cooked recipes
 • Recipe bookmarks
 • iPad support
 • Improved accessibility
 • Dark mode

bluejetty:00024763:ios.summary:
Welcome to High Valley Transit, the Wasatch Back’s newest public transit provider.
The High Valley Transit app makes it easier than ever to move around Summit County — with a few taps, you can book on-demand rides, check bus schedules, tra
bluejetty:00024763:ios.description:
Welcome to High Valley Transit, the Wasatch Back’s newest public transit provider.
The High Valley Transit app makes it easier than ever to move around Summit County — with a few taps, you can book on-demand rides, check bus schedules, track your vehicle on its way to you, and plan multi-leg journeys. Plus, it’s all totally free! 
How does the High Valley Transit app work?
The High Valley Transit app is both an on-demand rideshare service and general trip planning and mobility app. Input your address and we’ll give you the most efficient way to get there, whether that means matching you with a vehicle going your way or pointing you to the closest bus stop. 
Using the High Valley Transit app you can:
BOOK AN ON-DEMAND RIDE.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
CHECK BUS ROUTES AND SCHEDULES.
Our app has the most up to date information on bus routes and schedules, as well as a dynamic interface of stop points throughout the zone.
TRACK YOUR RIDE ON ITS WAY TO YOU.
Once you have booked a trip, you can track the location of the van in the app until it arrives at your indicated pickup point.
High Valley Transit is focused on accessibility. Cost should be no barrier to access, so all rides are 100% free. In addition, High Valley Transit operates wheelchair accessible vehicles and a complementary ADA service. To learn more about free ADA services (formerly the Park City Mobility Bus), visit highvalleytransit.org.
Questions? Head to highvalleytransit.org or reach out at highvalleytransit@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

Ever find yourself staring at the weather like it’s a trick question?
Maybe you’re an American living abroad wondering if 15°C means “bring a jacket” or “call the fire department.”
Or you’re from literally anywhere else, in the U.S., staring at 25°F and thinking, “Why is it snowing? 25 is supposed to be warm.”
Relax, chief. We got you.

With WeatherGO, you can finally have those confident weather conversations with:
 • your cool international friends
 • your Tinder date who “totally hikes”
 • that one neighbor who always has a weather take
 • random strangers you definitely didn’t ask
And you’ll actually know what you’re talking about.
Features
 • Fahrenheit + Celsius side by side
 • Accurate hourly & daily forecasts
 • Weather alerts when things get weird
 • Lock Screen & Home Screen widgets for quick glances
 • Multi-city support for travelers, expats, and nomads
 • Built-in °F↔°C converter for those “what the hell is this?” moments
 • AI-powered weather insights so JEFF sounds extra smart
Whether you’re abroad, at home, or somewhere in between, WeatherGO makes the weather simple, friendly, and a little bit like your uncle from New York (his name is JEFF).

bluejetty:00138398:ios.description:
Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.
You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.
Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...
MASSIVE OPEN WORLD
Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?
ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM
Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.
Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.
BEAUTIFUL VISUALS
Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.
SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK
Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.
BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM
Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.
JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS
Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.
As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!
WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS
Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!
SUPPORT
If you encounter any issues during the game, you can send us feedback via the in-game Customer Service Center.

bluejetty:00122530:ios.summary: With Bills Organizer & Reminder you can say NO to late payment fees, penalties and low credit score! The main idea of the app is to give you tool that lets you track and manage all your bills in one place. Bills Organizer & Reminder has das
bluejetty:00122530:ios.description:
With Bills Organizer & Reminder you can say NO to late payment fees, penalties and low credit score! The main idea of the app is to give you tool that lets you track and manage all your bills in one place. Bills Organizer & Reminder has dashboard-style views that allow you quickly see approaching bills, and it sends payment reminders for upcoming bills before due date. Never miss bill payment and always pay all your bills on time!
Main app features:
- Different views: Upcoming Bills, Paid Bills, Accounts, Account Bills, Calendar View, Chart View, Settings, etc.
- App allows you create recurring bills with different billing periods (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly etc.) and one time bills as well.
- Bills Organizer & Reminder sends payment reminders regardless whether the app is open or closed.
- Mark bill as paid from within notification without starting the app.
- Calendar gives you monthly view with payment statuses of bills.
- Chart lets you analyze your spending over any period of time.
- Bills Organizer & Reminder synchronizes data across all your iOS devices.
- Secure access to the app with Passcode, Touch ID or Face ID of your device.
- App icon’s badge shows you number of upcoming bills.
- Accounts management.
- Bills Organizer & Reminder allows you to export all your bills into CSV file.
- When you create or update account enter website URL. And later when you record bill payment click Payment URL link on the bill’s payment page to easy navigate to website and pay your bill.
- Advanced bill editing capability lets you update selected bill and all future bills as well. If you accidentally mark bill as paid you can easily mark it as unpaid.
- Auto Pay Bill feature becomes really handy when you have automatically paid bill and want the app to automatically mark the bill as paid on the due date.
- Upcoming Bills view displays total amount of unpaid bills by month and week.
- Paid Bills view displays total amount of paid bills by month.

bluejetty:00015733:ios.description:
Learn Spanish online or offline for free with SpanishDictionary.com, the leading Spanish-learning app trusted by millions. Translate anything between Spanish and English, look up the conjugations for every Spanish verb, and practice with our interactive quizzes, lessons, and drills. Watch thousands of pronunciation videos, browse millions of example sentences, and learn a new word each day with the Word of the Day.
FEATURES:
- Learn Spanish: Learn Spanish from A to Z with hundreds of interactive video lessons covering introductory Spanish all the way through advanced grammar topics.
- Spanish-English Dictionary: Browse thousands of entries that include translations, examples, regionalisms, and context. Our English to Spanish and Spanish to English dictionary is lightning-fast, extremely accurate, and works online or offline.
- Spanish-English Translator: Type, paste, or dictate the English or Spanish text that you want to translate and receive translations from three state-of-the-art, AI-powered, and highly-accurate neural machine translation engines. Then, copy the results from our Spanish translator straight to your device.
- Spanish Verb Conjugations: Become a pro at Spanish conjugation. Conjugate any verb in any tense, online or offline. Master irregular verbs and get context with example sentences.
- Spanish Pronunciation Videos: Perfect your Spanish pronunciation with native-speaker videos for tens of thousands of words.
- Spanish Vocabulary Practice: Quiz yourself on thousands of Spanish words with our highly-personalizable and extremely-effective vocabulary system powered by spaced repetition.
- Spanish Grammar Guide: Our Spanish-language experts have written thousands of articles and lessons about the most common Spanish grammar questions and the trickiest topics.
- Spanish Verb Conjugation Drills: Master the conjugations for any verb and any tense with interactive practice questions.
- Spanish Word of the Day: Never stop learning Spanish by discovering a new word each day.
- SpanishDictionary.com Premium: Take your learning to the next level with offline vocabulary quizzes, no ads, and downloadable Cheat Sheets and Phrasebooks.
Check out some of our reviews:
- “I’m using this app to learn Spanish and build up my vocabulary, and this is exactly what I need.”
- “I have been looking for places to teach me Spanish forever!! You can learn lessons for free just by watching 5 second ads after a lesson. If you ever need help with homework or a word this is the place.”
- “Easy to use and comprehensive. Large vocabulary and grammar examples abound”
- “It’s all at your fingertips. So easy. So comprehensive”
- “I love the fact that it gives different word usages for Spain vs Latin American countries. Very helpful. And the grammar quizzes and words of the day are great.”
- “This has always been and will always be my favorite Spanish translator app”
If you choose to purchase SpanishDictionary.com Premium, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
