bluejetty:00041064:ios.description:
Everyday tasks, all in one app.
Calculate tips, convert currencies, scan QR codes, count down to events, measure objects, check levels, track steps, and more — with 36 practical apps in one place.
AppBox Pro® includes 28 core apps for free, plus 8 premium apps available through Extra Pass or Full Pass.
28 Free Apps
Calculators
– Calculator: Basic and scientific.
– Date Calculator: Calculate days between dates and convert between solar and lunar calendars.
– Loan Calculator: Estimate payments and total cost.
– Percent Calculator: Calculate discounts and percentages.
– Sales Calculator: Find final prices and sales tax.
– Tip Calculator: Calculate tips and split bills.
– Unit Price: Compare prices to find the better value.
Converters
– Currency Converter: Convert world currencies.
– Lunar Converter: Switch between Solar and Lunar calendars.
– Translator: Translate text and speech across multiple languages.
– Unit Converter: Convert units across many categories.
Productivity
– Days Counter: Track key dates and events.
– Expense List: Keep a simple spending record.
– Ladies Calendar: Track cycles and view trends.
– Wallet: Organize passwords, cards, and personal data.
Life
– Abbreviation: Find what an acronym means.
– Holidays: Explore public holidays in 104 countries.
– Kaomoji: Find expressive emoticons for chats.
Utility
– Battery Status: Check battery and charging status.
– Clock: Choose from digital, LED, flip, and wave clock designs with weather.
– Flashlight: Light up the dark with a tap.
– Level: Check whether a surface is level — flat or upright.
– Magnifier: Zoom in on small text or objects.
– Mirror: Use your front camera as a mirror.
– Pedometer: Count steps with Apple Health.
– QR Code: Scan QR codes in seconds.
– Random: Generate a random number.
– Ruler: Measure in centimeters or inches.
8 Premium Apps
Available with Extra Pass or Full Pass:
– Daily Card: Capture your mood in a daily card and build a collection. Requires iOS 18 or later.
– PDF Splitter: Split a PDF into the pages you need.
– Password Generator: Create strong passwords in a tap.
– Markdown Reader: Open and read Markdown files.
– QR Code Generator: Create QR codes for links and text.
– Sleep Calculator: Find sleep and wake times that fit your schedule.
– Noise Meter: Measure the sound level around you.
– Text Counter: Count characters, words, and lines instantly.
Premium Upgrades
– Home Styles: Choose 3D Voxel, Jewelry, or Cartoon themes.
– Wallet: Smart Scan, Insights, Checkup, reminders, Recently Deleted, and scannable barcodes or QR codes for your cards.
– Days Counter: Milestones, date scanning, Home Screen widgets, and a Lock Screen countdown.
– Pedometer: Trends, streaks, and achievements.
– Calculator: Scan a math problem with Smart Calc.
– Tip Calculator: Scan a receipt with Smart Tip.
– Loan Calculator: Compare refinancing options with Refinance Analyzer.
Premium Options
Use all 28 core apps for free. Choose a plan for premium apps, premium features, or no ads:
– Ads Free Pass: Remove ads across AppBox Pro.
– Extra Pass: Unlock all premium apps and features.
– Full Pass: Unlock everything in Extra Pass and remove ads.
Subscriptions
Monthly and annual auto-renewable plans are available. Prices are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in App Store subscription settings.
Good to Know
– Some features require an internet connection.
– Pedometer uses Apple Health for steps and distance. Access is optional.
– No separate AppBox Pro account or sign-in is required; subscriptions use your Apple Account.
– Built and maintained independently since 2009.
Privacy Policy: https://www.allaboutapps.net/privacy.html
AppBox Pro® End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00027071:ios.description:
Unlock new dimensions of music creation with Audiobus, the ultimate hub that connects your music apps seamlessly, just like virtual cables. Whether you're crafting beats, experimenting with effects, or syncing live performances, Audiobus empowers your creativity with endless possibilities.
With Audiobus, you can:
- Send live audio or MIDI from one Audiobus-compatible app or AUv3 Audio Unit to another
- Add effects on top of your favourite synthesizer, and use your favourite step sequencer to drive it or plug in your guitar, and create your own effects chain, in parallel with your mic input
- Adjust the mix and balance with the mixer
- Send the result to your favourite DAW, sampler or looper, or run it out through a multi-channel audio interface
Integrate your music gear with Audiobus: 
- Connect a Bluetooth or wired MIDI keyboard to play a synth or other app or Audio Unit.
- Control your whole session from a foot switch or other MIDI controller using Audiobus' MIDI Learn In-App Purchase.
- Sync with external hardware with Audiobus' best-in-class MIDI clock.
Explore a vibrant ecosystem of over a thousand compatible apps, including:
- Korg Gadget
- GarageBand
- Launchpad
- Animoog
- Loopy HD
- Cubasis
- Auria
- Amplitube
...and many more! Check the full list at https://audiob.us/apps.
For detailed guidance, visit the Audiobus user manual at https://audiob.us/help.

- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00182511:ios.description:
Feeld was made for you to connect with open-minded people looking to explore dating and relationships in a safe and private way. Chat & connect on an alternative dating app created for anyone and everyone. Feeld is open to anyone looking for an exciting, new type of dating experience.
Discover a space to be your true self and let the people looking for you find you. Join Feeld to explore virtual or other locations and connect with like-minded individuals worldwide. Connect openly in a diverse community open to all genders and sexual identities as you redefine your relationships to self and others on Feeld.
Discover an open-minded dating experience when you download today.
FEELD FEATURES
CHAT & CONNECT
• Meet open-minded humans and start up a conversation
• Connect with people closest to you, or explore 20+ of our most popular cities around the world
• Find people looking to connect and discover a new way to date
A DATING APP MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Choose from over 20 gender identities
• Pick from a list of 20+ sexualities to personalize your Feeld experience
DATE YOUR WAY
• Explore safely on a secure and private dating platform
• Connect with curious Feeld members and explore your desires
• Chat with open-minded Feeld members for meaningful experiences
As seen in: New York Times, The New Yorker, Dazed & Confused, Cosmopolitan and Vanity Fair.
Become Majestic for the full Feeld experience. With a Majestic membership, you can enjoy enhanced features such as seeing who liked you on the app, adding private photos visible only to your Connections, one free Ping a day, and more.
Download Feeld, a place to explore curiosity and desires, and date in a different way. Connect with other people around the world that are ready for a new, exciting way to date.
______
You must be at least 18 years of age to access and use Feeld.
The app is free to download and use.
Additional features are available when you join the Majestic Membership, an optional paid subscription service that funds the app’s development.
Subscriptions must be managed by the members and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the App Store Subscriptions screen after purchase. 
When a trial subscription is offered, the trial period begins when a member signs up for the subscription through their App Store account. The subscription will be charged on the last day of the trial unless the member cancels at least 24 hours before trial ends.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the member purchases a subscription.
To cancel the Membership, members must cancel directly through their App Store account.
Cancellations begin at the end of the current subscription period.
All purchases are billed to the payment method that you designate when you sign up for an Apple ID as part of your App Store account and will appear as Apple on your App Store statement.
All personal data is handled under the Terms of Use of Feeld Privacy Policy. More details can be found here: https://feeld.co/about/privacy.
Terms of Use can be found here: https://feeld.co/about/terms

bluejetty:00139159:ios.description:
Chatting with people who have the same music taste as you is more fun, right?
With makromusic, you can easily find people listening to the same music at the same time as you. You can match and meet with them instantly. More? 
You can share posts about your favorite artists and tracks while having new friends. You don't even have to sign up, using your Spotify account to be connected would be enough. Also, it is totally free!
If you want, you can match according to your profile or music you listen to instantly. How is it? By connecting with your Spotify account, you actively share with us or share your favorite artists and songs that you have listened to before. We also match you with the people who are closest to your taste or listen to the same music at the same time. You can start chatting after viewing the profiles of the people you match with.
makromusic is designed in the best way for you. We want you to spend your precious time in the most fun and fluid way.
3 ways to find your music buddy and match in makromusic!
If you turn on instant pairing, we will match you with people listening to the same music simultaneously as you in makromusic
If you turn on Matching by Profile, we will match you with the person with the best taste of music, according to your listening habits on Spotify. You may both be listening to the same artists, the same songs, both of your favorite songs could be by one of the extraordinary bands.
On the Discover page, you can access people who are actively listening to music in makromusic. If your Spotify account is premium, you can choose the music you want from the explorer and have the same music open for you, and you can match the person listening to that music.
There are many ways to match in makromusic, as long as you want to match and chat with the same music lover.
On the chat page, you can access messages from people you have already matched with. You can continue the conversation with the person you wish from where you left off. Hmm, is there something you don't like? You can tell us by pulling the message to the left on the chat page or by pressing the three dots in the upper right corner of the conversation screen. You can be sure that we will achieve the best result for you! We want the makromusic experience to be at the most comfortable stage.
From ''my profile page'', you can see your favorite artists, your favorite songs and the songs you last heard. So you can easily share the taste of music with your mates and friends.
By reviewing the profiles of the people you are matching with, you can see your match rate, common songs, partner artists and why you are matched. So you can manage your matches in the healthiest way.
How do we use Spotify APIs?
We get the Email address, name and username, profile picture, and public playlists to which the Spotify account is linked. This information allows you to quickly register with makromusic. We want you to match and meet the people closest to the music taste quickly without losing time. Remember, you can always update this information as you like from the settings section.
We try to understand the music taste by taking the music you have played last, the content you have played, your favorite artists, and their favorite content. In this way, we match you with the person closest to the taste of music.
By doing the song changing action on the device to which the Spotify account is connected, we enable you to open the music quickly without logging out from the makromusic whenever you want to listen to the same music with the person you match with in makromusic. So we want you to have uninterrupted chat and user experience.
You can easily delete your makromusic account and saved data from the "Settings" section whenever you want.
You can review our privacy policy at https://makromusic.com/PrivacyPolicy and Terms of Use (EULA) at https://makromusic.com/terms-of-use
What are you waiting for? Download makromusic and start to match!

bluejetty:00123922:ios.description:
FAQ: http://bit.ly/HPS-FAQ
Raise your virtual pet in your pocket! Play dress up, decorate your house, and indulge in exciting mini games! Immerse yourself into a town full of good humor and happy animal friends, and create a unique dream home out of your imaginations! With hundreds of items to collect and tons of cute outfits and fashion accessories, you’ll be spoilt for choice! 
Stroll along the street lined with cute and colorful shops or simply chill in the cafe! Invite your friends to your town and show off your impressive home-decorating skills. You can also visit other townies to see if they are as cool and creative as you are. Build friendships and interact with your neighbors through hilarious dialogues, and help them out with daily requests in exchange for exciting rewards.
Add that personal touch to your home and fill it up with your favorite knick-knacks. Watch your house grow into the perfect dream home that you’ve been looking for!
YOUR PERFECT DREAM TOWN COME TO LIFE
- CREATE your own virtual pet with tons of outrageously cute outfits!
- TAKE CARE of your pet, give it a unique name and lots of tender loving care!
- DECORATE your very own home and make your friends envious!
- VISIT your friends’ street and interact with new players from all over the world!
- Step into a street full of lively animal neighbors! Meet Whiff, the poker-faced monkey who keeps farting, Albert the cranky wolverine professor, Bubbles who’s a shiny popstar, and Bizkit the ever-hungry sheep!
- PLAY mini games and complete quests for your friendly neighbours! Go fishing, play Rock Paper Scissors, join in the balloon popping frenzy, tap along to music rhythms and more! Complete your friendly neighbors’ requests for cool rewards!
- CHECK OUT the latest fashion fad at the Furniture Shop, Fashion Store, Salon, Cafe, and much more! 
- CHILD-FRIENDLY mode and Online mode: Players can choose to play in Child-Friendly mode where all online features and social interactions are disabled. Choose Online mode for the original gameplay experience.
If you’re a fan of the well-loved Pet Society, then this is a MUST-TRY!
FEATURES THAT YOU’LL LOVE
- FREE to download & FREE updates!
- Simple, intuitive and easy gameplay.
- Unique art style and vibrant world that is immersive, charming and cute!
- Stay happy all-day everyday with your animal neighbors!
- 200+ unique outfits, 300+ furniture and decorations, 200+ customizable looks, 10+ neighbors!
- Multiplayer! Visit your friends and compete on the rankings!
- Offline mode available! No internet access required. Keep your baby pet with you forever!
DOWNLOAD NOW!
- Remember to write a review to support us!
- Feedback: mojo@happylabsfree.com
This game is free to play but might include some In-App Purchase. Please turn this off in device settings if you do not wish to use this feature.

bluejetty:00096413:ios.summary:
The world is tangled. Threads of every color wrap around toys, animals, and tiny treasures, waiting for you to set them free. In Wool Fever, every puzzle is more than a challenge: it’s a little mystery hidden beneath layers of yarn.
Pull t
bluejetty:00096413:ios.description:
The world is tangled. Threads of every color wrap around toys, animals, and tiny treasures, waiting for you to set them free. In Wool Fever, every puzzle is more than a challenge: it’s a little mystery hidden beneath layers of yarn.
Pull the first strand. Hear the soft snap. Watch colors slip into order. Suddenly, what was once a chaotic knot becomes calm and clear. That’s the magic of Wool Fever: turning mess into harmony, one thread at a time.
Why You’ll Love It
- Unravel surprises: Beneath every layer of wool is something new, a plush bear, a tasty cupcake, or maybe something you never expected.
- Satisfying ASMR moments: Every tap, every pull, every unravel has that click of satisfaction.
- A dance of colors: Threads aren’t just yarn; they’re your palette. Sort them, match them, and paint order onto chaos.
- Calm meets challenge: Sometimes it feels like meditation. Sometimes it feels like a brain workout. Most of the time, it feels like both.
How to Play
- Tap to release colorful threads from their tangled jam.
- Match colors into tidy yarn boxes.
- Plan carefully when slots run out, it’s easy to tangle yourself up.
- Keep unravelling until every secret shape is free.
Whether you’re playing for a quick break or sinking into a long puzzle session, Wool Fever is a cozy escape that always welcomes you back.
So, are you ready? Grab a strand, pull gently, and let the unraveling begin.
Download Wool Fever now and lose yourself in the art of untangling.

bluejetty:00172747:ios.name: Clock Alarm++
bluejetty:00172747:ios.summary: Welcome to Clock Alarm, the ultimate iOS app designed to revolutionize your mornings and transform the way you wake up. With a range of innovative features and customizable options, Clock Alarm ensures you start your day on the right note,
bluejetty:00172747:ios.description:
Welcome to Clock Alarm, the ultimate iOS app designed to revolutionize your mornings and transform the way you wake up. With a range of innovative features and customizable options, Clock Alarm ensures you start your day on the right note, feeling refreshed and ready to conquer the world.
Key Features:
1. Alarm with a Variety of Sounds:
Clock Alarm offers a wide selection of alarm sounds to suit your preferences. Whether you prefer gentle melodies, nature-inspired tunes, or energetic beats, there's a sound to match every mood. Wake up to your favorite music, a soothing melody, or even the sound of chirping birds – the choice is yours!
2. White Noise Sleep Sounds with Timer:
Trouble falling asleep? Clock Alarm has you covered. Enjoy a peaceful night's sleep with a collection of high-quality white noise sleep sounds, such as rain, waves, and forest ambience. Set a timer to automatically turn off the sounds after a certain duration, allowing you to relax and drift off into a restful sleep.
3. Customizable Digital Screen:
Personalize your wake-up experience with Clock Alarm's customizable digital screen. Choose from a variety of visually appealing colors and font styles to create a display that resonates with your taste and complements your device's aesthetics. Whether you prefer a sleek minimalistic look or a vibrant burst of color, the app lets you create a unique and visually pleasing clock face.
4. Smart Alarm and Snooze Function:
Never oversleep again with Clock Alarm's smart alarm feature. The app analyzes your sleep patterns and ensures that you wake up during a light sleep phase, leaving you feeling refreshed and energized. Activate the snooze function for those mornings when you need a few extra moments of rest without worrying about oversleeping.
5. Multiple Alarms and Recurring Alarms:
Clock Alarm allows you to set multiple alarms for different occasions, ensuring you never miss an important event or appointment. Whether it's a weekday wake-up call or a reminder for an important meeting, the app lets you schedule alarms with ease. You can also set recurring alarms, saving you the hassle of manually setting them every day.
6. Bedtime Reminder:
Maintain a consistent sleep schedule with Clock Alarm's bedtime reminder feature. Set a reminder to receive a notification when it's time to wind down and prepare for bed. Establishing a regular sleep routine can significantly improve your overall sleep quality and well-being.
Clock Alarm is the perfect companion for anyone seeking to enhance their sleep and wake-up experience. Download the app now and start enjoying peaceful nights and energized mornings. Wake up refreshed, rejuvenated, and ready to embrace each day with Clock Alarm – the ultimate iOS alarm app.
Note: Clock Alarm requires iOS 15.4 or later. Some features may vary depending on your device's compatibility and operating system version.

bluejetty:00037898:ios.description:
Get direct answers to medical questions based on scientific references. Disclaimer: please always consult with a qualified medical professional before making any health decisions.
How does MediSearch work?
Trustworthy Sources: Answers rooted in scientific research. Our AI sifts through extensive databases of scientific papers and medical publications to provide you with information that is both accurate and up-to-date.
Easy-to-Understand Insights: Whether you're a medical professional or someone seeking general health information, MediSearch breaks down complex medical jargon into simple, understandable language.
Instant Access to Health Information: Say goodbye to endless online searches. MediSearch delivers swift answers to your health queries, saving you time and effort.
International: MediSearch provides answers in many widely used languages.
In-app Subscriptions:
Upon confirming your MediSearch Pro subscription, it will be linked to your Apple account. Your subscription will continue to renew automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the current period ends. To cancel, simply go to the 'Manage Subscription' area in your account settings. For additional details, please check our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Terms of Use: https://medisearch.io/terms
Privacy Policy: https://medisearch.io/privacy

bluejetty:00168173:ios.description:
If you're a fan of both car and tycoon games, we've got something for you! With our tycoon game and car builder in one, you'll get into a world of car factory management and vehicle production.

- Interesting graphics and captivating game mechanics.
- Make money and hire more assembly line workers.
- Get components such as chassis, wheels and engines joined on your assembly line.
- Accelerate the work of assembly line workers.
- Boost the number of sale outlets for your cars.
- Hire more sales agents to speed up the car sales process.
- Use boosters to raise the number of customers.
- Reach next levels to unlock more car models for sale.
- Keep your business going, manufacture and sell the cars.

Remember, your primary goal is to be the best manager, the leading car manufacturer on the market and to generate the highest possible revenue.

On Reef, every bit of curiosity about marine life finds a home. You can post photos of marine creatures you’ve captured, stories of amazing encounters while diving, or organized science notes. You can also browse shares from enthusiasts worldwide—give a like to stunning content, and use comments to exchange insights about corals, sea turtles, and tropical fish. Chat about species habits to ecological protection, turning every discussion into an opportunity to explore the deep blue.
Want to dive deeper into marine life knowledge? Reef’s AI assistant is always on standby! You’ll get professional yet easy-to-understand answers and recommendations, easily filling knowledge gaps and satisfying your curiosity about the marine world.

When you meet a like-minded friend, start a private chat anytime—talk about diving spots to creature observation tips, taking interactions beyond the comment section. Meanwhile, you can also check detailed knowledge about common marine species on Reef, learning about their physical features and living habits, laying a solid foundation for marine exploration.
Care about the latest in the marine field? On Reef, you can check marine life-related news in real time, staying updated on species protection progress and marine ecological trends. Play your MP3 files anytime, anywhere, even with your screen off.

• Offline Playback
Listen to your music with no WiFi or internet required.
• Screen-Off Playback
Keep the music playing even when your device is locked or the screen is off.

Add your MP3 files from Files, iCloud Drive, or any folder on your device.
• Background Playback
Continue listening while using other apps.
• High-Quality Audio Engine
Enjoy clear, rich, uninterrupted sound.
• Custom Playlists
Organize your songs the way you like.
• Clean & Modern Design
Fast, minimal, and optimized for a premium user experience.
Perfect For:
• Users who want offline music,
• Those with local MP3 files,
• Anyone who needs music that keeps playing when the screen turns off,
• Listeners who want battery-friendly, stable playback.
Your Music. Your Way. Offline.
Download now and take full control of your music library — without ads, without limits, and without needing the internet.

bluejetty:00120277:ios.name: Learn Portuguese +
bluejetty:00120277:ios.summary:
Do you want to learn Portuguese quickly and have fun doing it? Learn Portuguese + by Vidalingua is the first language app of its kind with a Virtual Tutor you can chat with on any topic, using advanced AI with ChatGPT.
The New York Times
bluejetty:00120277:ios.description:
Do you want to learn Portuguese quickly and have fun doing it? Learn Portuguese + by Vidalingua is the first language app of its kind with a Virtual Tutor you can chat with on any topic, using advanced AI with ChatGPT.
The New York Times says "Apps from Vidalingua are hugely popular... they're free and they work offline, handy when you're actually abroad."
Immerse yourself in real-life situations that you can use in the classroom or on a trip. Learn Portuguese + includes 101 lessons, 1,190 phrases and 5,277 exercises to help you become proficient in Portuguese in record time.
Vidalingua is a leading developer of language apps with over 15 million users. See what others have to say.
"Great for students! I teach at a bilingual school and it’s challenging to keep the students' attention. Apps are the best way to go and this offline app is one of my favorites."
"I downloaded several free apps. Some are like games but I’m not sure I’m learning things I can use. This app has lessons that are immediately useful for talking to real people in real situations.”
"Lingidy is a super fun way to learn Portuguese. It steps you through lessons you will need for a trip then throws in a few unexpected ones. Fun app. Bravo!"
The Vidalingua Method
Real-life Learning
Other apps waste time on vocabulary and grammar you’ll rarely ever use. Learn Portuguese + jumps right to lessons that you can use immediately. Start by learning Greetings, Essentials and Questions to get a conversation started. Progress to helpful lessons such as Airports, Hotels and Directions. Make the most of your travels with lessons such as Museums, Movies and Making Friends.
Understanding & Speaking
Understanding Portuguese is a good start but speaking is critical. Learn Portuguese + provides advanced speech recognition to help you master pronunciation. Practice speaking at your own pace until you build the confidence to talk to others.
Engaging Experience
Some of the lessons in Learn Portuguese + teach the basics such as telling Time, using the Subway or Eating Out. Others are unique and amusing such as Limousines, Hot Tubs, Pick-up Lines and Rejections. Interactive exercises keep your attention and improve retention. Meerling the meerkat provides help and encouragement.
Learn as you Like
Other apps force you to learn in a specific order. Lingidy allows you to move through lessons, phrases and exercises freely.
Features
• 101 lessons for real-life situations like taking Taxis, arriving at a Hostel or asking about the Weather. Fun lessons such as Flirting and Swearing.
• 1,190 useful phrases such as “Can you speak slowly?” and “Where is the closest cash machine?”.
• 5,277 exercises to master vocabulary, pronunciation and comprehension.
• Vocabulary exercises to help you master Numbers, Menus, even Cocktails.
• Audio pronunciations. Choose accents and speed.
• Select favorites to create your own study list.
• Word Jumble Exercises challenges you to order words in a phrase correctly.
• Pronunciation Exercises with advanced speech recognition to know if you say a phrase correctly.
• Picture Exercises to choose the image that matches a word.
• Write Exercises teaches you to understand spoken words & write them correctly.
• Multiple Choice Exercises to recognize the correct translations of a phrase.
• Set goals for yourself and track your learning progress.
• Notifications for Daily Phrases & Streaks.
Download Learn Portuguese + today!
Terms & Conditions
• Learn Portuguese + includes 12 free lessons and 101 lessons with a subscription.
• Payment charged to iTunes Account at the end of the trial period.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24-hours before expiring.
• Subscriptions may be managed by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Terms of Service
https://vidalingua.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00161819:ios.description:
‣ Driving School in Your Mobile: Theory, Driving Lessons & Courses
With Trafiko, you can do everything needed to get your driving licence directly in the app: study theory, book driving lessons, and schedule risk training. It’s both easier and more affordable than traditional driving schools.
‣ Pass-the-Test Guarantee
You can feel confident that you will pass the Swedish Transport Administration’s theory test on your first attempt when you study with Trafiko. We guarantee that you will pass the theory test, or you will get your money back.
‣ Get Your Driving Licence in 2 Weeks
Get your driving licence quickly with our two-week intensive course. The course includes everything you need to pass.
‣ Complete Theory with Videos & Theory Questions
Learn all the theory you need, step by step. At each stage, you can choose to watch a video, listen to an audiobook, or read. Then answer theory questions related to what you’ve just learned.
‣ Driving Lessons with Free Pick-up
Want your driving lesson to start at home, at school or even at your workplace? When you book driving lessons with Trafiko, free pick-up is always included. Of course, the pick-up time does not take away from your lesson duration.
‣ Book Risk Training Part 1 & Risk Training Part 2
In the app, you can easily book all the mandatory courses needed to get your driving licence: risk training part 1 and risk training part 2.
‣ Driving Licence Book 2026 as Audiobook & E-book
Listen to the latest Driving Licence Book 2026 as an audiobook or read it as an e-book directly in the app.
‣ Theory in Multiple Languages: Swedish, English, Arabic & Persian
All theory questions, the audiobook and the e-book are available in Swedish, English, Arabic, and Persian. Switch languages whenever you like.

bluejetty:00044806:ios.summary:
Introducing the Fully Alive App: Your Path to Spiritual Growth
Fully Alive is a Digital Community filled with courses and resources that help you partner with Jesus to become the Fully Alive person you were made to be. 
Living Fully Alive
bluejetty:00044806:ios.description:
Introducing the Fully Alive App: Your Path to Spiritual Growth
Fully Alive is a Digital Community filled with courses and resources that help you partner with Jesus to become the Fully Alive person you were made to be. 
Living Fully Alive is:
*Experiencing more healthy and life-giving relationships as you grow in Character. 
*Partnering with God and others to make our world more like heaven as you grow in Calling. 
Does This Describe Your Life?
There is a gap in every human soul. That gap is the empty void between the person we know we were meant to be… and the person we are. We instinctively know the gap exists and we are constantly disappointed by our inability to close it. The gap is a vacuum demanding to be filled… yet how we fill it tends to leave us empty.
Jesus knows all about our gap. And while some may have told you otherwise, Jesus did not come to condemn our gap. He came to redeem it. Jesus boldly declares into our gap, “I have come that you might have life… and have it to the full.” Jesus left heaven to bring that full life to you.
Living fully alive is for everyone ready to trade their current life for the one Jesus offers. Following Jesus is a journey. It becomes an adventure as we begin sharing our life with others. And it becomes a world-changing movement when we all do it together. Is Fully Alive for you?
“I knew I needed discipline in my life and wanted to experience more intimacy with Christ. These courses helped me think about God’s word and act on it. I’m eager to live for Jesus and share my faith with others, too.”
Donna, Cleveland, OH
“The Fully Alive cohorts challenged me to find my gifts and areas of passion to lead others, and become a producer in the Kingdom of God. I’ve never felt this close to God.”
Paul, Kansas City, KS
“5 years into leading the discipleship cohorts, I can honestly say I’m living fully alive! The Fruit of the Spirit is active in my life, and my greatest longing to help others do the same is being fulfilled.”
Myra, San Diego, CA
The Path to Living More Fully Alive
The Fully Alive App will guide you through three essential stages of spiritual formation based on the Fully Alive Life Plan. Unlock Your Spiritual Potential with Three Core Levels:
Explore
Begin your spiritual journey with Jesus by "seeing" for yourself. Dive into our free Explore courses, designed to help you ask investigative questions and discover Jesus' teachings from the Bible without any assumptions of faith.

We instinctively know the gap exists and we are constantly disappointed by our inability to close it. The gap is a vacuum demanding to be filled… yet how we fill it tends to leave us empty.

Living fully alive is for everyone ready to trade their current life for the one Jesus offers. Following Jesus is a journey. It becomes an adventure as we begin sharing our life with others. And it becomes a world-changing movement when we all do it together.  Is Fully Alive for you?

You will have a great time studying God's Word with this powerful, yet simple
bluejetty:00014125:ios.description:
This Reina Valera Bible has been carefully made by believers for believers willing to have a closer relationship with our LORD Jesus Christ, studying His words. 
You will have a great time studying God's Word with this powerful, yet simple to use app, including these main Features:
- No advertisements!
- Listen to the Reina Valera Old Testament and New Testament with Reverend Samuel Montoya.
- Real time GPS maps from 1200 places in the Bible
- Concordancia Biblica
- Many available text fonts for easy reading.
- Write your own notes using our Text Editor.
- Day reading mode and night reading mode.
- Change the text spacing and size.
- Fast pinch to zoom the text.
- Change the screen brightness.
- Justify the text to left, right or center.
- Reading mode and study mode.
- Fast access to cross references .
- Bookmark any verse easily.
- Share Bible verses on Facebook.
- Fast and feature rich Bible search.
- Auto-scrolling with adjustable speed.
- Automatically sync your notes on iCloud.
- Change the text to any color (in the Fonts Menu)
- Change the Background to any color (in the Fonts Menu)
- Change the App Theme to any color (in the Fonts Menu)
***** Commentaries in Spanish ***** 
By Editorial Mundo Hispano:
Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the whole Bible, 1871.
Century XXI Commentary.
Bible Dictionary Editorial Mundo Hispano
***** Commentaries in English ***** 
1) Albert Barnes (1798-1870) Notes on the whole Bible.
2) Adam Clarke's Commentary and critical notes on the whole Bible, written from 1810 to 1825.
3) John Nelson Darby Bible translation notes and Synopsis on the whole Bible.
4) Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the whole Bible, 1871.
5) John Gill's verse-by-verse Exposition of whole the Bible.
6) Matthew Henry's whole Bible Commentary
7) Philip Schaff Commentary on the New Testament (4 Volumes) and Introduction to all books, 1890.
8) Scofield Reference Notes on the whole Bible, 1917 Edition.
9) Treasury of David by C. H. Spurgeon, the "Prince of Preachers" with comments on the 150 Psalms.
10) Treasury of Scriptural Knowledge on the whole Bible, compiled by John Canne, John Browne, Thomas Scott, Benjamin Blayney, Reuben Archer Torrey and others (1900).
The power of the Scriptures is necessary for your spiritual growth, and that's why we've carefully designed the best app for the iPhone, iPod and iPad so you can search the scriptures daily (Acts 17:11). Learn from God's chosen way to speak directly with you, and every word is very important (Matthew 4:4).
As you study the Bible you can highlight the text with many colors to learn what our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ is teaching you. Take notes using the Rich Text Editor, because All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness (2 Timothy 3:16). 
Thank you for downloading the Reina Valera Study Bible!

- No network connection is required after downloading the game
This game is free to play, but you can choose to pay real money for special in-game items.

bluejetty:00140093:ios.description:
Take control of your very own pro wrestling team, building up your members to seize the title of undisputed industry best! Diet, training, even the occasional R&R—every facet counts when you're going for gold!
With your own team comes your own gym. Furnish it with a bench press, heavy bag, and other equipment of your choice, as you'll need your wrestlers in tip-top condition come fight day. On that note, a colorful host of wrestling rivals await your challenge. Prep sufficiently and you just might get your hand raised! So fight hard, fight well, but also—fight with style!
...And crack some crass quips at the pre-fight press conference too!
As for the in-ring action, weather thrilling exchanges amidst cheers from a capacity crowd, sinking a finisher at the right moment to nab the three-count!
The more popularity your team amasses, the more visitors will flock to your gym—and the more merch you'll ultimately move. You can even erect an arcade, karaoke room, batting cage and much, much more for some welcome added revenue!
Lastly, any team worth its salt needs more than a few members. Should a particularly talented wrestler catch your eye, see if you can't bring him or her onboard! This will grant you access to a whole new world of 2v2 and 3v3 tag matches—meaning more tussling territory for you to terrorize!
Well? What are you waiting for? Mask up and get in the ring! This is the business of bash, brother!

bluejetty:00179247:ios.name: Paper Sudoku: Classic & Killer
bluejetty:00179247:ios.summary:
Sudoku is best on paper. Paper Sudoku is the only app that keeps it that way.
Write your numbers with Apple Pencil, in your own handwriting, exactly as you would in a puzzle book - then let the iPad handle the parts paper can't. No smudged
bluejetty:00179247:ios.description:
Sudoku is best on paper. Paper Sudoku is the only app that keeps it that way.
Write your numbers with Apple Pencil, in your own handwriting, exactly as you would in a puzzle book - then let the iPad handle the parts paper can't. No smudged pencil marks, no rubbing a hole in the page, no starting the whole grid again because of one wrong digit twenty moves ago.
NEW IN VERSION 4.0
Killer Sudoku, written by hand - cages, sums and all.
Mini. Quick 6x6 games, for when you have a few minutes rather than an hour.
More puzzles, and difficulty recalibrated from the ground up - with far more at expert.
Learn now walks you through advanced strategies step by step, showing exactly which cells each one rules out and why.
Writing rebuilt from the ground up: strokes land faster, automatic note recognition is more reliable, and games are far easier on the battery.
Paper Sudoku now speaks Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese as well as English.
WRITTEN, NOT TAPPED
Built for Apple Pencil from the first line of code - not a number pad with handwriting bolted on. Pencil marks and candidate notes stay in your own hand, and when you would rather not write out a full set, notes fill themselves on demand.
FOR EVERY SOLVER
Highlighting to trace a digit across rows, columns and boxes. Check the whole grid for errors with a single tap. Unlimited undo and redo, so an experiment costs you nothing. And the interactive Learn mode teaches the strategies themselves, from the first scan of a grid to the techniques that crack an expert.
Unlimited puzzles. Every one playable offline, anywhere - a puzzle book that never runs out.

bluejetty:00026677:ios.description:
The best of PriceCharting and SportsCardsPro now on iOS! Find out what your collectibles are worth. Track market prices of video games, sports cards, Pokemon, YuGiOh, Magic the Gathering, Lorcana, and other trading cards, comic books, US coins, LEGO, and more. Completely free. We track thousands of sales from the top auction sites: eBay, Heritage, PWCC, and more, filter and sort them by condition into easy to use price guides.
PriceCharting allows you to:
- View pricing for all conditions of an item.
- View previous sales of collectibles from across the web. 
- Add items to your Collection to track their value over time. 
- Add items to your Wishlist 
- Use Search By Photo or Barcode Scanner to instantly ID your trading card or comic. 
- View all of the variations of your collectibles with our extensive photo catalog.
- Share collectibles with your friends via text message.
- Get notifications when items on your wishlist are listed below market value on eBay or our own marketplace
- Create lots from any number of items, add markups, and share PDF receipts when you're at conventions or just a garage sale
- Get grading recommendations for your ungraded collectibles that would gain the most value 
Example video games console supported: Playstation, PS2, PS3, PS4, PS5, Nintendo NES, SNES, Wii, Wii U, Gameboy, GBA, Nintendo DS , Xbox, Sega Genesis, Dreamcast, and many others. 
Example Pokemon sets supported: Base Set, Scarlet & Violet, Pokemon 151, Vivid Voltage, Obsidian Flame, and every other Pokemon English and Japanese set.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00041787:ios.summary: FKN (Фитнес как наука) - это революция среди фитнес-приложений. Мы объединили спорт и науку для получения гарантированного результата, о котором вы мечтаете! Наша цель – помочь построить здоровое тело, проработать все страхи и сомнения, кот
bluejetty:00041787:ios.description:
FKN (Фитнес как наука) - это революция среди фитнес-приложений. Мы объединили спорт и науку для получения гарантированного результата, о котором вы мечтаете! Наша цель – помочь построить здоровое тело, проработать все страхи и сомнения, которые вас останавливают.
Программы тренировок разработали амбассадоры спортивного мира: Александр Дзидзария и Владислав Лапшин в тандеме с лучшими атлетами страны в различных категориях. Программы составлены по авторской методике нагрузок RPE. Это наша фишка! RPE помогает подобрать идеальную физическую нагрузку конкретно под вас.
С помощью приложения FKN вы сможете:
- сбросить или набрать массу
- повысить гибкость или укрепить тонус мышц
- изменить пищевые привычки
- полюбить физическую активность
- узнать свое тело по-новому
Приложение FKN адаптирует программу под ваши потребности, упрощая весь путь к здоровому образу жизни:
ПИТАНИЕ. В приложении есть готовые рецепты и недельные планы питания, которые автоматически создают список простых и понятных продуктов, все можно найти в ближайшем магазине!
ТРЕНИРОВКИ И ПРОГРАММЫ. Раздел тренировок удобно упакован в циклы. Помимо комплексных программ есть и индивидуальные тренировки, например если хотите прокачать только грудь или руки.
КОНТРОЛЬ. Выполненные тренировки фиксируются в календаре — так удобно отслеживать успехи и добавлять любимые тренировки в Избранное.
СТАТИСТИКА. Вести расчеты - утомляющая рутина. Этим займётся умный алгоритм приложения FKN: нормы КБЖУ, воды и потребления калорий. Все цифры учитывают ваши индивидуальные особенности, а благодаря поддержке Apple Health приложение автоматически считает шаги.
ЗНАНИЯ. Важные статьи на темы здоровья, спорта, витаминов и гормонов вы найдёте в разделе Полезное. Хотели разобраться в сахарозаменителях или составить веганское меню? Известный диетолог Олег Ирышкин удовлетворит ваш интерес по этим и другим вопросам.
Мы добавили для вас:
- трекер воды, чтобы вы могли отслеживать количество употребляемой жидкости
- Трекер для интервального голодания, что поможет вам с легкостью голодать и отслеживать промежутки голодания и приема пищи.
- Базу с продуктами, добавление продуктом по штрих-код и возможность добавлять свои продукты. Мы переработали систему с питанием и дали больше возможностей для более детального и гибкого добавления питания.
- Мы переработали дашборд и вынесли туда основные инструменты, которые нужны вам каждый день для поддержки своих целей.
- Трекер шагов - покажет сколько в день вы проходите и поможет выполнить суточную норму шагов.
Немного об экспертах приложения:
Александр Дзидзария: врач уролог, онколог, андролог, доктор медицинских наук, президент ассоциации молодых урологов, наставник чемпионов по бодибилдингу и фитнесу. Позаботится о медицинских показателях вашего здоровья, поможет выявить дефицитные состояния организма, которые влияют на похудение и набор массы.
Владислав Лапшин: мастер спорта по бодибилдингу, чемпион Москвы по классическому бодибилдингу и Men's physique muscular, триатлонец, участник IronMan. Будет вашим тренером и передаст максимум знаний, накопленных за 10 лет профессиональной работы тренером. Его главный девиз: "На дне терпения оседает золото".
Олег Ирышкин: врач эндокринолог, кандидат медицинских наук, эксперт по диетологии. Профессионально ответит на каверзные вопросы и объяснит, как применять науку о пище на практике, в жизни.
Медицинский подход к фитнесу - это FKN. Под руководством профессионалов вы будете меняться день за днем! Несколько тысяч человек уже доверили нам своё здоровье и смогли изменить себя. Присоединяйтесь и добро пожаловать в FKN!

How amazing this airplane game is, a real adventure in today's sky game because of its features which make it unique from the other flight simulator. Just fly your own choice of planes, avoid hitting any other vehicles like cars, buses, bikes, and trains and fly unlimited in cities. Be careful while takeoff and landing with airplanes, jets, helicopters & trainee planes because along its airplane parking area like other airplane parking games.
Airplane Game – Trainee Pilot Game Mission Mode:
Be the best pilot in the new dimensioning of simulation set your goals in airplane games suit for the new pilots who just joining us. Really love flying, let do a mission in the sky with the ‘Airplane Simulator Flight’ game just designed for you. This airplane new game will give an idea for completing real flight missions with plane games. Train yourself like an expert pilot, fly multiple game planes free, and thrilling airplane games mission. Every army soldier who has a dream of becoming a pilot can train himself with these airplane army games.
Realistic Game with Flight Simulator Experience:
Have you any experience in airplane games flying? Let’s play and handle the role of flight pilot in this airplane games simulator. Take control of your airplane games offline. Fly planes in the sky and complete the airplane game missions. Your task in this plane simulator game is to fly an airplane in the air and complete the circles. This pilot game has high-quality graphics and detailed airplanes. You will need excellent pilot skills to take off the flight. Landing is a tough job for a pilot, you will learn flight landing experience. Enjoy the experience of an airplane pilot. It is a new way to test your perfect plane driving skills in airplane games.
This fly mission game has a different set of challenges. Flying over mountains and high buildings is the most beautiful part of this game. In aeroplane games, you always need attention. Be careful while flying over the mountain if you crash with a mountain or hill, your plane will be damaged. You will enjoy the realistic games aeroplane engine sound in this airplane landing game.
Surprising about this game consists of modern aircraft, training planes, and jet fighters to play with them and concurred sky. Every plane has different driving game features.
Airplane Simulator - Jet Sky Fighting Warrior Game Mode:
Ai

bluejetty:00026549:ios.description:
Welcome to the Offroad Revolution world - the most realistic offroad experience on mobile phones. Build your favorite custom vehicles and drive them through mud, water, snow, desert, perform stunts! Complete control over your look and tuning - use tracks instead of wheels, swap to diesel, change axles, etc. Upgrade your trucks with thousands of combinations of parts, suspensions, tires, rims, colors, etc. Download now and conquer the offroad world.
CUSTOM VEHICLES
Choose from 40 different vehicles - pickup trucks, SxSs, rock crawlers, ATVs, SUVs, semi trucks, muscle cars, etc. Build custom vehicles with countless different options - front bumpers, rear bumpers, cages, running boards, fenders, tires, rims, etc. Tune your vehicle completely - change axles, adjust stiffness, damping, wheel sizes, etc. Choose different suspensions on your vehicles. Want an independent instead of solid? No problem!
MAPS
Enjoy driving on various maps and under different conditions - mountain/swamp, desert, stunts and snow. Tune your vehicles to adjust behavior to different terrains. Enjoy open free play mode and explore maps and find secret boxes with gold/money. Find challenges along the way. If you want a career mode, you can complete different missions and levels.
MULTIPLAYER
If you want to play with your friends, this is the best way. Customize your cars to your liking and show them off online.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Racing Community:

Gear up, rev your engines, and dive into the most intense motorbike racing experience on the App Store. Whether you're a casual rider or a seasoned pro, our game offers the perfect blend of excitement, challenge, and realistic thrills. Are you ready to leave your mark on the asphalt? bluejetty:00061378:ios.name: Log-Book
bluejetty:00061378:ios.summary: The goal of Log-Book is to create entering car mileage as simple and quick as possible but still be compliant with the tax departments’ requirements. Once you have used Log Book a few times you will be able to enter a new trip in THREE taps
bluejetty:00061378:ios.description:
The goal of Log-Book is to create entering car mileage as simple and quick as possible but still be compliant with the tax departments’ requirements. Once you have used Log Book a few times you will be able to enter a new trip in THREE taps (and that's including the tap to save it).
We use this app and apart from trying to fix how to stop us forgetting to do it we wanted to make the process as quick as possible because lets face it, everyone wants to spend as little time as possible doing things like this, regardless of how pretty or feature rich the app is.
To speed up a trip entry you can add your own common start, destination and purpose entries. The date and start odometer are entered automatically.
There are no pretty graphs, fancy reports or a multitude of settings, just simple, quick entries.
All entries can be exported to a CSV file for manipulation (graphs and wiz-bang formulas) in a spreadsheet.
Features details:
- Add entries for each trip including distance, places, reasons and general notes.
- 1 to 3 taps for a new entry
- Include start and end times, if required
- Export to CSV
- PDF by month, last month, last 3 months, last year, or all
- Email CSV and PDF
- Popup monthly summaries

bluejetty:00026366:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00026366:ios.description:
This season, live the game like never before with GameChanger, the #1 youth sports app. 
Coach smarter. Connect live. Replay the action. All with tools designed to elevate the season for coaches, club directors, athletes, youth sports families, and fans.
COACH SMARTER
Coach smarter with tools like Game and Player Insights, lineup recommendations, team messaging, and announcements, so you can stay organized, make informed decisions, and support stronger player development.
CONNECT LIVE
Connect live to every game and get real-time play-by-plays whether you’re on the field, on the go, or cheering from home thanks to a suite of live streaming tools, digital scorekeeping, Full HD (1080p) live streaming, free game alerts, and more.
REPLAY THE ACTION
Replay and share the biggest moments of every game automatically with highlight clips, recap stories, video archives, Career Profiles, and more.
EASY-TO-USE SCOREKEEPING TOOLS 
Track the game faster, easier, and more reliably with intuitive scorekeeping tools available for dozens of sports.
LIVE HD VIDEO STREAMING 
Stream games live for free in Full high-definition 1080p and bring a high-quality version of the game to anyone, anywhere complete with real-time scoreboard overlays that keep viewers up to date throughout the game.
FREE TEAM MANAGEMENT
Keep teams connected with built-in messaging, scheduling, RSVPs, and photo sharing free for everyone — all in one place.
ROSTER MANAGEMENT
Build and manage rosters with a centralized team view and seamless imports from MaxPreps, Sports Connect, or a past season on GameChanger. 
LINEUP RECOMMENDATIONS
Build lineups that reflect real performance and give athletes the opportunities they’ve earned with data-backed lineup suggestions before every game. 
GAME & PLAYER INSIGHTS
Coaches receive clear, easy-to-understand offensive and defensive insights for every baseball, softball, and basketball game to help shape practice plans and game strategy. And families and fans get game and season-level insights specific to their player.
SHAREABLE CAREER PROFILES
Create customizable Career Profiles showcasing individual stats and key video highlights to aid in player development and share with family, friends, or recruiters. 
AUTOMATIC HIGHLIGHT CLIPS
Re-watch or share automatically generated video clips of every play or point scored by your team throughout the game when you stream and score.
RECAP STORIES
Catch up on a game’s biggest moments with a newspaper-style account of a scored baseball, softball, or basketball game.
GAME HIGHLIGHT REELS
Watch your team’s top offensive and defensive plays from a game in a single, comprehensive reel.
EXTERNAL CAMERA COMPATIBILITY
GameChanger is compatible with Mevo, GoPro, XbotGo, and other third-party cameras using RTMP.
FREE FOR COACHES & TEAM STAFF
GameChanger premium features like video highlights, video archives, career stats, and spray charts remain completely free for coaches and team staff. (Paid subscription required for fans.)
WEB PORTAL 
Access your teams any time in the app or on the web at gc.com.
GameChanger is currently available for: baseball, softball, soccer, basketball, lacrosse, football, volleyball, field hockey, ice hockey, water polo, rugby, swimming & diving, track & field, wrestling, crew & rowing, bowling, cheerleading, cross country, tennis, and golf.
Terms of Use: https://gc.com/home/terms
California Disclosures: https://dickssportinggoods.com/s/california-disclosures
US Patent No. 8,731,458

bluejetty:00169762:ios.description:
Tebra is the first and only complete and fully integrated platform designed for the unique needs of independent practices. Tebra Mobile for iPad, iPhone and Apple Watch is the mobile companion to the platform. It helps you run a more efficient and profitable practice all from your mobile device.
You can now truly engage with patients while accessing every part of your practice instantly and seamlessly. A single login gives you access to your Tebra Clinical (EHR), Tebra Billing (PM) or Tebra Managed Billing (RCM) modules. Now you have the power to care for patients and monitor the health of your practice right at your fingertips.
With Tebra Mobile you can:
• Access and update your schedule: add and edit appointments, schedule for single or multiple providers, and manage multiple locations. 
• Manage all of your patients: add new and search for patients, review patient records, and view demographics. 
• Communicate with your entire office: send and receive secure messages to your biller, patients and employees. Reference patients and attach documents to your messages. 
• Manage all of your documents: view, capture and upload documents and annotate images. 
• Get started in minutes by using our quick diagnosis and procedure code importer.
For Tebra Clinical (EHR) users: 
• Create clinical notes using shortcuts, free text, and templates 
• View and document medications, vitals, patient history, immunizations, and more
• E-prescribe medications and order, review, and sign off labs 
• Create and manage superbills (ICD-10 ready)
For Tebra Billing (PM) users:
• View, manage, and capture charges submitted to your biller
• Review your practice's financial health with billing analytics
• Receive and review subscribed reports
• Quickly enter patient data and see account alerts
For Tebra Managed Billing (RCM) users: 
• View and capture charges 
• Receive and review subscribed reports
• Quickly enter patient data and see account alerts
With Apple Watch you can:
• Manage your schedule, get reminders for upcoming appointments
• View, send, and reply to secure messages
• See your progress throughout the day 
The Tebra Platform is secure, HIPAA compliant, ICD-10 ready and includes a Meaningful Use Stage 2 certified EHR.

bluejetty:00150002:ios.description:

bluejetty:00145742:ios.description:
The official FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app helps you keep in touch with your friends and prepare for adventure, anytime, anywhere! Access your in-game friend list, chat with fellow adventurers, make and share plans using the event list, manage your items, browse the market board, and assign retainer ventures!
Please note that an active service account and subscription for FINAL FANTASY XIV are required to use this app. 
Please also note that some features such as chat can still be accessed for the first 30 days after your subscription for the main game has expired. You will lose access to all features after this period. 
■Features
- Chat
Chat with other players who are using the companion app; your in-game friends, Free Company and Linkshell members, and more!
- Event List
Create, edit, and manage scheduled events, bringing your friends together to take on raids, trials and more!
- Item Management
Sort, move, sell, or discard your items with the tap of a button! 
*Please note that item management via the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app is not available while logged into the game with the associated service account.
- Market Board
Items can be purchased or listed for sale on the market board through the use of in-app currencies: Kupo Nuts or Mog Coins. Kupo Nuts can be obtained as login bonuses and Mog Coins are available as in-app purchases. Please note that access to the market board via the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app is not available while logged into the game with the associated service account. 
- Retainer Ventures
Spend Kupo Nuts or Mog Coins and assign retainer ventures, anytime, anywhere!
* A purchase of a virtual currency in this App grants a license for the virtual currency.
For full terms of service, please see the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/ww/) and SQUARE ENIX TERMS OF SERVICE (https://www.square-enix-games.com/en_US/documents/tnc).
■Feedback & Bug Reports
Your feedback is extremely valuable in helping us to improve the app and provide the best possible service. While the app review system allows users to evaluate the overall quality of the app, our Support Centre specialises in responding to more detailed feedback and reports of potential issues. 
Should you encounter any issues when using the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app, please do not hesitate to contact the Support Centre at the address below or via the app.
Contact the SQUARE ENIX Support Center: https://sqex.to/WXr

Access your in-game friend list, chat with fellow adventurers, make and share plans using the event list, manage your items, browse the market board, and assign retainer ventures!

Please note that an active service account and subscription for FINAL FANTASY XIV are required to use this app. 
Please also note that some features such as chat can still be accessed for the first 30 days after your subscription for the main game has expired. You will lose access to all features after this period. 


■Features

- Chat
Chat with other players who are using the companion app; your in-game friends, Free Company and Linkshell members, and more!

- Event List
Create, edit, and manage scheduled events, bringing your friends together to take on raids, trials and more!

- Item Management
Sort, move, sell, or discard your items with the tap of a button! 
*Please note that item management via the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app is not available while logged into the game with the associated service account.

- Market Board
Items can be purchased or listed for sale on the market board through the use of in-app currencies: Kupo Nuts or Mog Coins. Kupo Nuts can be obtained as login bonuses and Mog Coins are available as in-app purchases. Please note that access to the market board via the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app is not available while logged into the game with the associated service account. 

- Retainer Ventures
Spend Kupo Nuts or Mog Coins and assign retainer ventures, anytime, anywhere!

* A purchase of a virtual currency in this App grants a license for the virtual currency.
For full terms of service, please see the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/ww/) and SQUARE ENIX TERMS OF SERVICE (https://www.square-enix-games.com/en_US/documents/tnc).

■Feedback & Bug Reports

Your feedback is extremely valuable in helping us to improve the app and provide the best possible service. While the app review system allows users to evaluate the overall quality of the app, our Support Centre specialises in responding to more detailed feedback and reports of potential issues.  

Should you encounter any issues when using the FINAL FANTASY XIV Companion app, please do not hesitate to contact the Support Centre at the address below or via the app.

Contact the SQUARE ENIX Support Center: https://sqex.to/WXr

bluejetty:00177605:ios.description:
O app Tistu é a maneira mais simples, prática e segura de você acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na escola. Esqueça as ultrapassadas agendas de papel, você pode utilizar seu celular e ter acesso ao diário de seu filho em tempo real e onde estiver!
Com o app Tistu você tem todas as funcionalidades necessárias para acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na palma da sua mão:
* Diário: acompanhe as atividades realizadas pelo seu filho. Como estava a sua participação nas brincadeiras e tarefas? Ele estava animado? Brincou com os coleguinhas? Fez todas as refeições? Comeu bastante ou pouquinho? Fez pipi?
* Recados: envie um recadinho diretamente para o professor de seu filho ou para a diretora da escola e seja avisado quando receber uma resposta.
* Calendário: verifique o dia e o horário das atividades realizadas pela escola. Seja avisado assim que receber um novo convite e receba um lembrete quando uma atividade estiver próxima. Informe sua participação aos professores aceitando ou rejeitando os convites.
* Medicamentos: informe ao professor os medicamentos que seu filho está tomando, em que horário eles devem ser ministrados e em que dosagem. Encaminhe junto uma foto da receita médica.
* Dados: informe os dados mais importantes sobre seus filhos. Quais são as suas alergias? Qual o seu plano de saúde? Quais são as pessoas autorizadas a buscá-lo? Qual o seu aniversário?

bluejetty:00180538:ios.name: Happy Bundee: Kids Short Story
bluejetty:00180538:ios.summary: Introduce your little ones to “Happy Bundee,” a charming short storybook app designed especially for preschool, nursery, and kindergarten children ages 3 to 7. This educational app is a fun introduction to children’s books, filled with mora
bluejetty:00180538:ios.description:
Introduce your little ones to “Happy Bundee,” a charming short storybook app designed especially for preschool, nursery, and kindergarten children ages 3 to 7. This educational app is a fun introduction to children’s books, filled with moral lessons about sharing, kindness, and giving. Ideal for both home and school, it’s perfect for early learners.
— KEY FEATURES FOR YOUNG LEARNERS
* Read-to-Me Fun: This delightful app helps children start reading with gentle read-to-me narration while they learn about sharing, kindness, and early literacy skills through interactive storytelling.
* Offline Learning & Audio: All content, including the read-aloud narration, text, voice, and picture elements, works completely offline—no internet required.
* Interactive Picture Book Fun: Kids can tap, pull, pop, and drag elements in this delightful English-language book, turning reading into a hands-on activity.
* Read-Along & Word Learning: Follow along with the story using highlighted words and clear English narration. Children can listen to the story aloud or practice reading with support, helping build vocabulary and early literacy skills.
* Moral & Bible-Based Fable: Bundee the bunny learns that giving is better than hoarding. This app connects with biblical teachings and Bible stories about generosity, kindness, and putting heavenly treasures above earthly possessions.
* Safe for Toddlers & Babies: With a kid-safe experience (no ads or in-app purchases), even nursery-age kids and toddlers can enjoy the story worry-free.
* Perfect for Short Sessions: Great for 5-minute bedtime stories during quick educational moments throughout the day.
* From Me to We: Children learn the value of sharing “from me to others” while enjoying a fun, animated experience.
* Designed for Young Learners: Simple text, soft audio, and warm illustrations make it ideal for early learners ages 3 and up.
* Start Having Fun: Enjoy a playful, game-like experience as you tap, pull, pop, and drag your way through the app.
* Perfect for Early Readers: Happy Bundee is ideal for children taking their first steps toward independent reading.
— EDUCATIONAL BENEFITS
More than just a storybook, “Happy Bundee” is an educational tool that helps children understand empathy, generosity, and cooperation through age-appropriate storytelling. It’s a fun way to learn at home or at school, with engaging voice narration, colorful pictures, and easy-to-follow text.
— BIBLE VERSE HIGHLIGHT
“Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal, but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal. —Matthew 6:19–20 (ESV)
— WALA BEAR INC.
https://www.walabear.com

bluejetty:00084042:ios.summary:
Print your iPhone or iPad calendar quickly and easily with Cal Printer. Create clear Day, Week, Month or List views, then print them directly using AirPrint or save and share them as PDFs.
Cal Printer works with the calendars and reminders
bluejetty:00084042:ios.description:
Print your iPhone or iPad calendar quickly and easily with Cal Printer. Create clear Day, Week, Month or List views, then print them directly using AirPrint or save and share them as PDFs.
Cal Printer works with the calendars and reminders already on your device — there's no new calendar to set up and no account required. Perfect for printing family calendars, work schedules, appointments, monthly planners, weekly schedules and reminders.
PRINT YOUR APPLE CALENDAR
Need to print your calendar from your iPhone or iPad? Cal Printer makes it simple. Choose the calendars you want to include, select a date range and print a clear paper copy in Day, Week, Month or List format.
If you use Google Calendar, Exchange or other calendar accounts with the Calendar app on your device, those calendars can also be selected and printed.
PRINT YOUR REMINDERS
Cal Printer isn't just for calendars. Print your Apple Reminders and to-do lists too, giving you a convenient paper copy of your tasks.
PERFECT FOR FAMILY CALENDARS
Keep everyone organised with a printed family calendar. Print a weekly or monthly calendar for the fridge, kitchen or wall so everyone can see what's coming up at a glance.
GREAT FOR WORK, DIARIES & APPOINTMENTS
Need a physical copy of your work schedule, diary or appointments? Select the dates you need and create a clear printed record of your calendar events.
SAVE OR SHARE AS PDF
Don't have a printer nearby? Export your calendar or reminders as a PDF to save, email, share or print later.
USE THE CALENDARS YOU ALREADY HAVE
There's nothing new to set up. Cal Printer uses the calendars already available on your iPhone or iPad, so you don't need to copy your events into another calendar app.
SIMPLE CALENDAR PRINTING
• Day, Week, Month and List views
• Print calendars directly from your iPhone or iPad
• Print Reminders and to-do lists
• Choose which calendars to include
• Select the date range you want to print
• Print monthly and weekly schedules
• Print family calendars and work schedules
• Save and share as PDF
• Print using AirPrint
• No new calendar or account to set up
Whether you want to print an Apple Calendar from your iPhone, put a monthly family calendar on the fridge, print your weekly work schedule, keep a paper copy of upcoming appointments or print your Reminders, Cal Printer makes it quick and easy.

From the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli. Take a journey to a diverse world you haven’t experienced in racing games before.
Legendary Cars
Jump behind the wheel of legendary rally cars, including Das Holzwagen, The Doggo, The Bobond, and many more. We’re going 90s this time, so there’s also going to be new stuff. Das Sandsturm and Celestia just for a start!
Passionate Co-Drivers
Your co-driver can be your biggest cheerleader and toughest judge. It's a partnership that thrives on performance and emotions! Their goal is to assist your performance with helpful directions and navigation, critical to informing your next maneuver, and tips on improving your performance - sometimes delivered a little too passionately.
#DRIVE Design
Build your cars from the ground up to match your racing style and rally your way. Personalize the body, the paintwork, the decals, and then add that little cherry on top with custom decorations. 
#DRIVE Arcade Mechanics
Simple enough for beginners yet addictively challenging and demanding in its depth. It’s a handling system designed to bring back joy to racing games. 
Retro Revival
#DRIVE Rally is packed with throwbacks, nods, and Easter eggs that'll make any car enthusiast take a trip down memory lane. 
Photo Mode
Get creative and capture your greatest #DRIVE Rally moments. Adjust the angles, switch filters, go crazy. Create the perfect shot and then share it with your friends.
#DRIVE Community
Ready to dive deeper into the world of #DRIVE? Join our Discord server where every member is a co-driver.

Woohoo, it’s that time of year again when you register to run for those who can’t 
310,719 participants in 191 countries took part in the 2025 Wings for Life World Run, but we know 2026 can be even BIGGER. Enter: you.
We're a bit different to other races, we don’t use a finish line for starters. Instead, our Catcher Car chases you. Sounds fun, right? And whether you’re running or rolling (in a wheelchair), you choose your own distance. The best bit: 100% of your entry fee goes directly to the Wings for Life foundation to help fund spinal cord research. Win-win.
There's more; wherever you are, you’ll be joining tens of thousands of runners all over the world, all racing at the same time. You can take part with friends, either in real life or virtually, or go it alone. Whatever your vibe, register now directly on our app.
Actually, our app has a bunch of great features:
- Virtual Catcher Car
- Goal calculator and Preparation Run Mode
- GPS tracking
- Sharing functions for your mates
- We also speak 19 languages

bluejetty:00073062:ios.description:
Introducing our revolutionary cubic yard calculator app, the ultimate tool for homeowners, contractors, and landscapers alike. This user-friendly app is designed to make materials estimation and project planning a breeze, saving you time, money, and headaches.
Accurate Measurements:
With our cubic yard calculator app, you can say goodbye to guesswork and inaccurate estimations. Our advanced algorithms ensure precise measurements, allowing you to calculate the exact amount of materials needed for your projects. Whether you're ordering soil, gravel, concrete, or mulch, our app will provide you with the precise cubic yardage required, ensuring you don't overspend or run out of materials.
Versatility and Flexibility:
Our app caters to a wide range of projects, from small backyard landscaping to large-scale construction. It accommodates different shapes and dimensions, allowing you to calculate cubic yards for irregular areas, curved edges, and even multi-level surfaces. Simply input the measurements, and the app will handle the calculations effortlessly, giving you the confidence to plan your project accurately.
Time-Saving Features:
We understand the value of your time, which is why our cubic yard calculator app is designed to streamline the estimation process. It eliminates the need for manual calculations or complicated formulas, saving you valuable time and effort. With just a few taps on your device, you'll have accurate cubic yard measurements at your fingertips, enabling you to move forward with your projects quickly.
Easy-to-Use Interface:
Navigating our app is a breeze, thanks to its intuitive and user-friendly interface. Whether you're a seasoned contractor or a DIY enthusiast, you'll find our app simple and straightforward. Just enter the dimensions of your project area, and the app will generate the cubic yardage instantly. Clear labels and prompts guide you through the process, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free experience.
Enhanced Planning and Budgeting:
Accurate materials estimation is crucial for effective project planning and budgeting. Our cubic yard calculator app empowers you with precise measurements, enabling you to plan your purchases and allocate your resources efficiently. You'll have a clear understanding of the quantities required, allowing you to avoid overbuying or underestimating your needs. This translates to cost savings and optimized project timelines.
Regular Updates and Support:
We are committed to providing you with the best user experience possible. Our app undergoes regular updates to enhance performance, add new features, and improve accuracy. We also offer reliable customer support, ensuring that any questions or issues you may encounter are addressed promptly, so you can make the most of our app.
Download our cubic yard calculator app today and take the guesswork out of your materials estimation. Enjoy the convenience, accuracy, and efficiency that our app brings to your projects. From landscaping to construction, our app is your trusted companion for precise cubic yard calculations. Get started now and experience the power of accurate measurements at your fingertips!

bluejetty:00147381:ios.description:
Going to the doctor is now a breeze! Breeze offers a modern experience at the doctor’s office, at home, or on the go. Ideal for those of us that never want to fill out another paper form, wait endlessly to be seen by our doctor, or have no flexibility for when or how to pay for our care.

- See upcoming appointments, cancel and schedule appointments, and manage outstanding payments all from the same app
- Enjoy a seamless, easy, and modern user experience throughout (finally!)
- Use multiple and faster check-in methods including using a QR code scanned right from your phone
- No more clipboards! Fill out electronic forms that make check-in and check-out faster: simply confirm that the automatically-populated data is correct, and edit only what has changed since your last visit
- Pay without having to wait in line, in the practice, at home or on the go (Yes, even with Apple Pay)
- Store your credit cards securely so you can pay faster
- Easily create payment plans and take the pain out of healthcare payments

Crystal-Clear Scans, Every Time

 • Multi-Lens Camera Optimization – Captures details at different focal lengths for the best results.

 • Smart Formatting – The OCR function detects and restores font styles and colors on a line-by-line basis.
 • Business Card Scanner – Instantly digitize business cards, extract contact details using OCR, and save them directly to your phone's address book.
 • Edit, annotate, draw, or sign directly on scanned pages.
 • Organize pages easily—reorder, delete, or move between documents.
Seamless Document Management
 • Create folders, rename files, and protect sensitive documents with passwords.
 • Search by name or perform a full-text search within OCR-processed documents.
Export & Share with Ease
 • Support exporting searchable PDFs.
 • Fax Worldwide – Send faxes to over 100 countries, even without a fax machine.
 • Wi-Fi & iTunes File Sharing – Access PDFs instantly from your computer.
 • Multiple Export Options – Save as PDF/JPEG, print via AirPrint, or open in other apps like iBooks and Kindle.
Cloud Integration & Advanced Import/Export (Bronze/Silver/Gold Plans)
 • Upload/download from Google Drive, Dropbox, One Drive, iCloud Drive, SMB (Windows/Mac/NAS), and WebDAV.
 • Import JPEGs and PDFs from other apps or cloud storage.

《比山更高的地方》：张馨予、巩峥主演《爱在山海间》原著，援藏医疗队与扶贫干部共谱高原传奇。
《斗罗：融合洪荒，勾魂唐三入地狱》：斗罗星意志觉醒，决定回归洪荒大陆的怀抱。防止斗罗大陆生物不适应，展开天幕并随机挑选魂师提前进入洪荒世界，于是远超斗罗生命想象的世界缓缓展开。
 《我就正常上学，怎么成高武禁忌了》：江寻穿越高武世界，靠写小说同步具现荒天帝实力。在他眼里，自己就是个平平无奇的普通大学生。却不知自己早已被武道界列为不能招惹的禁忌存在！
《小人类软又横！八大兽族排队饲养》：纪筝穿越了，穿到了兽人作为星际霸主，将人类当宠物饲养的时代。好消息，她成为联邦军区第一元帅的宠物，从此吃喝不愁。坏消息，第一元帅不喜欢她，并时刻打算将她退货。
《魏庭枝》：崔含枝自幼跟随父亲读的是圣贤书，学的是与天争命。夫君一朝亡故她做了寡妇，带着儿子在周府就差被人拆干抹净，周旋三年后她毅然离府。娘家势弱，那她便寻一个更强势的！听闻北安侯年过三旬，膝下无子？没关系，生儿子，是她最不起眼的本事了。
