bluejetty:00123663:ios.description:
ADRENALINE PUMPING AERIAL COMBAT awaits you in Ace Force: Joint Combat. Fight against the forces of the Devil Region. Dodge attacks and dominate adversaries from the world's most technologically advanced aircraft. Unleash the might of your plane's arsenal on enemy jets and light up the skies with blazing explosions.
Enjoy spectacularly detailed jets and environments as you dogfight and dive bomb your way through the most explosive aerial combat game to hit mobile.
DESTROY THE ENEMY
The Devil Region has constricted the World's fuel supply and left the world defenseless. Battle to regain control of precious resource bases to upgrade your planes against enemy attacks.
PILOT DEADLY FIGHTER JETS
Wide selection of over 100 modern realistic planes, like F-22 Raptor, PAK FA T-50, Saab-JAS39, J-10 Vigorous Dragon and more. Choose your fighter to command the skies! 
CREATE THE ULTIMATE WAR MACHINE
Hundreds of customization options! Upgrade your armor, engine, missiles, cannons, and technology systems to increase your power, and max out your war machines with classified blueprints.
ADRENALINE INTENSIVE FIGHTS
Modern air combat has never felt so realistic! Enjoy explosive, HD graphics as you progress through breathtaking regions! Shred your enemies and engage in high-speed acrobatics and dizzying 1 VS 1 encounters, and 2 VS 2 competitions. Complete quick time events to barrel roll and escape enemy fire.
TEAM UP AND JOINT COMBAT FOR GLORY
You're not fight alone. Clan with friends, build your exclusive team and win team glory on the global leaderboard. Honor above all else. Lead your team win through all the league championship. 
Take to the heavens, Pilot and protect the world. Destroy the Devil Region's enemy jets and dominate the skies! Download Ace Force: Joint Combat, today.

Test your language skills in strategic monster battles. Draw ability cards f
bluejetty:00033406:ios.description:
Learn a language while gaming! Master over 3000 of the most important words and phrases in an immersive fantasy world. Crush your learning goals and your enemies!
Test your language skills in strategic monster battles. Draw ability cards from a personalized deck and answer language flashcards to play them. 
Developed by language acquisition experts, Lingo Legend contains over 200 categories of grammar, vocabulary, and common phrases to learn from. It’s the perfect app to compliment or kick-start your language learning journey. 
Gameplay
- Collect cards, choose your strategy, and build your deck
- Embark on a perilous journey, meet captivating characters, and complete quests
- Play as a customizable avatar with unique gear to collect and equip 
- Explore a beautiful, dynamic, and mysterious world
- Find recipes, gather materials, and craft gear to gain experience and style
- Customize your camp with tons of unlockable content
Supported Languages
- French
- Spanish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Mandarin Chinese
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese (Brazilian & European)
Education
- Developed by language acquisition experts passionate about keeping people engaged in learning a language
- Learn words and phrases that are relevant with content organized around useful themes like Ordering Food and Meeting New People
- Ensure long-term retention by reviewing content when needed using our spaced-repetition algorithm
- Define your learning path and practice what you want, when you want
In-Game Subscriptions
You can enjoy Lingo Legend for a limited time every day for free. Additional daily gameplay requires a subscription
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. 
Have questions? Want to connect with us?
Contact support - support@lingolegend.com
Join Discord - https://discord.gg/TzWJSfzf4R
Follow on Twitter - https://twitter.com/LingoLegend
Privacy Policy - https://www.lingolegend.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use - https://www.lingolegend.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00019611:ios:0.description:
Team up and take down the opposition in Pokémon’s first 5-on-5 strategic team battle game!
 Join Trainers from around the world as they head for Aeos Island to compete in Unite Battles! In Unite Battles, Trainers face off in 5-on-5 team battles to see who can score the most points within the allotted time. Teamwork is key as you and your teammates defeat wild Pokémon, level up, evolve your own Pokémon, and work to prevent the opposing team from scoring points. Put your teamwork to the test, and take home the win!
 Key Features:
 • BATTLE IN STYLE: Take to the field while looking your best in Holowear! Thanks to a special technology developed using Aeos energy, Trainers can deck out their Pokémon in a variety of holographic outfits—with new styles arriving regularly!
 • UNITE MOVES: Unleash the true power of your Pokémon with Unite Moves! Leverage these all-new Pokémon moves, which are only possible while in Unite Battles, and turn the tide of even the direst situations.
 • RANK UP: Looking to prove how skilled you are? Participate in ranked matches, and earn points as you climb up the global leaderboard!
 • COMMUNICATION IS KEY: Even the most-skilled Trainers recognize how important communication is to their team’s success. Leverage signals, quick-chat messages, and—for the first time in a Pokémon title—voice chat to communicate and stay in sync with your team.
 • CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY: Challenge Trainers from around the world to Unite Battles on the Nintendo Switch™ system or on a compatible mobile device thanks to cross-platform support. Trainers may use their Pokémon Trainer Club account or Nintendo Account on both Nintendo Switch and mobile to easily keep their progress synced between devices. 
 Check out the official website for more information, and follow Pokémon UNITE on X (formerly Twitter) for all the latest news.
 ------------------------------------------------------------
 Official Website: http://PokemonUNITE.com/
 Official X (formerly Twitter): https://twitter.com/PokemonUNITE/
 Terms of Use: https://www.apppokemon.com/pokemon-unite/kiyaku/kiyaku003/rule/detail/#anchor_en
 Legal:
 • This is a free-to-start game; optional in-game purchases available. Data charges may apply.
 • An internet connection is required to play the game.

Whether you’re preparing for a special event, looking for creative inspiration, or just want to have fun, Choose Filter: Perfect Match offers a seamless and exciting way to bring your ideas to life. Perfect for sharing on social media or keeping as a memory, this app ensures you’ll always find the perfect filter for every moment.

- Customization options to reflect your unique style.
- Frequent updates with new and exciting filters.
- Download now and discover how Choose Filter: Perfect Match can help you shine every day!

bluejetty:00121455:ios.description:
Two cars. One race track. And a whole arsenal of power-ups. Welcome to the dynamic racing world of the future.
The first car across the finish line wins the race – that's how racing was and that's how racing will always be. Yet with ever-faster cars and perfected racing lines, motorsport soon became too predictable. In a bid to bring fun back to the sport, ways of combat, subterfuge, and special abilities were added to the cars. A new game emerged where it's not only the fastest who wins, but the most cunning:
Enter Hyperdrome.
INTENSE 1V1 DUEL RACING
It's not just racing anymore – it's Tactical PVP Battle Racing. Hyperdrome puts a twist on the genre by removing steering controls in favor of tactical abilities.
Outsmart and outpace your opponent to win. Whether you're a rolling bastion, all about the epic counter-move, or just like to go full wipeout – we've got you covered.
Clash with players from all around the world and race your way to the top.
36 WAYS OF DOMINATING YOUR OPPONENT
Craft your own strategy by equipping the eight power-ups that best suit your playstyle. Then punish your next opponent for bringing a gun to a flamethrower fight.
Collect, unlock, and upgrade your favorites. Choose from 36 unique abilities with even more to come. You can teleport ahead, lay tactical mines, or just let your combat drones do the hard work. We won't judge. As long as you're winning.
GARAGE
Choose from a pool of cars and select the vehicle that suits your playstyle best! Fast, armored or maybe you prefer an All-rounder? You can customize each vehicle individually! Change anything from your vehicle’s components or colors all the way to designs and start the race with your personal car. Dominate your opponent and mock them with your horn! 
FINISH IN STYLE
The future looks sleek. Burn rubber on one of four stunning racetracks and marvel at the kaleidoscopic visuals of tomorrow.
Complete with a thumping soundtrack that's sure to make you raise your hands in the air – if only you didn't need them for playing!
Crushing your friends has never felt better.
The race is on.
Features:
• Tactical 1v1 PvP battles
• Worldwide matchmaking
• 36 unique power-ups
• Customize your cars
• 8 action-packed race tracks
• Spectacular, futuristic visuals
• Wicked soundtrack tailored to each level
And non-stop, nerve-wracking, breathtaking fun.

bluejetty:00042432:ios.name: Firefly Health
bluejetty:00042432:ios.summary: Get started with Firefly Primary Care and/or the Firefly Health Plan. With Firefly, you'll get your own team of primary care providers for everyday and ongoing health support. If you have a Firefly health plan for your medical insurance, yo
bluejetty:00042432:ios.description:
Get started with Firefly Primary Care and/or the Firefly Health Plan. With Firefly, you'll get your own team of primary care providers for everyday and ongoing health support. If you have a Firefly health plan for your medical insurance, you can check your coverage and claims and chat with our friendly guides to answer all your coverage and billing questions. Whether you need a quick question answered, a same-day appointment, or guidance on managing chronic conditions, we're here to help.
KEY FEATURES FOR FIREFLY PRIMARY CARE MEMBERS:
• Chat: Get fast answers to your care or coverage questions anytime.
• Video Visits: Book visits and connect face-to-face with your care team from your phone.
• Prescription Management: Refill prescriptions easily and track your medications.
• Referrals: Get guidance on finding the right Firefly Nearby location or specialists.
• Personalized Care Plans: View and track your custom care plans with your care team.
KEY FEATURES FOR FIREFLY HEALTH PLAN MEMBERS:
• Digital ID Card: Access your member ID card wherever you go.
• Claims Details: Review your claims and understand your coverage.
• Request a Care Key: Reach out for provider recommendations for lower copays and coinsurance 
• Coverage Details: View specific information about your medical and pharmacy coverage 
ABOUT FIREFLY PRIMARY CARE: 
If you enroll in Firefly Primary Care, you'll get a new PCP (and care team). We believe that many heads are better than one — so instead of one provider, we give you a physician, nurse practitioner, and health guide who all work together to help you feel your very best. Your Firefly team will be able to handle all your primary care needs, ranging from preventative care to acute concerns, managing chronic conditions, and coordinating with any specialists you may have. 
• Preventive Care: Stay healthy with screenings, wellness visits, and health coaching.
• Routine Care: Get help with colds, infections, aches, and pains.
• Chronic Condition Management: Manage asthma, diabetes, high blood pressure, and more.
• Mental Health Support: Access mental health resources with referrals from your care team.
When you need in-person primary care (for example, a physical exam or a swab), your Firefly care team will guide you to Firefly Nearby providers in your area – these may be urgent care clinics, clinics with retail stores, or even providers that come to your home.
HAVE A FIREFLY HEALTH PLAN?
You may have a Firefly health plan through your employer-sponsored health plan. With your Firefly plan, you'll get affordable, high-quality healthcare. Enroll in Firefly Primary Care, get support finding great in-network providers, view information on your coverage and claims, and chat with our member guides anytime about questions or concerns. Download the Firefly app for additional coverage details specific to your plan.
HAVE MORE QUESTIONS? 
Learn more at https://www.fireflyhealth.com/faq.
Your health information is protected by industry-leading security practices and HIPAA compliance.
Download the Firefly Health app and experience refreshingly convenient healthcare today.

bluejetty:00168767:ios.description:
“Alli360” — is a service that helps parents to set time limits for children in entertainment applications and games
The “Alli360” app complements the “Kids360 for parents” app and must be installed on the device the teen is using
This app provides you with the following options:
Time limit - set a time limit for specific applications and games your teens uses
Schedule - set schedules for school time and rest in the evening: games, social networks, and entertainment apps will not be available during the specified time
List of applications - select applications you want to limit or block completely
Time spent - see how much time your teen spends on their smartphone and identify their most used applications
Always keep in touch - applications for calls, messages, taxis, and other non-entertainment applications will always be available and you will always be able to contact your school student.
The “Kids360” app is designed for family safety and parental control. Thanks to the application tracker, you will always know how much time teen is spending on their smartphone. The app cannot be installed on the cell phone without your child’s knowledge, its use is available only with the explicit consent. Personal data is stored in strict accordance with legislation and GDPR policies.
How to start using the "Kids360" app:
1. Install the “Kids360 for parents” app on your mobile device;
2. Install the “Alli360” app on your teen's phone and enter the link code with the parental device;
3. Allow monitoring of your teenager's smartphone in the app. 
In case of technical problems, you can always contact the 24-hour support service in the app or via the following email support@kids360.app
You can monitor your time on the smartphone for free after connecting second device. Time management functions in applications are available during the trial period and by purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00151985:ios.description:
Styku – Your Fitness in 3D
Discover a revolutionary way to approach your fitness and wellness with Styku’s patented, non-invasive 3D body scanning technology. With the Styku mobile app, your results come to life dynamically on your own device—no more static PDF reports.
How It Works
With thousands of locations equipped with Styku scanners, finding a place to perform your scan is simple. During your 3D whole-body scan, you stand on the turntable as it spins. A high-resolution camera takes thousands of snapshots of your body—just as safe as taking a picture with your phone. In under a minute, your scan is complete. Within minutes, your results are processed and delivered securely to the Styku app, where you can explore your body in 3D and track your progress.
Features & Benefits
Visualize Your Body Shape in 3D: View and interact with your 3D scans. Explore your body shape in full 360°—capturing the details that the scale can’t. 
Wellness & Shape Insights: Personalized insights from your body shape and composition help you build awareness and health literacy as well as make informed decisions to support your overall health and wellness.
Track What Matters Most: Go beyond the scale. Track key body metrics like fat %, lean mass, and waist size, plus regional changes that reveal how your body is truly transforming.
Compare Your Scans. See the Difference: Instantly compare two moments in your fitness journey. Side-by-side 3D visuals highlight how and where your body is changing—making your progress visible and motivating.
Disclaimer
Styku Scanner & Application
The Styku scanner and mobile application are designed for general fitness and wellness purposes. The Styku scanner is a 3D body scanner and is not a medical device. The mobile application simply displays results from the 3D body scan.
The mobile application is intended for informational and educational purposes only and does not diagnose, treat, cure, monitor, or prevent any medical condition or illness.
The use of this application is not a substitute for consultation with a physician, who is the only person qualified to establish a diagnosis and recommend treatment. The application does not constitute medical advice, a diagnosis, or a therapeutic recommendation.
If you have any health concerns, consult a licensed healthcare provider. Do not make changes to your medications, exercise, diet, or other health routines without first consulting your doctor.
Terms of Use
By using our application, you agree to the Terms of Use (EULA).
Link: https://www.styku.com/eula

bluejetty:00022076:ios.description:
Download the “vel’OH! officiel” app and access nearly 1,000 shared bikes and 97 docking stations. Use our bike-sharing system to explore like never before!
Bike-sharing has never been so easy
Open the app and activate your location services to find the closest docking station with available bikes.
When you arrive close to the station, press “Unlock a vel’OH!” and choose your vel’OH! from the list of available bikes there. 
At the end of your ride, a notification will be sent to your mobile confirming the safe return of the bike to a docking station and you will be able to share your experience with a community of active users. 
Flexible options: annual, daily or three-day rentals
The “vel’OH! officiel” app can be tailored to your needs: just select the option that is best suited to your lifestyle. The first thirty minutes of every ride are free. Bank card payments are secure.
Access the service as a group 
You can borrow up to five bikes at the same time with the “vel’OH! officiel” app. Spread the word! Whether you have an annual pass or not, you can purchase up to five additional short-term passes in just one click.
Collect points
Use the app to actively contribute to the good operation and improvement of the service by giving feedback on your bike at the end of each ride, or by flagging a defect to the technical service. 
Latest news about vel’OH!
Stay abreast of the most recent vel’OH! service developments: novelties, temporary station closures, tips... everything you need to know for an even more user-friendly and fun experience! 
Telephone support
Access the history of your rides and passes, and contact our support team easily – by phone (in English and French) or via the app.

bluejetty:00094331:ios.description:
Join Mia and Elara on a vacation of their lifetimes! 
The once beautiful and prosperous Mediterranean island has declined with the arrival of a mysterious corporation. Now it's up to the two best friends to uncover mysteries and bring the island back to its glory. 
Key Features:
Merge Items:
Create a vibrant world by combining items to craft new, exciting objects. Discover endless combinations as you help rebuild the Cozy Coast B&B and assist your friends on the island.
Explore the Island:
Venture across breathtaking Mediterranean landscapes using your exploration energy. Each area brims with unique challenges and rewards, all wrapped in stunning visuals that transport you to another world.
Revive the B&B and Beyond:
Restore the Cozy Coast B&B and the rest of the island! Each site holds its own story, inviting you to aid friendly islanders in rejuvenating their treasured home.
Uncover Hidden Mysteries:
Clear the fog to reveal new areas, chasing clues about the secretive plans of a mysterious corporation. Every discovery moves you closer to unveiling the truth and protecting the island’s future.
Follow an Inspiring Story:
Will Mia restore her childhood paradise, or will the mysterious corporation take over? Follow along as Mia and Elara put their friendship to the test in this captivating adventure weaving themes of friendship, love, and courage.
Team Up with Friends:
Mia and Elara are the dynamic duo for this grand mission. Together, they’ll face trials, unearth secrets, and fight for the island’s past and future.
Pack your bags and dive into the magical world of Cozy Coast. Your help is crucial—the island is counting on you!

bluejetty:00158266:ios.description:
Join the community that makes college prep, search, discovery, and application easier! Whether you are a high school student currently on the college search journey, a parent/guardian looking for ways to support your student, or a school counselor guiding your students toward their futures, Scoir can help you feel empowered to identify your talents, find your college fit, and apply with confidence—all for free.
FIND YOUR FIT:
- Take the Find Your College Match Quiz and discover colleges based on your preferences
- Explore dynamic College Pages to learn more about colleges you’re interested in
- For parents/guardians: Calculate estimated costs and compare college prices
BUILD YOUR LIST:
- Follow colleges you like and organize your My Colleges list on the go
- View suggestions from supporters like counselors or parents/guardians
COLLABORATE WITH YOUR SUPPORTERS:
- Receive messages from colleges and supporters (like counselors and parents/guardians)
- Take surveys to share insights with supporters
- For parents/guardians: Calculate the cost of college, suggest colleges to your student, view their lists, and more!
APPLY WITH CONFIDENCE:
- Apply to 140+ Coalition member colleges
- Make progress on multiple applications at once
SUPPORT YOUR STUDENTS (FOR COUNSELORS):
- View your student roster and individual student profiles
- Send direct messages to students, parents, and admissions officers
- Send group messages to keep everyone in the loop
- Receive push notifications for real-time communication

listings.name: Scoir
listings.description:
Join the community that makes college prep, search, discovery, and application easier! Whether you are a high school student currently on the college search journey, a parent/guardian looking for ways to support your student, or a school counselor guiding your students toward their futures, Scoir can help you feel empowered to identify your talents, find your college fit, and apply with confidence—all for free.

FIND YOUR FIT:
- Take the Find Your College Match Quiz and discover colleges based on your preferences
- Explore dynamic College Pages to learn more about colleges you’re interested in
- For parents/guardians: Calculate estimated costs and compare college prices

BUILD YOUR LIST:
- Follow colleges you like and organize your My Colleges list on the go
- View suggestions from supporters like counselors or parents/guardians

COLLABORATE WITH YOUR SUPPORTERS:
- Receive messages from colleges and supporters (like counselors and parents/guardians)
- Take surveys to share insights with supporters
- For parents/guardians: Calculate the cost of college, suggest colleges to your student, view their lists, and more!

APPLY WITH CONFIDENCE:
- Apply to 140+ Coalition member colleges
- Make progress on multiple applications at once

SUPPORT YOUR STUDENTS (FOR COUNSELORS):
- View your student roster and individual student profiles
- Send direct messages to students, parents, and admissions officers
- Send group messages to keep everyone in the loop
- Receive push notifications for real-time communication

Keep up with Scoir by following us on:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scoirinc/?hl=en
Podcast: https://insidecollegeadmissions.buzzsprout.com/1384537
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ScoirInc

Need support? https://scoir.helpdocs.io/

bluejetty:00179725:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00179725:ios.description:
Prepare for your Canadian Citizenship Test with confidence! Our app is your complete study companion — the only bilingual citizenship test prep app with built-in translation in 15 languages, including French.
Fully updated for 2026, with 750+ practice questions based on the official "Discover Canada: The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship" handbook.
WHAT'S INSIDE
- 750+ practice questions covering all 10 official Discover Canada categories
- Flashcard mode with flip animation and Text-to-Speech audio
- Detailed explanations for every single question
- Full study guide with 12+ chapters from the official handbook
- Smart progress tracking with accuracy rates and statistics
- Weak area analysis — know exactly where to focus
- Built-in translation in 15 languages including French, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, and more
- Vocabulary builder for key Canadian terms (Reading + Writing drills)
- Dark mode for comfortable late-night studying
- Save, flag, and bookmark questions for later review
STUDY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Canada is a bilingual nation, and our app reflects that. Translate any question, answer, and explanation into 15 languages — all processed on-device for instant results. Perfect for newcomers preparing for the citizenship test.
Supported languages: French, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, and English.
OFFICIAL TEST FORMAT
The Canadian Citizenship Test consists of 20 multiple-choice questions. You need at least 75% (15 out of 20 correct answers) to pass within 30 minutes. Our practice tests mirror the exact official format so you know what to expect on test day.
STUDY BY CATEGORY
Practice questions organized into the 10 official Discover Canada categories:
1. Rights and Responsibilities
2. Who We Are
3. Canada's History
4. Modern Canada
5. How Canadians Govern Themselves
6. Federal Elections
7. Justice System
8. Canadian Symbols
9. Economy
10. Regions of Canada
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
See your scores improve over time with detailed statistics. Our weak area analysis pinpoints which categories need more attention, so you spend your study time wisely — not guessing where to focus.
COMPLETE STUDY GUIDE
Access the full study material based on "Discover Canada" — the official resource for the Canadian Citizenship Test. Covers everything from Canadian history and government structure to rights, symbols, the economy, and all 13 provinces and territories.
FLASHCARDS WITH AUDIO
Flip through questions in flashcard mode with Text-to-Speech audio support. Listen to questions and answers while commuting, exercising, or relaxing — study without even looking at your screen.
VOCABULARY BUILDER
Master key Canadian terms with dedicated vocabulary practice:
- Reading mode: 63 essential words across 7 categories
- Writing mode: Hear a word, type it, and check your spelling
STUDY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
All content is available offline. Study on the bus, during lunch breaks, or whenever you have a few minutes. No internet connection required.
Download now and take the first step towards becoming a Canadian citizen!
DISCLAIMER
This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) or the Government of Canada. All content is based on publicly available study materials, including "Discover Canada: The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship." This app is intended as a study aid only and does not guarantee success on the Canadian Citizenship Test. Official test content and requirements may change — always refer to the IRCC website (canada.ca) for the most current information.

bluejetty:00137924:ios.summary:
1,200+ studio-quality classes for the bike, treadmill, elliptical, rower or Max Trainer® you already own — plus strength, yoga, Pilates, core, meditation and mobility.
No proprietary hardware. No membership locked to one brand of machine.
bluejetty:00137924:ios.description:
1,200+ studio-quality classes for the bike, treadmill, elliptical, rower or Max Trainer® you already own — plus strength, yoga, Pilates, core, meditation and mobility.
No proprietary hardware. No membership locked to one brand of machine. Fitscope works with the equipment in your home and the equipment at your gym, and every class is filmed with real trainers at our Los Angeles studio.
▶ WORKS WITH THE GEAR YOU OWN
Indoor bikes · treadmills · ellipticals · rowers · Max Trainer® · vertical climbers · recumbent, upright and air bikes · functional trainers · dumbbells · kettlebells · mat
▶ LIVE METRICS ON SCREEN
Pair over FTMS Bluetooth® and watch RPM, watts, pace, resistance, distance and calories as you go. Compatible with Horizon®, Bodycraft®, Concept2®, Merach®, Xterra®, Yosuda®, Yesoul® and more.
▶ COACHED, NOT JUST STREAMED
Los Angeles trainers call your pace, incline and resistance in real time across HIIT, rhythm, endurance, hills and low-impact formats.
▶ EVERY LEVEL, EVERY BODY
Beginner to advanced, plus prenatal and active-aging classes. Knee-friendly low-impact options for cycling, elliptical, recumbent, power walking, rowing, yoga, Pilates and strength training.
▶ OFF THE MACHINE TOO
Strength with dumbbells, kettlebells, slam balls, resistance bands and exercise balls — or nothing at all. Yoga, mat Pilates, core, mobility, meditation and pre- and post-workout stretching.
▶ APPLE WATCH
Track heart rate, duration and calories. Start and pause classes from your wrist and save every workout to the Health app.
▶ YOUR MUSIC
Play from Spotify or Apple Music, pick a Fitscope playlist curated for the class, or train with no music at all.
▶ AT HOME, AT THE GYM, OFFLINE
Stream to iPhone, iPad and laptop, or download classes and train anywhere without a signal.
▶ BUILD A ROUTINE THAT STICKS
Schedule classes on your calendar, save favorites, and follow structured multi-week programs.
FREE AND PRO
Start free with a limited selection. Pro unlocks the full 1,200+ class library on all your devices.
Subscription options:
• Monthly — $14.99
• Quarterly — $29.99
• Annual — $99.99
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. If a free trial is offered, the subscription renews automatically at the standard rate unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.fitscope.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.fitscope.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00086791:ios.description:
Female-led, non-profit, privacy-focused menstrual cycle app.
Read Your Body (RYB) is highly customisable for understanding your unique patterns.
Loved and trusted by users worldwide. 100% community-driven and user-funded. 
Try free for 30 days then it’s a small monthly / annual payment.
PRIVACY FIRST
By default all charting data is stored only on your device to care for your privacy. Use the app without ever entering your name or email address if you wish! 
Export or delete your charting data at any time. Register for an optional account for encrypted data backups & educational emails. 
PERIOD TRACKING
*Period tracking mode with unlimited symptoms & lifestyle tracking including exercise, mood, stress, ovulation pain, cramps, self-care
*Create your own custom tracking items to track what matters most for you
*Upload daily notes, journal entries & photos
*Enjoy dark mode & moon phases
*Import your cycle data from other apps including Flo & Clue
*Review your cycle trends including cycle length variation over time
*Grow your menstrual cycle knowledge with our science-based content including menstrual cycle phases, hormones & top tips for cyclical living
FERTILITY CHARTING
*Customisable cervical fluid categories, sensation & cervix tracking
*Basal body temperature (BBT), Tempdrop integration
*Hormone tests (LH, progesterone, pregnancy, Clearblue monitor)
*Mark all of your own interpretations including peak day, temperature rise, coverline & fertile days
*Import your cycle data from other apps including Natural Cycles, Kindara & Fertility Friend
*Review your cycle stats including cycle length, peak day & luteal phase length variation over time
*Choose a settings template that perfectly matches your chosen natural family planning (NFP) / fertility awareness-based method (FABM)
*Approved by institutes including SymptoPro, FEMM, Justisse, Marquette Method Professionals Association
*Export your charts as images to share with your fertility awareness educator
IRREGULAR CYCLES
PCOS
PERIMENOPAUSE
*No predictions or algorithms makes Read Your Body ideal for use with irregular menstrual cycles
*Set up custom tracking items for symptoms, medication, self-care
*Export your charts as images to share with your healthcare provider
PREGNANCY
POSTPARTUM
*Track pregnancy progress based on presumed ovulation day rather than last menstrual period for a more accurate estimated due date
*Set up custom tracking items for pregnancy symptoms, breastfeeding, weaning
SUPPORT
Friendly, responsive support provided by our female-led team. 
Connect with us through the app: Menu > Support > Contact us
Or via email: hello@readyourbody.com
Whether you’re tracking your periods & symptoms, looking to understand your hormones or support your wellbeing, coming off hormonal birth control, trying to avoid pregnancy or conceive, pregnant or postpartum, moving through perimenopause - we’re here for you!
YOUR DATA IN YOUR HANDS
Note: Read Your Body is a data recording tool. It is not a contraceptive device or a medical device. It puts full responsibility for all tracking goals & outcomes in your hands. 
https://readyourbody.com/privacy-terms/

listings.description:
Female-led, non-profit, privacy-focused menstrual cycle app.

Read Your Body (RYB) is highly customisable for understanding your unique patterns.

Loved and trusted by users worldwide. 100% community-driven and user-funded. 

Try free for 30 days then it’s a small monthly / annual payment.

PRIVACY FIRST

By default all charting data is stored only on your device to care for your privacy. Use the app without ever entering your name or email address if you wish! 

Export or delete your charting data at any time. Register for an optional account for encrypted data backups & educational emails. 

PERIOD TRACKING

*Period tracking mode with unlimited symptoms & lifestyle tracking including exercise, mood, stress, ovulation pain, cramps, self-care
*Create your own custom tracking items to track what matters most for you
*Upload daily notes, journal entries & photos
*Enjoy dark mode & moon phases

*Import your cycle data from other apps including Flo & Clue
*Review your cycle trends including cycle length variation over time
*Grow your menstrual cycle knowledge with our science-based content including menstrual cycle phases, hormones & top tips for cyclical living

FERTILITY CHARTING

*Customisable cervical fluid categories, sensation & cervix tracking
*Basal body temperature (BBT), Tempdrop integration
*Hormone tests (LH, progesterone, pregnancy, Clearblue monitor)

*Mark all of your own interpretations including peak day, temperature rise, coverline & fertile days
*Import your cycle data from other apps including Natural Cycles, Kindara & Fertility Friend
*Review your cycle stats including cycle length, peak day & luteal phase length variation over time

*Choose a settings template that perfectly matches your chosen natural family planning (NFP) / fertility awareness-based method (FABM)
*Approved by institutes including SymptoPro, FEMM, Justisse, Marquette Method Professionals Association
*Export your charts as images to share with your fertility awareness educator

IRREGULAR CYCLES
PCOS
PERIMENOPAUSE

*No predictions or algorithms makes Read Your Body ideal for use with irregular menstrual cycles
*Set up custom tracking items for symptoms, medication, self-care
*Export your charts as images to share with your healthcare provider

PREGNANCY
POSTPARTUM

*Track pregnancy progress based on presumed ovulation day rather than last menstrual period for a more accurate estimated due date
*Set up custom tracking items for pregnancy symptoms, breastfeeding, weaning

SUPPORT

Friendly, responsive support provided by our female-led team. 
Connect with us through the app: Menu > Support > Contact us
Or via email: hello@readyourbody.com

Whether you’re tracking your periods & symptoms, looking to understand your hormones or support your wellbeing, coming off hormonal birth control, trying to avoid pregnancy or conceive, pregnant or postpartum, moving through perimenopause - we’re here for you!

YOUR DATA IN YOUR HANDS

Note: Read Your Body is a data recording tool. It is not a contraceptive device or a medical device. It puts full responsibility for all tracking goals & outcomes in your hands. 

https://readyourbody.com/privacy-terms/

• 6 Tanpu
bluejetty:00186986:ios.description:
iShala is an Indian music mobile app that provides flawless accompaniment for classical music practice, be it vocal, instrumental or rhythmic. It comes in 2 Editions: Standard and Pro (previously known as Premium). 
It features:
• 6 Tanpuras (10 on Pro Edition)
• 2 Tablas (3 on Pro Edition)
• a Swarmandal
• a Vibraphone (Pro Edition only)
• a Harmonium
• 3 Manjeeras (6 on Pro Edition)
all fully customisable in practice sessions that can then be loaded on demand. It effectively replaces a tabla machine, a lehra player and an electronic tanpura. It is therefore an ideal tool for anyone practicing Indian classical music, or just wishing to jam along virtual Indian musicians on any other musical style.
iShala includes over 60 rhythmic cycles, melodies in more than 110 ragas and 7 different tempos. You can also create your own ragas and fine-tune each of their notes at micro-tones (or shrutis) level. Possible combinations are thus nothing short of endless!
iShala initially comes in Standard Edition, but you can upgrade it to Pro Edition through an In-App purchase option. These are one-time payments; whatever the edition you choose, you can use the app forever.
Standard Edition has all the features you need for your riyaaz, and more. But Pro Edition adds some really exciting functionality like:
• pitch correction: iShala detects the note you are currently singing, along with a coloured meter highlighting whether you are right on pitch or not. This is a precious tool to improve your accuracy.
• additional instruments: 4 tanpuras, a low pitch tabla, a vibraphone and 3 manjeeras
• manual playing of all instruments: tabla, harmonium, tanpura, swarmandal, vibraphone and manjeera
• NEW: plug a MIDI keyboard (USB/Bluetooth) and play any of these instruments through it!
• record your own loops
• record your practice session: adjust mic/music level, then press REC, sing, press STOP and the audio recording file will be generated for you to listen and share
• pull items from the Cloud: download rhythmic and/or melodic cycles posted from SwarShala users directly on your device
For more detailed info on features per edition, check the following topic: https://www.swarclassical.com/guides/ishala/topic.php?product=is&id=18
----

Even when I had queries and when I was in need of assistance, they replied through Email and helped me within 10 minutes. App is wonderful which I am using for my music practice, it's helping me a lot. If u are a true music learner, I would recommend this. Thanks a lot to the team members and developers of this IShala app."
"Excellent app. Best for riyaz. Fine sounds. Perfectly tuned instruments."

bluejetty:00082433:ios.description:
All your favorite social media recipes in one place!
Import recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and any website. Inspo uses AI to instantly extract ingredients, step-by-step instructions, nutrition facts, and more from any recipe link. Inspo makes cooking effortless — from saving to shopping to serving.
SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Safari with one tap using the Share Sheet
• Import recipes from photos, camera, or by pasting text
• Generate brand new recipes with AI — just describe what you want to cook
• Paste any recipe URL or add your own manually
COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
• Follow recipes step-by-step in Cook Mode — swipe through instructions hands-free
• Scale ingredients up or down for any serving size
• Convert between metric and imperial units
• View calories, protein, carbs, and fat with a visual macro breakdown
ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
• Create folders to organize recipes by cuisine, meal type, or however you like
• Search recipes by name, ingredient, or keyword
• Bulk organize unorganized recipes in seconds
MEAL PLANNING
• Plan your meals for the week with a weekly calendar view
• Add recipes to any day — breakfast, lunch, or dinner
• Browse by folder or search when building your plan
SMART GROCERY LISTS
• Auto-generate grocery lists from your recipes
• Adjust serving sizes and pick which ingredients you need
• Duplicate ingredients are automatically merged
INSPO PREMIUM
Inspo includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features. Upgrade to Inspo Premium to unlock:
• Unlimited recipe saves
• AI recipe generation
• Photo and camera recipe import
• Nutrition information for every recipe
Inspo offers an optional auto-renewing subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple/Google account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your account settings.

bluejetty:00178193:ios.description:
Welcome to the mansion!
Play through a fun story filled with cute characters, creating stylish, unique rooms!
◆ Story
You're unexpectedly approached by a mysterious cat-like figure called Meowlin, who asks about your worries and then declares you would definitely benefit from spending time in his (her?) Mystic Mansion.
You are shown to a strange, dilapidated building. Waiting for you there is the mansion's manager, Purrcy, with his disarmingly adorable kitten looks.
"Your job is to clean up the mansion. Make it beautiful again. If you don't fix up every room, you can't go back alive. Think you can make it back with your life? I'm looking forward to your results. Hehehe."
You have no clue what's going, but your work sure is cut out for you! Unravel the mystery of the ruined mansion as you meet a cast of cute oddball characters and help them get their rooms back in shape!
◆ Puzzles
Move colorful pieces around to match three or more! It's a deceptively simple but satisfyingly challenging tile-matching puzzle game.
◆ How to Advance in the Game
Complete puzzles to earn Stars which you expend on various tasks, such as cleaning rooms, getting new furniture, and talking to characters. Each type of furniture or decoration comes with options for you to select from to create your own unique rooms.
- Kill time playing a free game!
- Solve challenging puzzles!
- Enjoy a story with a manga/anime vibe!
- Feast your eyes on adorable characters and rooms!
- De-stress with all this cuteness!
- Perfect for cat lovers!
- Get to the bottom of the mansion's mystery!
- Design awesome interiors!
- Satisfy your DIY urges!
- Renovate the mansion to make Meowlin proud!
- Meet lovable animal-themed characters!

bluejetty:00029904:ios.summary:
Today Weather brings detailed forecasts, powerful radar and beautiful widgets together in one easy-to-use app. Choose your preferred weather provider and make your weather experience your own.
WEATHER YOUR WAY
- Choose from trusted weather
bluejetty:00029904:ios.description:
Today Weather brings detailed forecasts, powerful radar and beautiful widgets together in one easy-to-use app. Choose your preferred weather provider and make your weather experience your own.
WEATHER YOUR WAY
- Choose from trusted weather providers, including Apple Weather, AccuWeather, National Weather Service (NOAA), Weather.gc.ca, OpenWeather, YR.no, UK Met Office, Météo-France and more.
- Plan ahead with hourly and daily forecasts, precipitation probability and precipitation amounts.
- Explore temperature, humidity, visibility, dew point, pressure, wind speed and direction.
- Check air quality, UV index, pollen levels, sunrise, sunset and moon phases.
RADAR AND WEATHER MAPS
- Follow precipitation with animated radar.
- Explore weather layers for temperature, wind, clouds, humidity, pressure, UV index and air quality.
- Track storm paths and view available storm information.
- Choose your preferred layers and arrange them your way.
BEAUTIFUL, CUSTOMIZABLE WIDGETS
- Bring forecasts and radar to your Home Screen.
- Choose from multiple layouts, colors, weather gradients and photo backgrounds.
- Personalize weather details and alert indicators on supported widgets.
- Keep weather information close with Lock Screen widgets.
WEATHER ALERTS
- Stay informed with severe weather alerts and advisories.
- Receive rain and snow notifications.
- Set up daily forecast notifications.
REAL WEATHER PHOTOS
- Share weather photos wherever you go.
- Discover photos matched to location, time and weather conditions.
- Explore weather through photos shared by people around the world.
READY FOR YOUR DEVICES
- Ready for iPhone Duo with an adaptive layout.
- Optimized for iPad with a spacious layout.
- Apple Watch support with complications for quick weather checks.
Feature availability varies by location, weather provider and device. Some features require Premium.
PREMIUM
- Remove ads.
- Unlock premium radar features.
- Access all weather icon sets.
SUBSCRIPTION
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Manage subscriptions in Account Settings.
Privacy policy: https://todayweather.co/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://todayweather.co/termofuse.html

bluejetty:00038651:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00038651:ios.description:
The next generation of photo books and stationery has arrived.
Put your precious memories down on paper and cherish them for a lifetime thanks to the Rosemood app. Create photo books, photo prints, photo calendars, greeting cards and invitations directly from your mobile phone. Our team in our French atelier go above and beyond to make sure your creations are as unforgettable as the moments they are designed to celebrate.
LA CREME-DE-LA-CREME OF PHOTO BOOKS
Our designers have created a collection of photo books you won’t find anywhere else. Our range of modern and elegant designs will help you record and share the moments that matter most. With their hot foil stamping or debossed photo covers and sewn binding, our fabric hardcover photo books are perfect for immortalising your wedding day or adventures. Our soft and hardcover photo books are available in a variety of colours, sizes and formats.
DECORATIVE PHOTO PRINTS
With 6 different formats and a range of templates, you are sure to find the perfect photo prints for your space. With traditional photo enlargements as well as retro, traditional, and elegant photo collage prints, you can turn your photos and captions into decorations for any album, frame or wall. We offer two premium photo papers (satin or matte) and offer double-thickness photo prints that stand up against a wall, shelf or object.
PHOTO CALENDARS
Relive your precious memories all year round with our personalised photo calendars. Whether you are looking to mount a family calendar on your wall or add a bit of organisation to your desk, our stunning and practical photo calendars are available in 3 formats designed to help you manage your busy schedule in style. 
CHRISTMAS CARDS
Send your loved ones warm wishes this year with our personalised Christmas cards. With a selection ranging from traditional to modern cards, our Christmas cards are available in a variety of formats and colours crafted to help you spread joy. Whether you opt to include a festive photo or simply a heartfelt message, your season’s greetings are bound to be one of a kind.
UNIQUE CARDS & INVITATIONS
Whatever the occasion or milestone, our collection of elegant cards and invitations helps you celebrate in style. Our range of christening and birthday invitations, baby thank you cards and Christmas cards can be personalised in minutes. Discover our range of formats, including our unique bookmark cards and invites.
Our range of modern wedding stationery is also at your fingertips with our app. From save the date cards and invitations to menus and wine labels, you'll find everything you need to make your big day extra special.
YOUR GO-TO APP FOR PRINTING YOUR GREATEST MOMENTS
Whether you are looking to immortalise everyday moments of joy with your family, record your latest adventures or share warm wishes with your loved ones, create unique photo products and cards directly from your mobile phone. Simply choose your favourite design, upload your photos, adjust the layout, add your text and voilà, a stunning photo product for you to cherish. Want to finish personalising your creation on your computer or tablet? Connect to your account to continue editing your draft online.
THE ROSEMOOD TOUCH
Elegant designs you won't find anywhere else
Cutting-edge printing
High-quality FSC-certified paper
Top-notch customer service
Retouching services included
ABOUT ROSEMOOD
We are Rosemood, a French company specialising in personalised stationery and photo printing for all of life’s greatest moments. We take great pride in printing all of our own stationery right here in Nantes, France, where our experts ensure that your photo books, prints, notebooks, calendars, invitations and cards do justice to your favourite moments, big or small. We print your stationery and photo products using paper of the highest quality to transform your unforgettable adventures into elegant keepsakes.
We would love to hear from you at rosemood.co.uk or hello@rosemood.co.uk!

bluejetty:00088179:ios.description:
"Smart Transfer: Free Data Transfer App"
- Still using troublesome apps & old methods to transfer content? Not anymore!
Here is a best, FREE content transfer app with fastest cross-platform transfer speed. Smart Transfer App allows you to easily transfer content & manage data on the new device. Now switch phones in a carefree way to move files to another device without compromising quality & move data seamlessly. This mobile transfer app also supports different languages.
It is a fast, Free & comprehensive cross platform content transfer solution for all major smartphone platforms - supporting file transfer & data transfer over the hotspot & Wi-Fi.
- Activation Code based Transfer
This simple file transfer app connects through Activation Code for content transfer like contacts, photos, videos, music audio & many more data. So, effortlessly clone your phone & transfer data in no time. You can migrate your content between devices securely & quickly. Transfer files without losing quality of content.
- Supports Multiple Content Types
Smart Transfer app supports different content types for Cross Platform content transfer which includes:
- Contacts
- Calendar
- Photos
- Videos
- Reminders
- Music
Additionally, it guides you throughout the process of content migration in easy steps. It is a free to use and supports all major platforms!
Features of Smart Transfer
- Easy Connectivity:
Its advanced technology simply connects two devices & transfers all supported content types through the hotspot or Wi-Fi connection as per your convenience without the need of wires or cables. Transfer data even faster than Bluetooth connectivity & Share files using Activation Codes.
- Cross-Platform Capability:
This app supports Free Cross Platform data transfer. Content transferring has never been so easy! It allows you to transfer any file type without altering the original.
- Quick Data Transfer:
Smart Transfer is a fast solution to transfer all mobile data to the other device within no time. You can comfortably switch phones for contacts share, photos, videos & files transfer without the difficulty of backup content.
- Photo Gallery Storage Management
Declutter your phone gallery by removing duplicate photos, videos, and files. Smart Transfer intelligently identifies and removes duplicate, similar, and blurred media files from your phone's storage, freeing up space.
- Easily Merge & Remove Duplicate Contacts
Finding and manually deleting duplicate contacts can be tedious. Smart Transfer streamlines this process with a single tap, creating more storage space on your phone.
- No Data Limitation:
With this content transfer app, files transfer between phones is unlimited.
Payment & Subscription Terms
The subscription options provided adhere to the terms outlined in the Apple End User License Agreement (EULA).
- Yearly Premium Access
- Monthly Premium Access
- Yearly Premium Access with Free Trial
- Monthly Premium Access with Free Trial
You may cancel your Subscription at any time
Smart Transfer free trial allows unlimited access to all features for 3 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 3-day free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing an auto-renewing subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://www.smarttransferapp.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.smarttransferapp.com/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00123136:ios.name: Santander Business Banking
bluejetty:00123136:ios.summary: Now you can manage your money anywhere, anytime with the Santander Business Banking app. It’s fast, simple, and convenient. You can use the app to check real-time balances, make transfers between your accounts, pay bills, and deposit checks
bluejetty:00123136:ios.description:
Now you can manage your money anywhere, anytime with the Santander Business Banking app. It’s fast, simple, and convenient. You can use the app to check real-time balances, make transfers between your accounts, pay bills, and deposit checks. 
The app is free to Santander Bank customers in the United States with a Business Online & Mobile Banking account.
Business banking is better than ever with these enhanced app features:
Account Management
• Log in to the app using your Online Organization ID, User ID, and Password.
• Forgot your Password? No problem: Reset with the app.
• Check real-time balances without logging in with the Quick Balance feature.
• Make transfers between your business and personal accounts. Restrictions apply. Please see the Digital Banking Agreement for Business Online and Mobile Banking for details.
• View recent activity on your business accounts and monthly statements.
• Manage Paperless settings and modify payees.
Stay Secure
• With Touch ID® or Face ID®, log in with just your fingerprint or facial recognition. If you share your device with others, please note that any fingerprints stored on your device may be used to log in to Santander Business Mobile Banking and access your account.
Deposit Checks
• Deposit checks in a snap, with simplified check deposit flow, camera enhancements, and step-by-step instructions. Mobile deposits are subject to limits and other restrictions. Please see the Digital Banking Agreement for Business Online and Mobile Banking for details.
Pay Bills
• Schedule and authorize payments.
• Pay eBills.
Contact Us
• Contact Santander Customer Service with one-touch calling.
• Get directions to the nearest Santander branch or ATM.
To use the Business Banking app, you’ll need to enroll first by contacting Santander. Message and data rates may apply.
iPhone, iPad, Touch ID, and Face ID are registered trademarks of Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00187345:ios.description:
Soffia | Gestão de Escalas, Plantões e Rotina da Saúde
Chega de planilhas espalhadas, grupos de WhatsApp desorganizados, retrabalho e erros operacionais.
A Soffia é a parceira do plantão. A plataforma criada para simplificar a rotina da saúde e conectar tecnologia com quem faz a saúde acontecer todos os dias.
Junte-se aos +170 mil profissionais da saúde que já utilizam a Soffia no dia a dia e estão presentes em mais de 2.000 unidades de saúde em todo o Brasil.
Organize escalas, gerencie plantões, acompanhe equipes, encontre oportunidades de trabalho, tenha mais previsibilidade financeira e conecte toda a sua rotina em um só lugar.
O que você encontra na Soffia:
# Gestão de escalas e plantões sem planilhas
Crie escalas individuais e em grupo, organize plantões, centralize informações e reduza erros operacionais com mais praticidade, controle e segurança.
# Trocas de plantão organizadas e oficializadas
Menos falhas de comunicação. Mais segurança operacional. Tudo registrado, centralizado e acessível em um único lugar.
# Gestão inteligente para hospitais, cooperativas e empresas da saúde
Controle presença com biometria facial e geolocalização, acompanhe equipes em tempo real, gere relatórios e tenha mais eficiência operacional.
# Relatórios automáticos e indicadores inteligentes
Visualize horas, produtividade, valores e informações organizadas por plantonista e setor. Transforme fechamentos operacionais demorados em processos mais rápidos, seguros e eficientes.
# Vagas e oportunidades na saúde
Encontre vagas alinhadas ao seu perfil, divulgue oportunidades de trabalho e conecte profissionais e instituições de saúde em um só lugar.
# Rede profissional da saúde
Fortaleça sua carreira, mantenha seu perfil profissional atualizado, construa conexões e faça parte de uma comunidade que cresce todos os dias.
# Soffia Ads
Divulgue serviços, produtos e oportunidades dentro do ecossistema Soffia e alcance profissionais da saúde com mais precisão, segmentação e resultados.
# Soffia Financeiro
Antecipe recebíveis, organize sua vida financeira e tenha acesso a check-up financeiro, seguros, consórcios e soluções criadas para quem vive a rotina intensa dos plantões.
# Soffia Premium
Receba notificações importantes, visualize vagas com antecedência, integre seus plantões ao Google Agenda e tenha ainda mais organização, praticidade e previsibilidade na sua rotina.
# Mais controle. Menos erros. Mais eficiência.
A Soffia conecta escalas, plantões, operações, relatórios, oportunidades, financeiro e profissionais da saúde em uma única plataforma.
Seja você plantonista, gestor de escala, hospital, cooperativa ou empresa da saúde — a Soffia conecta toda a sua operação em um só lugar.
Baixe agora e crie sua conta grátis!

bluejetty:00092072:ios.description:
What is Streetspotr?
Streetspotr is the innovative app that allows you to earn money doing ‘microjobs’ (fast, simple and fun jobs) using your smartphone. Simply open the app to discover where microjobs are available in your area and you are on the way to making some fast cash. Streetspotr is all about connecting businesses with people who are in the right place at the right time… with their Smartphones at the ready of course!
What kind of micro-jobs are available?
Businesses are constantly needing feedback about their product but do not always have the ability to travel throughout Europe to get the results they need. Many businesses now rely on the Streetspotr mobile workforce to bring them answers from the places where they are not! 
Using your Smartphone, you have the power to provide this feedback in a matter of clicks or snaps! A microjob may involve photographing how a certain product is displayed at your local supermarket, or perhaps checking the menu at a competitor’s restaurant or inspecting whether that holiday rental is as good as it looks on the website!
How do I get paid?
Simple. We pay you directly into your PayPal account. 
Become a part of the Streetspotr mobile workforce where putting your brain behind your smartphone can earn you some serious pocket money.
More Information?
Streetspotr.com
LIKE our Facebook page to keep updated with the latest and greatest Streetspotr news and hear what others are talking about in the Streetspotr community.
Please note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. Although Streetspotr uses advanced techniques to limit the usage of GPS to a minimum.

bluejetty:00171523:ios.description:
Watch every game live or on-demand in the American Association of Professional Baseball (AAPB), the premier MLB Partner league in the United States and Canada!
Baseball fans will enjoy the high level of play during 600 regular season games over a five-month season, along with the AAPB Postseason and All-Star games. Choose between home and away announcers in broadcasts that are streamed in HD.
The American Association of Professional Baseball was formed in 2006 and is based in the heart of America and southern Canada. The following clubs make up the 12-team league: Chicago Dogs (IL), Cleburne Railroaders (TX), Fargo-Moorhead RedHawks (ND), Gary SouthShore RailCats (IN), Kane County Cougars (IL), Kansas City Monarchs (KS), Lake Country Dockhounds (WI), Lincoln Saltdogs (NE), Milwaukee Milkmen (WI), Sioux City Explorers (IA), Sioux Falls Canaries (SD), and Winnipeg Goldeyes (MB).

bluejetty:00132057:ios.summary:

iTAK is a collaborative geospatial application to see you
bluejetty:00132057:ios.description:
**Compatible with ALL TAK ecosystem (TAK server, WinTAK, ATAK, WebTAK)**
The Team Awareness Kit (TAK) (known as the Tactical Assault Kit in the Department of Defense) application: 
iTAK is a collaborative geospatial application to see your teams’ locations, sensor information, videos, chat, and more in real-time. iTAK supports Department of Defense (DoD) and commercial sector standards for icons, sensor information, and communication. Data can be pre-loaded into iTAK or downloaded from the network (via TAK Server) when available.
iTAK capabilities include:
• Online and offline mapping (most standard formats), download the maps right in the app
• Blue force / team tracking (BFT)
• Collaborative mapping, including points, drawings, locations of interest
• Import and display of KML, KMZ, GeoPDF overlays
• Location marking, sharing, with photo tagging
• Chat, file sharing, photo sharing
• Live video streaming with the ability to share video links
• Spotted map to mark and share multiple locations across your map
• Digital pointer to rapidly mark and share items on the map with your team
• Navigation-walking/hiking, driving, also useful flying and air-ground coordination
• Center on self or other objects (e.g. another person in the network)
• Range, bearing measurement tools
• Team Emergency Beacons
• Customizable toolbar
• 3D perspective
• All data is secured and fully compatibility with the TAK ecosystem (ATAK, TAK Server, WinTAK)
• Useful for law enforcement, first responders, hunting, fishing, ornithology, wildlife site survey
System Requirements
Operating System: iOS version 17 and later.

bluejetty:00179304:ios.summary:

With real mud and water physics, a real damage system and proper truck handling this is as close as you'll get to the r
bluejetty:00179304:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to build your own mud truck? Well now you can in Trucks Off Road without getting your hands dirty!
With real mud and water physics, a real damage system and proper truck handling this is as close as you'll get to the real thing. From the developers of Monster Truck Destruction comes Trucks Off Road, the next generation of mega truck fun.
There are currently 8 mud parks to compete in with various game modes such as;
FREESTYLE - get the highest score by combining tricks and stunts
CIRCUIT RACING - Go head to head against your rivals
DRAG RACING - Knockout drag, do you have the fastest truck in a straight line?
MUD BOGGING - Can you pass through all of the gates in the quickest time?
OPEN PLAY - Non-competitive timed event to cruise around the park and show off
Over 400 unique parts to choose from to customize your truck to make it look and perform the way you want it to. Paint panels, parts and decals. Fit different fenders, hoods and panels. Upgrade to different chassis types. You can also increase power by adding cubic inches, superchargers, and turbochargers along with exhausts and other items. Don't forget traction, you'll need upgraded tires to tackle some of the huge hills. If you punish your truck too much it'll need repairing. If you feel your truck is worthy of showing the world, regardless of its condition, then upload photos of your truck to your Facebook account.
Play in Single Event mode to win gold trophies in each game mode or play in Career mode to win Championship belts. When you think you're the best check out the Leaderboards to see if you really are the best. See if you can unlock all of the 30+ achievements.
With more updates to come you can be sure that this is going to be game worth investing in as it will continue to grow and expand.
Make sure you play with your device connected to the internet to gain access to the latest content and features, and to ensure that your profile is backed up (Enable Cloud Save in the Options screen).
For technical support or feedback, support@oddgames.com.au
http://www.oddgames.com.au
https://www.facebook.com/trucksoffroad/

bluejetty:00129208:ios.description:
Stay safer online with a top-performing VPN and much more. 
Get fast and reliable VPN with advanced privacy and malware protection plus Parental Control to keep your family and your devices safer online. 
Available products after install: 
Norton VPN Standard
Protect your mobile online privacy when connected to Wi-Fi at home or while on-the-go. Norton VPN helps ensure private, fast internet access wherever you are. 
• Change Location: Seamlessly connect to your ideal location in any one of 28 countries so you can enjoy what you’re doing more securely, privately, and without interruption. 
• Auto Connect: Automatically turn on your VPN whenever you connect to a public network, so your data stays safer and more private. 
• Ad Tracker Blocking: Help block advertisers’ tracking technologies to reduce many of the targeted ads that follow you around the web. 
• No-log policy (supported by 3rd party audit): We don’t track, log, or save your browsing activities. 
• Global Servers: Our global high-speed VPN servers let you change your virtual location or you can auto-select the best region. Our servers dynamically scale with the number of users to ensure the best performance. 
• Compromised Network Detection: Choose to automatically secure your connection if you connect to suspicious Wi-Fi networks. 
• Bank-grade Encryption: Protect your privacy online.
Norton VPN Plus 
• All the features of Norton VPN Standard plus: 
• Malware Protection: Powerful protection against cyberthreats. 
Get real-time protection against malware, phishing, ransomware, and other threats whether you’re using your devices online or offline. 
• Safe SMS: Keep scams out of your text messages.
• Safe Web: Avoid scam sites and unsafe links.
• Dark web monitoring (Availability vary by country**): Be notified if we find your personal info on the dark web and take fast action to help secure your accounts and prevent it from being exploited. 
• Password Manager
• Cloud Backup (10 GB) 
Norton VPN Ultimate 
• All features as Norton VPN Plus with additional: 
• Privacy Monitor (US only): Take greater control of your privacy. 
Scan people-search websites to see if your personal info has been exposed and manually opt out from each of those websites to stay more private. 
• Parental Control: Keep your children safer online. 
Help your children develop healthy online habits by setting screen-time limits, blocking unsuitable sites, and pinpoint the location of your child’s device. (Location Supervision features are NOT available in all countries.) 
• Cloud Backup (50 GB) 
Even beyond encryption, our VPN is built using technology from Norton – a trusted leader in consumer cybersecurity. 
** Dark Web Monitoring disclaimer: § Dark Web Monitoring is not available in all countries. Monitored information varies based on country of residence or choice of plan. It defaults to monitor your email address and begins immediately. Sign in to your account to enter more information for monitoring. 
*** Norton VPN is no longer available for use within India as a result of governmental regulations requiring the logging and saving of user data, but you can still use your subscription when traveling outside of India.
Subscription Details
– You need Norton VPN subscription to use the app
– Free trial requires activation of annual subscription (see in-app product pricing)
– Cancel in App Store account settings or within your Norton VPN account before the end of the trial to avoid payment
– After a free trial, your subscription will start and renew automatically annually unless canceled
– You can manage your subscriptions and automatic renewal may be turned off by going to App Store account settings or within your Norton VPN account after purchase
– Free trial is valid for one-time use per App Store account.

bluejetty:00118968:ios.description:
The DSB app is part of your journey. Here you can find tickets, commuter cards, and traffic information.
In the DSB app, you can purchase Orange tickets, a commuter card, or use Check in, and see current traffic information and an overview of departures. You can also buy a seat reservation for your trip.
You can find cheap Orange and Orange Free tickets on a wide selection of our departures.
Check in is a new digital ticket at Rejsekort prices*, for those who need to travel here and now. Just swipe before you board, and travel as far as needed with all public transport in Zealand, Funen, and Jutland. We will check you out automatically or remind you to do so.
When you buy a ticket or check in through our app, you earn points on your journey, which can be used at 7-Eleven at the station. You just need to be logged in with your DSB Plus profile and accept our points terms. And if you check in, part of the journey must be with DSB trains.
You can purchase, renew, and refund commuter cards and have your youth card delivered in the app if it is from DSB.
If you experience any issues while using the app, you can call us at 70 13 14 15 every day from 7 AM to 8 PM.
Download the DSB app and get everything you need for your journey in one place.
*Check in with DSB’s app costs the same as a personal Rejsekort if you are an adult in the age range 26-66. As a youth aged 18 to 25 and 67+, you will receive your usual age discount.

bluejetty:00115044:ios.description:
Discover the magical world of Pinkfong x SKIDOS, where global family favorites meet award-winning learning games! For the first time, children can enjoy Pinkfong Baby Shark & Bebefinn, Pinkfong K-pop Princess Dress Up, and Pinkfong Dino World together with over 1000+ SKIDOS activities and 50+ games designed to inspire creativity, problem-solving, and confidence in kids 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10 year olds.
Baby Shark & Bebefinn
-Brush teeth with Bebefinn and Baby Shark to build healthy habits
-Make cotton candy and enjoy sweet treats in fun minigames
-Dive into creative coloring with the Shark Family
-Sharpen memory with flip cards and spot-the-character games
Perfect for fans of Baby Shark on YouTube, these activities combine fun, music, and learning in one safe space.
K-pop Princess Dress Up
-Style your own dazzling princess and transform her into a K-pop idol! This game celebrates self-expression and creativity through:
-Fashion styling, makeup, hair salon, and nail art
-Trendy K-pop looks and royal ball gowns
-Mix-and-match costumes, accessories, and jewelry
-Magical backdrops for photo shoots
-Story-based play where kids decide if it’s a royal adventure or a star-studded concert
With every combination, children explore identity, creativity, and storytelling.
Dino World
-Travel back to the Jurassic period! Pinkfong’s Dino World makes dinosaurs exciting and educational:
-Learn and master dinosaur names like T-Rex, Triceratops, Spinosaurus, and more
-Run, brush, feed, and dig with interactive dino activities
-Explore coloring games, puzzles, and card matches
-Discover fossils and prehistoric facts in a fun, hands-on way
Every roar and stomp is designed to combine curiosity with learning.
SKIDOS Learning Games
Beyond the Pinkfong adventures, your child unlocks SKIDOS’ universe of fun games & learning activities. Designed with accessibility guidelines, SKIDOS supports both neurotypical and neurodivergent children, including those with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dyscalculia, and Dysgraphia.
Academic Skill Building
-Math: From counting and addition to geometry and problem-solving, games adapt to your child’s level
-Phonics & Reading: Letters, sounds, vocabulary, and storytelling come alive through songs and interactive play
-Tracing: Guided visual and audio prompts help kids master letters, numbers, and handwriting skills
21st Century Life Skills
-Motor Skills – Tapping, swiping, and racing games build coordination
-Cognitive Development – Puzzles and STEM challenges boost problem-solving
-Language & Communication – Songs and wordplay enrich vocabulary
-Creative Imagination – Crafting, DIY, and storytelling unlock creativity
-Social-Emotional Learning – Games nurture empathy, teamwork, and self-expression
-Executive Function – Planning and decision-making in roleplay games
-Fitness Activities – Breathing, stretches, and movement keep kids active
Safe & Inclusive Environment
-COPPA & GDPR compliant
-KidSAFE & Astro-SAFE certified
-Works offline for learning on the go
-Personalized with up to 6 child profiles and detailed progress tracking
With one SKIDOS Pass, families unlock unlimited access to all games, videos, and future updates — creating a single safe learning hub for kids.
Why Parents Love SKIDOS
-Trusted by millions of families worldwide
-Designed to make screen time smarter, safer, and more meaningful
-Encourages kids to learn while having fun with characters they love
Subscription Info
We offer monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions available
Payment charged to your Apple Account after any applicable free trial
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00167086:ios.description:
Change your voice beyond recognition, shoot cool stories and record audio messages with our app!
If you want to improve your mood or amuse and surprise your friends, you just need to come up with a story and record it with a modified voice on video or audio and share the result with your friends.
You can change your voice in real time with AI while recording audio or video, enabling instant transformation into different styles or characters. App also allows adding or replacing voices with AI after recording, making content creation more flexible and efficient. 
◆CHANGE◆
Try on the voice of a robot or a baby, sing in a multi-person choir, tell the latest news on a walkie-talkie, or speak in a fictitious language with the voice of an alien or a chipmunk. These and other high-quality audio effects will help you in the flow of your creativity. You are not limited by anything!
◆USE AI◆
Go beyond presets — use AI not only to turn text into speech, but also to transform your voice while recording. Choose a famous personality or a favorite character, and let the AI recreate the voice as realistically as possible.
Give an inspiring speech, tell a joke, or recite poetry in your favorite voice. Make your friends laugh or prank them — the collection of voices is constantly growing.
◆RECORD◆
Record audio tracks and videos without limits. Share it on social networks or prank your friends in messengers with audio messages.
◆CREATE◆
Create and customize your own voices and get fancy! Save it as presets so that they are always at hand. With simple customization, everyone can figure it out.
◆LISTEN◆
Plug in headphones or speakers and listen to the modified voice in real time.
◆SURPRISE◆
Surprise the world with your pranks and funny stories!
◆HAVE FUN◆
Have fun and invite your friends to take part in creative challenges. Tell stories and shoot videos to make them laugh!
-------------------------------
