bluejetty:00092787:ios.name: HomeSense
bluejetty:00092787:ios.summary: HomeSense turns your iPhone or iPad into a command center for your automated home. HomeSense supports Caséta Wireless, Lutron RadioRA 2, Lutron RadioRA 3, Lutron HomeWorks QS, Philips Hue Personal Wireless Lighting, Sonos speakers, Honeywel
bluejetty:00092787:ios.description:
HomeSense turns your iPhone or iPad into a command center for your automated home. HomeSense supports Caséta Wireless, Lutron RadioRA 2, Lutron RadioRA 3, Lutron HomeWorks QS, Philips Hue Personal Wireless Lighting, Sonos speakers, Honeywell Lyric Thermostat and HomeKit, providing seamless integration between these systems. See the state of your connected devices, rooms, and convenient summary of your whole home with the base version, and upgrade to control lights, fans, shades, thermostats, edit schedule and more. With Notification Center widget, favorites, home and room scenes, HomeSense is flexible, convenient and easy to use.
Please note that device control and editing for scenes and schedules requires a purchase.
Common Features
- See and control lights, ceiling fans, shades, blinds and thermostats from the application.
- Home overview shows the state of every room and makes it easy to see what rooms have lights or fans on.
- Add often used controls or scenes to the Favorites. Any light, fan, shade, or even individual keypad button can be added to Favorites to appear on a separate screen. Tap to toggle, or tap and hold to open the detail view.
- Create your own home and room scenes that can combine devices from different systems.
- Turn off all lights and fans in a room with a single gesture - just choose “All Off” action on the room.
- Set up additional actions for a room to be recalled quickly from actions menu.
- Organize your home: manage rooms, rename controls and keypad buttons, hide unwanted devices.
- Today widget lets you access selected controls or scenes without launching the app.
- Change switch type - choose if switch controls an outlet, light or fan.
- Adjust device defaults - set default brightness, fade-in and fade-out time for dimmers, set default speed for fans.
- iCloud sync keeps your home configuration up-to-date on all of your devices.
Caséta Wireless Features
- View and edit Pico button programming and scheduled events.
Lutron RadioRA 2 and HomeWorks QS Features
- View and edit keypad button programming, scheduled events and thermostat schedules.
- Change schedule and energy saving (“Green”) mode.
Philips Hue Features
- View and edit scheduled events, including events relative to sunrise or sunset.
HomeKit Features
- Supported devices include outlets, switches, lights, fans, shades, blinds, thermostats, door locks, garage door openers, faucets, and sensors.
- Scheduled events support both weekly events, as well as time triggers with repeat intervals, from 5 minutes up to one month.
Sonos Features
- Play, pause, and control volume.
- Select a playlist or a station to play from your Sonos favorites.
- Group speakers to play music to more than one rooms.
Requirements
- For Caséta Wireless, Smart Bridge or Smart Bridge Pro connected to home WiFi network.
- For Lutron, professionally installed system connected to home WiFi network.
- For Philips Hue, Philips Hue lights with bridge connected to home WiFi network.
- For Lyric, Lyric Round Wi-Fi Thermostat, Lyric T5 or Lyric T6 Pro Wi-Fi Thermostat with working Internet connection.
Trademarks
Lutron, HomeWorks, RadioRA are trademarks of Lutron Electronics Co., Inc registered in the US and other countries.
Caséta, RadioRA 2, RadioRA 3, GRAFIK RA are trademarks of Lutron Electronics Co., Inc.
Lyric, Lyric Round are trademarks of Honeywell International Inc.
PHILIPS is a registered trademark of Koninklijke Philips N.V.
Sonos and Sonos product names are either trademarks or registered trademarks of Sonos, Inc.

bluejetty:00157498:ios.description:
Designed for iPhone Duo. Capture the perfect frame from any video—at full resolution and with no quality loss.
Freeze Frame turns moments from 4K, HDR, slow-motion, and everyday videos into high-quality photos. Scrub through your video, step forward or backward with frame-level precision, and save the exact moment you want.
The new adaptive iPhone Duo interface places controls along the side for comfortable, precise editing across different screen sizes and device poses. Left-handed controls and the classic bottom layout are also available.
PERFECT FRAME EXTRACTION
 • Extract full-resolution photos from videos
 • Step forward or backward one frame at a time
 • Jump multiple frames to find moments faster
 • Capture action, sports, pets, children, and slow motion
 • Batch export multiple favorite frames
PRESERVE ORIGINAL QUALITY
 • Export 4K and HDR frames at native resolution
 • Preserve available EXIF metadata
 • Retain GPS location and capture timestamps
 • Avoid screenshots, cropping, and screen-resolution limits
DESIGNED FOR IPHONE DUO
 • Adaptive side-mounted control layout
 • Comfortable right- or left-handed controls
 • Consistent tools across screen sizes and device poses
 • Optional classic bottom-toolbar layout
PRIVATE AND ON DEVICE
Your videos and extracted frames are processed locally on your device. Freeze Frame doesn’t upload your videos for processing.
COMPLETELY FREE
 • No advertisements
 • No subscriptions
 • No watermarks
 • No locked quality levels
 • No required account
Turn video into photos and preserve the moments that happen between shots. With Freeze Frame, the exact frame is always within reach.

bluejetty:00092563:ios.name: RedBox Rx
bluejetty:00092563:ios.summary: The RedBox Rx mobile app gives you personalized healthcare at your fingertips. We are a telehealth provider and online pharmacy that offers transparent, affordable pricing on prescriptions and convenient online doctor consultations on your
bluejetty:00092563:ios.description:
The RedBox Rx mobile app gives you personalized healthcare at your fingertips. We are a telehealth provider and online pharmacy that offers transparent, affordable pricing on prescriptions and convenient online doctor consultations on your schedule. 
RedBox Rx sets itself apart with a standard of care and benefits designed with your needs in mind: 
• A commitment to transparent, low prices.
• Online doctor consultations, on your schedule.
• FDA-approved, reliable prescription treatments.
• FREE same-day shipping Monday-Saturday.
• No membership fees.
• No insurance required. HSA and FSA accepted. 
CONDITIONS WE TREAT
Our experienced, licensed medical providers are passionate about serving patients through telemedicine and specialize in mental health, women's health, men's health, dermatology and primary care.
Mental Health:
• Anxiety and Depression 
• Adult ADHD
• Insomnia
Women’s Health:
• Urinary Tract Infections
• Yeast Infections
• Birth Control and Emergency Contraception
Men’s Health:
• Erectile Dysfunction
• Premature Ejaculation
Dermatology: 
• Acne and Rosacea
• Anti-Aging, Melasma and Dark Spots
• Eyelash Growth
• Hair Loss, Dandruff and Itchy Scalp
• Skin Rashes, Hives and Eczema
• Cold Sores and Shingles
• Scabies
• Excessive Sweating
Primary Care: 
• Short-Term Prescription Refills
• Allergies
• Headaches and Migraines
• GERD, Heartburn, Indigestion and Upset Stomach
• Nausea and Vomiting
• Sinus Headaches and Infections
• Pink Eye
APP FEATURES
• View current and previous consultations with RedBox Rx providers, including doctor notes, status of prescribed medications and shipment tracking. 
• For mental health consultations, our app provides a secure, seamless experience to schedule and complete your 15-minute video doctor consultation, with appointment reminders.
• Manage your current RedBox Rx prescriptions. Pay for new prescriptions, refill medications early, delay or stop automatic refills and more.
• Never miss taking your medication again – easily set up medication reminders for your RedBox Rx prescriptions. 
• Renew ongoing prescriptions by completing a follow-up doctor consultation through the RedBox Rx app. 
• Create an account and manage your account settings and profile.
• To start a consultation for a new condition, our mobile app allows you to navigate to a services page on our website where you will be able to complete your initial online assessment through the web-based portal. 
HOW REDBOX RX WORKS
1. Online consultation
Get started by selecting the condition you would like to treat. Complete a quick online assessment answering a few questions about your health history and current concerns.* Our interactive pricing tool makes it easy to see how much treatment will cost and lets you select a preferred medication.
2. Personalized treatment plan
An experienced, licensed medical provider for your state will review your assessment,* develop your personalized plan, and recommend treatment options so you can complete your prescription order.
3. Prescriptions delivered or picked up locally
Get prescriptions conveniently delivered to your door from RedBox Rx with fast, free shipping or pick up at a local pharmacy of your choice.
*For mental health conditions, you’ll also schedule a 15-minute online video consult with one of our experienced, licensed providers.
ABOUT REDBOX RX
Powered by $12 billion parent company Hy-Vee, Inc. and more than 50 years in the community pharmacy space, we understand healthcare. We fill more than 22 million prescriptions annually, have a world-class reputation for patient care, helping you with your health and wellness needs. Take control of your health and wellness today with RedBox Rx. 
DISCLAIMERS
Please make sure to seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions using the RedBox Rx app.
By downloading and using the RedBox Rx app, you agree to our terms and policies. Read more at: https://www.redboxrx.com/about/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00044737:ios.description:
Welcome to Dragon Tiger Noodle
At Dragon Tiger Noodle, your noodles, your way. Build modern Asian noodle and rice bowls inspired by flavors from across Asia, then get them fast with pickup, delivery, or catering—while earning rewards on every bite. 
Created in collaboration with Chef Jet Tila, Dragon Tiger Noodle brings bold broths, crisp wings, and customizable bowls together under one roof—and now, into one app.
Order Ahead & Pickup – Skip the line by customizing your noodle bowls, Tiger Rice Bowls, and Dragon Wings in the app, then pick up when it’s ready.
Delivery – Get your favorite ramen, wings, and bowls delivered from nearby Dragon Tiger Noodle locations.
Loyalty Rewards – Earn points on every in-app purchase and redeem them for food and other rewards as you keep ordering.
Exclusive Promotions – Unlock app-only deals, limited-time menu drops, and seasonal offers you won’t see on third-party marketplaces.
Stay Updated – Turn on push notifications to hear about new locations, chef specials, limited-time flavors, and upcoming events.
Dragon Tiger Noodle brings together curated flavors from across Asia with a “build-your-own” experience—choose your noodle, broth, protein, toppings, and spice level. Signature items include Tonkotsu ramen, Thai-inspired noodles, Tiger Rice Bowls, Dragon Wings, pork belly bao, and kimchi fried rice, alongside vegetarian and tofu options. 
Dragon Tiger Noodle
Whether you’re craving a quick solo bowl, a late-night noodle fix, or a big spread to share, the app makes it easier to customize and reorder your go-to combos in just a few taps.
Download Dragon Tiger Noodle today to customize your bowl, earn rewards, and get your favorite noodles, wings, and rice bowls for pickup, delivery, or catering.

bluejetty:00154713:ios.name: Find Bluetooth Device Finder
bluejetty:00154713:ios.summary: Lost your AirPods, headphones, or keys? Find them in seconds. Device Finder turns your phone into a powerful Bluetooth radar that locates any earbuds, speaker, smartwatch, or tracker nearby — and warns you the instant you leave a device beh
bluejetty:00154713:ios.description:
Lost your AirPods, headphones, or keys? Find them in seconds. Device Finder turns your phone into a powerful Bluetooth radar that locates any earbuds, speaker, smartwatch, or tracker nearby — and warns you the instant you leave a device behind.
==Powerful Bluetooth Scanner==
Real-time Radar: Visualize how close you are to your lost device with our responsive signal strength indicator.
Distance Estimation: See approximate distance (Near, Medium, Far) to guide your search.
 Broad Compatibility: Works with AirPods, Headphones, Earbuds, Smart Watches, Fitness Trackers, Speakers, and virtually any BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) device.
==Smart Separation Alerts==
Don't Leave It Behind: Get instant notifications on your phone if you walk away from your favorite devices.
Customizable Triggers: Set specific distance thresholds (Near, Medium, Far) for alerts.
Quiet Hours: Schedule "Do Not Disturb" times (like at night) so you only get alerted when it matters.
==Device Location History==
Last Seen Location: Automatically save the last known location of your device on a map.
History Log: View a timeline of where your device was detected, making it easier to retrace your steps.
==Item Tracker==
Track Anything: Not just for electronics! Create profiles for your Keys, Wallet, or Bag.
Photo & Notes: Add photos and notes to identify your items easily.
Map Integration: Pinpoint exactly where you left your personal items.
==Home Screen Widgets==
Quick Access: Add our sleek widgets to your home screen to check the status of your favorite devices at a glance without opening the app.
### Supported Devices
- Wireless Earbuds & Headphones (Compatible with most major brands)
- Smart Watches & Fitness Trackers
- Portable Bluetooth Speakers
- Tablets & Phones
- Bluetooth Tags & Beacons
- Any other device broadcasting a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) signal
### Disclaimer
Device Finder is an independent utility application intended to help you locate your lost connected devices. It is not affiliated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Apple Inc., or any other brand names mentioned. All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners.
=== Subscription options ===
The app is free to download, but to access premium features, a subscription is required. With the subscription, you'll enjoy uninterrupted access to our premium features. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
If you wish to cancel the automatic renewal of your subscription, you can do so at any time by accessing your iTunes account settings. However, please note that refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To ensure a successful cancellation, please make sure to turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
=== Support ===
Need a helping hand? Don't hesitate to contact us at andychung.cc@gmail.com. We're always ready to assist you!
Privacy policy: https://bluetoothscanner.andyrgb.com/privacy

bluejetty:00025969:ios.description:
Step into the dynamic world of Toribash, where strategy meets intense physics-based combat! Unleash your fighting spirit and engage in epic battles, executing precise moves with tactical finesse. With unparalleled customization and online multiplayer, Toribash offers a truly unique and immersive fighting game experience!
◦ PHYSICS-BASED COMBAT
Engage in thrilling duels that embrace the laws of physics. Plan your moves, control your fighter's limbs, and execute devastating attacks with realistic precision.
◦ REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER
Challenge fighters from all around the world! Test your skills against other players in online PvP battles and climb the ranks to become the ultimate Toribash master.
◦ TURN-BASED GAMEPLAY
Embrace the art of strategy! Each move counts, and every decision shapes the outcome of the fight. Outsmart your opponents and seize victory with cunning tactics.
◦ BECOME THE CHAMPION
Prove yourself in intense online tournaments and earn exclusive rewards. Show the world your mastery of Toribash and become a legend in the global fighting community.
◦ UNRIVALED CUSTOMIZATION
Your fighter, your rules! Dive into an extensive character customization system that lets you fine-tune every aspect of your warrior. Customize your character's appearance with colors, custom items, your own textures and more!
◦ ENDLESS VARIETY
Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping adventure with thousands of user-generated game mods. Join thrilling battles ranging from fast-paced showdowns to mind-bending puzzles, each presenting new challenges and strategic opportunities.
◦ USER-GENERATED CONTENT
Become part of a thriving community that continuously shapes the game's universe. Create and share your custom game mods, scripts and art with fellow fighters worldwide. Join clans and participate in events together. Whether it's a thrilling tournament or a deliberate parkour puzzle, your creativity knows no bounds!
Embrace the Ultimate Sandbox in Toribash and join a vibrant community of creators and fighters. Unleash your creativity, customize your character, and experience a multitude of exhilarating game mods. Download now and immerse yourself in the world of endless possibilities!

bluejetty:00047701:ios.description:
► Fork N Sausage – Are you a weiner?
Feeling hungry? Better get that sausage on your fork then. But it’s not that simple in this flippin’ crazy puzzle game that’s stuffed with action, humor, and grin-inducing fun. Fate has put a ton of obstacles in the way between that eager little sausage and your patiently expectant fork, so you’ll be swiping frantically and cursing the laws of physics as you flip, twist, bounce and slide the sausage, battling level after level of inventive and extremely funny puzzle madness to prove that you’re a real hot dog.
► Can you cut the mustard?
• Hundreds of levels of carefully designed and fiendishly tricky physics puzzles that pit you and your little sausage against the hard, sharp, appliance-filled world of the modern kitchen. bluejetty:00043855:ios.description:
The Alternative Fueling Station Locator app helps you find fueling stations that offer electricity, natural gas, biodiesel, E85, propane, or hydrogen.
Use your current location or enter a custom location to find the 20 closest stations within a 30-mile radius. View the stations on a map or see a list of stations ordered by distance from your location. Select your alternative fuel of choice and adjust the custom filters to fit your needs.
Select a station from the map or list to view contact info and other details:
- address, phone number, and hours of operation
- payment types accepted
- public or private access
- special services
- compression (natural gas)
- vehicle size access (natural gas)
- number and types of chargers (electric)
- blends available (biodiesel)
- blender pumps (ethanol)
The app draws information from the U.S. Department of Energy's Alternative Fuels Data Center, which houses the most comprehensive, up-to-date database of alternative fueling stations in the United States. The database contains location information for more than 15,000 alternative fueling stations throughout the country.

bluejetty:00138209:ios.description:
Christmas Gangster: Rope Santa is an exhilarating action gaming app that allows you to embody a powerful blue superhero with extraordinary rope abilities. Dive into a bustling open-world city filled with gangsters and intense combat as you set out to eradicate crime through engaging quests and formidable challenges.
As the iconic Rope Santa, harness your superhuman powers and wield your magical rope to traverse skyscrapers, ascend walls, and partake in thrilling battles. Your adventure takes you through a dynamic city brimming with action, quests, and countless challenges. Navigate the treacherous streets, discover hidden collectibles, and accomplish various missions to gain rewards and accolades.
The vast realm of Christmas Gangster: Rope Santa provides an expansive playground for your heroic escapades. Confront thugs, dismantle gang operations, and restore order to the city. Your rope abilities empower you to swing between buildings, offering a strategic advantage in both exploration and combat. Whether you’re scaling walls like a spider or descending upon enemies from above, your rope serves as your most valuable asset.

Boost your capabilities with a variety of vehicles available in the shop, including cars, tanks, SUVs, helicopters, and even a battle mech, providing additional firepower as you confront crime.
Elevate your superhero skills and equipment to conquer the toughest challenges and engage in battles with increasingly powerful foes. As you navigate the storyline, you'll face crime bosses, corrupt police officers, and other formidable enemies in your quest to liberate the city from the grip of crime.
Christmas Gangster: Rope Santa also boasts numerous mini-games and side missions to maintain high levels of excitement. Put your skills to the test with ATM hacking for quick cash, improve your stamina on treadmills, and showcase your prowess in the Zombie Arena. Combat waves of zombies or take on the formidable robot boss for unique rewards! Each endeavor offers exclusive loot and opportunities to level up your gear and powers, ensuring you're ready to confront the rising threats within the city.

Our vehicles are stylish and are unmarked making this a private experience for our clients.

Safety and security is our highest priority to provide our clients with added peace of mind.
Your privacy is respected and your information is confidential.

Your car will be equipped with an onboard camera system that with allow you as a parent to monitor your children’s ride.
Payment terminals will be available on board your vehicle for Credit Card or Knet transactions if you choose not to pay by cash or utilize your stored Credit Card on our App.
You will be emailed an invoice of every charged trip.

bluejetty:00083735:ios.description:
Translate the speech in your videos into clear subtitles in other languages—without typing every word.
subtitles.so automatically transcribes your video, builds synchronized captions, and gives you the tools to make every line clear, accurate, and on-brand. Choose a video from Photos or record a new one, trim the beginning and end, then let the app create your first caption track.
AUTOMATIC CAPTIONS
• Convert spoken video into timed captions
• Detect multiple speakers and organize their dialogue
• Review and correct the full transcript
PRECISE EDITING
• Edit caption text directly
• Split, join, delete, and regroup captions
• Refine timing in a visual timeline
• Keep each speaker organized in a separate track
CUSTOM STYLES
• Choose fonts, weights, alignment, colors, and position
• Add backgrounds, outlines, shadows, and active-word emphasis
• Animate caption entrances and highlighted words
• Style speakers independently and save reusable presets
TRANSLATE AND REACH MORE VIEWERS
Translate your captions into additional languages, review each translation alongside the original, and choose which language to show or export.
FLEXIBLE VIDEO EXPORT
Choose the quality that fits your needs, preview the finished result, control watermark placement, and save or share your captioned video.

bluejetty:00016972:ios.description:
Experience time in a whole new way!
Poloska transforms your iPhone into a slit-scan camera, letting you take surreal and mesmerizing pictures like never before. 
Rather than taking a single snapshot, Poloska records continuous slices of time, creating dynamic images that reveal motion, distortion, and unique visual effects.
Unleash your creativity and have fun with photography!
How it works:
- Slit-scan magic: Poloska captures hundreds of frames per second, extracting a narrow slice from each frame and merging them into one flowing image. The longer you shoot, the wider your final image will be.
- Unleash your creativity: Capture images of stretched cars, melting landscapes, or warped portraits—your imagination is the limit.
- Customizable viewport: Choose between horizontal or vertical scanning to shape your shot just the way you want.
- Pro tip: For the best results, use a tripod to stabilize your shots and unlock even more incredible effects.
Download Poloska today and start bending time with your photos!

bluejetty:00114885:ios.description:
Email Check – Fast & Secure Mailbox
Email Check App support for Hotmail & Outlook and more is a powerful email management app that helps you stay in control of your inbox—faster, simpler, and more securely. Perfectly optimized for Outlook, Hotmail, Office 365, MSN, Live Mail, and all Microsoft email services.
1. Smarter Inbox, Faster Email
Cut through the clutter and process emails at lightning speed. Our app fetches mail faster than other clients (proven by speed tests) and makes it easy to search everything you need—bills, subscriptions, travel plans, packages, and more.
2. All Your Accounts in One Place
Connect multiple accounts—Hotmail, Outlook, Office 365, MSN, and Live Mail—into one unified inbox. No more switching between apps.
3. Key Features
• Fast & Secure Login – Automatic configuration with full support for Microsoft accounts.
• Smart Search & Contact Detection – Instantly find emails, files, or contacts with advanced search tools.
• Advanced Filters – Sort emails by unread, starred, or with attachments for a clutter-free inbox.
• Custom Signatures – Create unique email signatures for each account.
• Multiple Mailbox Support – Effortlessly switch between Outlook, Hotmail, Office 365, MSN, and Live Mail.
• Easy Attachments – Send and receive images, documents, and files without hassle.
• Enhanced Security with Face ID – Protect your inbox with biometric authentication.
• Productivity Tools – Auto BCC, image compression before sending, snooze emails for later.
• Push Notifications – Get realtime alerts for new emails with optional “Do Not Disturb” mode.
4. Personalize Your Experience
Customize swipe actions, create templates, adjust color themes, or enable Focused Inbox. Make your email experience truly yours.
With Email for Hotmail & Outlook, you’ll spend less time sorting through clutter and more time focusing on what matters most.
5. Download now and enjoy the fastest, most secure way to manage your email!

◆ Email Check Privacy: https://emailcheck.live/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00163196:ios.description:
1re carte postale OFFERTE sur l'app avec le code POPCARTE
Créez en quelques minutes sur votre téléphone, on imprime en France et on envoie directement chez vos proches ou chez vous. Satisfait ou réimprimé.
Cartes postales, faire-part, albums photo, posters, magnets et cadeaux photo personnalisés : tout part de vous.
CALENDRIER DE L'AVENT PERSONNALISÉ : NOUVEAUX DESIGNS
Faites patienter vos proches jusqu'à Noël avec un calendrier de l'Avent à votre image, à découvrir dans de nouveaux designs cette année. Ajoutez vos photos et vos messages, on s'occupe du reste. Pour compléter les fêtes : carte de Noël, carte de vœux et calendrier photo 2027.
Et sous le sapin : mug photo, puzzle photo ou tablette de chocolat personnalisée, des cadeaux uniques à créer en quelques minutes.
POURQUOI CHOISIR POPCARTE
- 1re carte postale offerte avec le code POPCARTE
- Imprimé en France sur papier premium
- Impression et expédition sous 24h
- Envoi direct à vos destinataires ou chez vous
- 100 % satisfait ou réimprimé
- Personnalisation gratuite sur mobile, tablette et ordinateur
- Paiement sécurisé, service client réactif et chatbot 7j/7
- Popcarte+ : frais d'envoi offerts toute l'année
ENVOI DIRECT À VOS DESTINATAIRES
Pas besoin de timbre ni de passer à la poste : saisissez l'adresse de vos proches, on imprime et on envoie directement chez eux. Vous préférez remettre votre carte en main propre ? Faites-vous livrer à domicile.
Programmez aussi vos envois : choisissez la date, on expédie au bon moment pour que votre carte d'anniversaire ou de Noël arrive à temps.
CARTE POSTALE PERSONNALISÉE AVEC VOS PHOTOS
Envoyez une vraie carte postale depuis vos vacances, un week-end ou votre canapé. Choisissez un modèle, ajoutez une ou plusieurs photos et votre texte : on imprime et on poste votre carte sous 24h, directement chez votre destinataire.
FAIRE-PART NAISSANCE
Annoncez l'arrivée de bébé avec un faire-part naissance à son image. Photo, prénom, date, poids et taille : de nombreux modèles à personnaliser en quelques minutes depuis votre téléphone, même avec un nouveau-né dans les bras. Complétez avec une annonce grossesse, une carte de remerciement naissance ou un album photo de naissance.
FAIRE-PART MARIAGE
Du save the date au remerciement, créez toute la papeterie de votre mariage : faire-part mariage, invitation, menu, carte de remerciement. Et pour garder les mots de vos invités, le nouveau livre d'or personnalisé, assorti à votre faire-part.
CARTE ANNIVERSAIRE ET INVITATION
Carte anniversaire adulte ou enfant, invitation anniversaire : souhaitez un joyeux anniversaire avec vos photos et votre message.
ALBUM PHOTO ET LIVRE PHOTO
Créez votre album photo directement dans l'app : format carré, portrait ou paysage, choix de la couverture, du papier et du nombre de pages. Vacances, naissance, mariage, année en famille : un livre photo à garder ou à offrir.
NOUVEAU : CADEAUX PHOTO PERSONNALISÉS
- Mug photo personnalisé, pour un café avec vos souvenirs
- Puzzle photo à reconstituer en famille
- Tablette de chocolat personnalisée avec votre photo et votre message
- Livre d'or personnalisé pour un mariage, un baptême ou une fête
- Lots de magnets photo pour habiller le frigo
Et toujours : calendrier photo mural ou de bureau, poster photo et stickers photo.
PERSONNALISEZ CHAQUE DÉTAIL
Partez d'un modèle ou d'une carte blanche, ajoutez vos photos, votre texte, votre signature, des stickers ou un message manuscrit. Glissez même un petit cadeau dans l'enveloppe.
Commencez sur mobile, finalisez sur tablette ou ordinateur grâce à la synchronisation multi-écran.
DES CARTES POUR TOUTES LES OCCASIONS
Faire-part baptême, carte de remerciement, félicitations pour un diplôme ou un nouveau travail, départ à la retraite, déménagement, baby shower, pendaison de crémaillère : il y a toujours une bonne raison d'écrire.
Chez Popcarte, on croit aux petits gestes qui rapprochent. Téléchargez l'app et faites passer vos messages comme vous les ressentez.

bluejetty:00039887:ios.name: Budget: expense tracker, money
bluejetty:00039887:ios.summary:
Budget, expense tracker, money is a perfect solution for those who want to manage finances without wasting time and effort.
We created an app that you would actually want to keep using!
Forget about incomprehensible interfaces, complicated
bluejetty:00039887:ios.description:
Budget, expense tracker, money is a perfect solution for those who want to manage finances without wasting time and effort.
We created an app that you would actually want to keep using!
Forget about incomprehensible interfaces, complicated functions and endless Excel tables! With Budget, expense tracker, money app control over the budget and finances will be simple and pleasant! You will know exactly where your money goes, hence saving up and amassing money will be easier!
Budget, expense tracker, money app is:
- Ease of use
With an intuitive interface the process of adding expenses and revenue will be fast: fill in only key information with just a couple of taps, or add such further details as comments or photos of the receipt to the transaction.
- Control over recurring payments
Add recurring payments and set reminders, and the app will send you notification at the stated time. And what is more, adding a corresponding transaction will be faster than ever, it won’t require effort and will save your precious time.
- All accounts in one place
Look through all of your accounts and overall balance on one screen - all important information at a glance!
- Visual clarity
Understand your spendings and income better with informative diagrams, charts and reports. Take a closer look at your bills and transactions on one or multiple accounts for a specified time period, or select a relevant category for even more details on your financial state. Convenient sorting options and keyword search will make this process super easy. 
- Budget planning
Set limits for selected categories of expenses and make sure to stay within cost constraints. Limits feature will help you avoid unnecessary expenses and impulse purchases, save money and you will reach your financial goals faster.
- Customization
Create your own categories, add accounts and the app will only display the information you actually need, nothing in excess!
- Security
Security is important! You can lock the app with a passcode or use biometric authentication to protect the app from intruders and make sure that you are the only one who can access your financial data. 
- Multicurrency support
The app supports multiple currencies: you can add transactions in various currencies - for instance, when on vacation abroad, in case of income in a foreign currency or purchases in a different country. Built-in calculator will automatically update the exchange rate and make all necessary calculations. 
- Data safety
No need to worry about your data safety! With our data synchronization you can be sure that even when you change your mobile device nothing will be lost and your information will stay with you.
When it comes to financial management it’s regularity and system approach that really matter. We created an app that doesn’t require any special knowledge - an app that you will definitely want to use day by day! Know where your money goes! Achieve your financial goals faster! And Budget, expense tracker, money app is here to help!

bluejetty:00068532:ios.description:
With Nemours Children’s MyChart, you can get expert care anywhere. Securely access your child’s medical record, see a provider on demand, use tools to keep your child healthy, and much more.
Key Features:
- View details about upcoming visits and doctor notes from past visits. 
- Complete pre-visit tasks from the comfort of home.
- Schedule appointments.
- Have a video visit with a Nemours Children’s provider.
- Send a message to your child's care team any time.
- Get test results and view your doctor’s comments.
- Request prescription refills.
- Search Nemours KidsHealth for articles and videos about your child’s health.
- Upload health and fitness data, including data from Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs.
- Pay your bill and manage billing account information.
About Nemours Children's Health:
Nemours Children’s Health is one of the nation’s largest multistate pediatric health systems, which includes two free-standing children's hospitals and a network of more than 70 primary and specialty care practices. Nemours Children's seeks to transform the health of children by adopting a holistic health model that utilizes innovative, safe, and high-quality care, while also addressing children’s needs well beyond medicine. In producing the highly acclaimed, award-winning pediatric medicine podcast Well Beyond Medicine, Nemours underscores that commitment by featuring the people, programs and partnerships addressing whole child health. Nemours Children's also powers the world’s most-visited website for information on the health of children and teens, Nemours KidsHealth.org.
The Nemours Foundation, established through the legacy and philanthropy of Alfred I. duPont, provides pediatric clinical care, research, education, advocacy, and prevention programs to the children, families and communities it serves. For more information, visit Nemours.org.

bluejetty:00043841:ios.description:
MonPrice: The Ultimate Trading Card Scanner & Price Tracker
Unlock the full potential of your trading card collection with MonPrice — the all-in-one scanner and market tracker for card game enthusiasts! Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting out, MonPrice helps you scan, track, and value your cards effortlessly.
Key Features:
- Instant Card Scanning – Quickly scan trading cards to retrieve detailed info like name, rarity, and estimated market value.
- Real-Time Price Tracking – Stay updated with live market trends to make smarter buying, selling, and trading decisions.
- Comprehensive Card Database – Explore thousands of cards from popular games and expansions.
- Personalized Watchlist – Keep an eye on your favorite cards and get notified about price changes.
- Smart Trading Insights – Use accurate market data to build your collection strategically.
- Whether you're looking to value rare cards, organize your collection, or track market trends — MonPrice is your trusted companion.
How It Works?
MonPrice uses advanced machine learning to recognize your trading cards with high accuracy. Our custom AI model was trained on over 19,000 cards to ensure fast and precise scanning — even for rare or less common cards.
Card prices are sourced from TCGPlayer and CardMarket, updated every 24 hours to provide reliable market data for collectors and traders.
Why Collectors Choose MonPrice?
Whether you are a casual hobbyist or a dedicated collector, MonPrice helps you:
- Scan cards instantly without manual entry
- Make informed decisions using real market data
- Track price changes and trends over time
- Organize and grow your collection more efficiently
- Export scan results and collections in JSON or CSV formats for use in professional tools
- MonPrice is also compatible with high-speed scanning devices such as CardSlinger and similar hardware, enabling fast batch scanning for large collections.
Supported Games
MonPrice supports a wide range of collectible card games. If you're passionate about trading cards, you'll find MonPrice to be a powerful companion for scanning, valuing, and tracking your favorites.

bluejetty:00092277:ios.summary:
Hey YOU! The one at the back of the pack of runners. Think you’re “too overweight”, "too out of shape", “too slow”, “too ____(fill in the blank)” to run? Then the Slow AF Run Club is for you!

bluejetty:00092277:ios.description:
Hey YOU! The one at the back of the pack of runners. Think you’re “too overweight”, "too out of shape", “too slow”, “too ____(fill in the blank)” to run? Then the Slow AF Run Club is for you! 
The Slow AF Run Club (Slow AF) is an online community of slow runners led by Martinus Evans, author, running coach, award-winning speaker and, most importantly, a back of the pack marathon runner who has helped countless people build the confidence to start running in their current body so they can live their best life now! The Slow AF mission is to empower, advocate, and solve the issues that are most important to the back of the pack.
+ Slow AF is a dedicated community that supports its members, meets up at races, runs as a group, and nourishes deep, nuanced connections. 
+ Slow AF is a SAFE place to share your insecurities and struggles as well as your wins. It is a NO-DRAMA and JUDGEMENT FREE ZONE. 
+ Slow AF is not for everyone, but if you are a back of the pack runner who wants to create meaningful connections with similar runners, the Slow AF Run Club is for you!
Community is the most important thing about running!
While shoes, gear, form, and training plans are important, the community saves us from the isolation and alienation that can come with running in the back of the pack. Slow AF is a place for us to call home. It’s a place we can meet to share knowledge, make connections, find inspiration, discover resources, and get support.
Are you tired of being an afterthought? 
Have you ever joined a running club that advertises to all paces and speeds only to feel unwelcome? You get there and everyone looks at you like you’re crazy because you don’t run as fast as they do and you’re not trying to.
Those days are over.
Have you ever joined a Facebook group that made you feel inadequate because your pace is slower than a 10-minute mile? Or whenever you post about your runs and success, people in the group tell you that you’re too slow or that you need to "push yourself harder”? ...Even though you were perfectly fine with your pace and progression?
Those days are over.
If you run, walk, jog, slog, or wog, you’re welcome here! If you run intervals, you’re welcome here! If you’re new to running, you’re welcome here! If you’re on the couch thinking about becoming a runner, you’re welcome here! There’s no pace too slow in the Slow AF Run Club.
Your community is waiting for you!
What value can you put on TRUE connection and support that helps you through the difficult days and celebrates with you on the great ones? We’re not just building a community here, we’re building a family...and we hope you will join us!
+ Discussions that matter. We believe that vulnerability is the route to authentic connection and “aha” moments. We created Slow AF as a safe space to have deep, nuanced conversations.
+ Privacy is important. Slow AF has the connectivity of Facebook with the security of a private membership site. None of your information can be shared outside of the community, so you can express yourself openly, without the fear of your posts being shared.
+ No Ads. No spam. No fake news. Just plain old connection with other runners just like you!
+ Access to a community of like-minded peers. The Slow AF Run Club includes people from numerous skills and backgrounds exploring ideas, sharing success stories, and discussing lessons learned. Find members near you. Find members online now. Find members by category.
Members of the Slow AF Run Club are connecting and getting support around topics like: 
+ Proper running form, breathing, and pacing
+ Managing your mindset so you stay motivated and excited about running.
+ Cross Training & Injury Prevention
+ What to wear to feel and perform your best.
+ Back of the pack friendly races
+ Training plans
...and much more.
--

The plan includes three runs per week with a rest day between, an
bluejetty:00021441:ios.description:
Watch to 5K helps you build up to running 5K in just 9 weeks. It’s designed for absolute beginners and runs entirely on your Apple Watch, so you can leave your phone at home.
The plan includes three runs per week with a rest day between, and a new schedule each week. By the end of the program, you’ll be able to run continuously for 30 minutes.
BUILT FOR THE APPLE WATCH
• Runs independently without the need for your iPhone.
• Watch face complications are included allowing you to monitor your progress and quickly launch the app.
PHONE COMPANION APP
• An iPhone companion app is included to allow you to track your progress.
• View a breakdown of your previous runs, including health data and run route.
• Achievements are awarded as you progress through the plan to celebrate milestones such as running continuously for 5 minutes or running for a certain distance.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
• Sessions are stored in Apple Health and count towards your activity goals.
• Watch to 5K tracks your route, distance, calories, average speed and heart rate so you can easily track your progress.
• Supports outdoors or indoor runs.
LISTEN TO YOUR MUSIC WHILE YOU RUN
• Works alongside your preferred music player or podcast watch app, automatically ‘dipping’ the volumes so you can hear the instructions and updates on your progress.
• Signals the halfway point, so you know when to head home!
• Easy to follow countdown timer that uses sounds and haptics, so you know how long you’ve got left of each run.
GO AT YOUR OWN PACE 
• Ability to repeat runs, allowing you to go at a pace that suits you.
• Start the plan from any week. Perfect if you are coming to Watch to 5K from a different plan/app.
• After completing the 5K plan, challenge yourself with the available 10K expansion plan.
NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
• Watch to 5K is a one time purchase with no ongoing subscriptions.
FEATURED ON
* TechRadar - Top Apple Watch app of 2024 *
* MacRumors - Apps to Check Out *
* Stuff.tv - 40 best Apple Watch apps *
* Coach - The Best Apple Watch Fitness apps * 
* Wareable - The Best Apple Watch running apps * 
Watch to 5K integrates with Apple Health using HealthKit to store your run activity.
If you have any questions, comments or ideas, you can get in touch at support@watchto5k.com

Customization: Customize your sword’s design and attributes to suit your playstyle.
Endless Fun: Unlock new elements and materials, continuously upgrading your sword as you progress.

If you love crafting, strategy, and action games, Sword Melter delivers an exciting and rewarding experience. Combine materials, forge your weapon, and cut through obstacles in this fun and engaging adventure.
Challenge Yourself Today!
Can you craft the ultimate sword and conquer every obstacle in your path? Play Sword Melter now and test your crafting and combat skills!

bluejetty:00159226:ios.description:
The Beans — We’ll build you a custom, simple, free, Visual Financial Plan and keep you updated, so you find your Money + Life Balance.
The Beans is the only Visual Financial Planning mobile app that will:
• Build you a custom, simple, and free Visual Financial Plan that you can personalize.
• Automatically and accurately label your transactions.
• Plan your monthly expenses.
• Keep you updated on how much you are free to spend and any upcoming bills.
• Keep your information safe and secure.
What is a Visual Financial Plan and how does it work?
A Visual Financial Plan is a more holistic look at your finances. Think of it as an upgrade to a budget. You’d connect your active accounts (checking, credit cards, loans, savings— whichever apply to you), then we’d surface your bills and other financial commitments for you to confirm. After confirming your commitments, The Beans calculates your average spending outside of bills and presents you with a Visual Financial Plan, which you’ll then customize and commit to. New Plans begin on the first of each month. We’ll send you support to stay on track and you’ll earn achievements as time goes on. As your finances evolve so will your Plan, which you can adjust at anytime.
How much does The Beans cost?
The Beans app is free to download. 
Is it safe and secure?
The Beans keeps your information private and secure. We won’t sell your information or advertise to you.
Does The Beans work with my bank?
The Beans works with close to 10,000 banks, if yours is not supported we will work to get you connected as soon as possible.
Read our friendly Terms of Service here: https://www.thebeans.io/home/terms-of-service/

· Browse restaurants and menus
· Customize your order, your way
· Pay with campus card or credit/debit card
· Know when to expect your order and get notified when your food is ready
· Earn points, get rewards at participating locations

bluejetty:00152338:ios.description:
ComicIQ helps collectors track, value, and manage their comic book portfolio with AI identification and real-time market data from hundreds of verified sources.
HOW IT WORKS
→ Snap or upload a photo of any comic cover.
→ ComicIQ instantly identifies the title, issue number, and edition.
→ Get accurate value ranges across all grade conditions from Mint to Good.
→ Explore detailed issue data including writer, artist, inker, and publication history.
→ View in-depth notes on cover condition, story highlights, and collector relevance.
WHAT YOU'LL SEE
• Instant value estimates: Market-based price ranges for every grade (1.0–10.0).
• Condition breakdowns: Learn how wear, spine creases, or fading impact value.
• Detailed issue data: Title, genre, publisher, release date, page count.
• Creator credits: Writers, artists, inkers, and contributors to the issue.
• Story summaries: Understand why key issues matter to collectors.
• Historical and pricing notes: Get context behind market trends and price shifts.
• Additional analysis: Expert-level insights about storylines, rarity, and grade range.
WHY COLLECTORS USE IT
→ Fast, photo-based identification
→ Reliable valuation using data from hundreds of sources
→ Complete historical and creator info
→ Built-in grading reference and visual cues
→ Track your collection's total value
→ Watch your portfolio grow with market updates
BUILT FOR
• Collectors who want to know what they own
• Sellers preparing to list or negotiate
• Buyers verifying value before purchase
• Investors tracking comic market trends
• Anyone sitting on a collection they've never priced
• Historians exploring comic eras
Disclaimer:
All estimated values are for informational purposes only and may vary based on market activity and physical condition. Authentication and professional grading are recommended for high-value transactions.
Categories: Comics, Collectibles, Reference, Entertainment
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.spectapps.com/vibecheckaiprivacypolicy

bluejetty:00173575:ios.description:
Train with Stew Smith, a former Navy SEAL Lieutenant and one of the most respected tactical fitness coaches in the world. This app gives you the exact exercises, techniques, and training methods Stew has used to prepare candidates for BUD/S and other elite programs since 1997.
RECOMMENDED FOR
• Navy SEAL, SWCC, EOD, and military candidates
• Police, firefighters, and tactical professionals
• Anyone who wants to train with purpose and get into the best shape of their life
FREE PST CALCULATOR & TRACKER
Enter your 500 yard swim, push-ups, sit-ups, pull-ups, and 1.5 mile run, and the app scores your Physical Screening Test using Stew Smith's own grading system.
• One score, graded against the real standards, including the tighter officer line
• See your weakest event and exactly what it costs you in points
• Every event measured against minimum and competitive standards
• Step-by-step instructions to run the test yourself, including rest periods between events
• Log every retest and watch your score improve on the progress chart
117 FREE EXERCISE VIDEOS
Every movement demonstrated and explained by Stew Smith, with clear instruction on form, pacing, and proper technique:
• Core, arms, and upper body
• Legs and lower body
• Full body conditioning
• TRX exercises
• 10+ push-up variations and 5+ pull-up variations
• Sit-up, crunch, and ab variations
Plus exclusive swimming and underwater training content, including SEAL-style swim techniques and the Survival Swim (drown-proofing) modeled on the conditioning required at BUD/S.
GO FURTHER WITH ONE UPGRADE
A single one-time purchase, no subscription, unlocks:
• The Daily Trainer: 24 weeks of progressive daily workouts, 168 in total, from base building to peak
• 50+ detailed PT routines covering swimming, running, calisthenics, and full body sessions
• Your PST results point you to the exact weeks of the program that target your weakest event
Try a full week of the Daily Trainer and 4 PT routines free before you decide.
ABOUT STEW SMITH
Stew Smith is a graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy, a former Navy SEAL Lieutenant, and the author of several bestselling fitness books, including The Complete Guide to Navy SEAL Fitness, Maximum Fitness, The Special Ops Workouts, and SWAT Fitness. He has trained thousands of candidates for the Navy SEALs, Special Forces, SWAT, FBI, and other demanding professions. His work has been featured in National Geographic's Fight Science, The Washington Post, Men's Health, and Sports Illustrated.
Navy SEAL style training is intense. Train with a partner, use safe exercise practices, and listen to your body as you progress.

bluejetty:00026846:ios.description:
Welcome to Webfic - Fantastic Reading, your passport to a world of enchanting tales and captivating narratives! Dive into a universe of words, where extraordinary stories await your exploration. This immersive online reading app is designed to transport you to far-off realms and tantalize your imagination with a vast collection of web novels
Webfic is a reading app with massive original English stories, including urban, romance, fantasy, werewolf, classic, and so on. With Webfic - Fantastic Reading, your online reading experience will never be the same again. Imagine being able to embark on thrilling adventures, unravel mysteries, and fall in love with characters, all from the convenience of your mobile device. 
Highlights
- Immersive Stories & Personalized Recommendations
Delve into a treasure trove of web novels that spans multiple genres, from heartwarming romances to suspenseful mysteries and epic fantasies. Our carefully curated library has something for every reader, ensuring you'll never run out of captivating tales to explore. And Webfic's intuitive recommendation system can help you discover more free stories that align with your interests. Whether you're a fan of billionaires, dramas, or romance, Webfic has a story waiting just for you.
- Customizable Reading Experience
One of the key features of Webfic is the ability to customize the reading experience. Users can adjust the background color, font size, and brightness to suit their preferences, ensuring optimal comfort for their eyes. Whether you prefer reading in the daytime or under the covers with a flashlight, Webfic accommodates your unique reading style. This level of personalization enhances the overall reading experience and sets Webfic apart from other free reading apps.
- Offline Reading & Regular Updates.
No internet? No problem! Download your favorite stories and read them offline, perfect for those times when you're on the go or just want to escape into a world of words without any distractions. Stories on Webfic are updated frequently, so you'll never have to wait long for the next chapter or episode. Say goodbye to cliffhangers that keep you waiting in suspense!
Key Features
- Get real-time recommendations of original free stories according to your preferences.
- Have a wonderful reading experience through the function of adjusting the background color.
- Save your favorite stories in the library to keep the latest chapter with you wherever you go.
Webfic is not just a reading app, it's a gateway to new worlds, a source of inspiration, and a community of book lovers coming together to celebrate the joy of reading. Escape reality for a while and explore the vast realms of fiction that are just a tap away. 
So, what are you waiting for? Start your journey with Webfic - Fantastic Reading today and unlock the door to a world of limitless storytelling possibilities. Whether you're a seasoned bookworm or just looking for an escape from the ordinary, Webfic welcomes you with open arms. Webfic - Fantastic Reading is a free reading app to use. If you want, you can also subscribe to unlock all the good novels for free.

Conquer ever-evolving puzzles. Where Chaos Meets Order in a Vibrant 3D World!
Welcome to Supermarket Sort 3D, the ultimate casual sorting adventure that transforms chaotic shelves into stunning displays! Step into a bustling supermarket filled with everyday items—from snacks and beverages to fresh fruits and delightful surprises. Your mission? Match, organize, and conquer the clutter to create beautifully arranged shelves, all in immersive 3D!
How to Play:
• Match & Merge: Drag and drop identical items to create triple matches. Whether you're aligning snacks, beverages, or fruits, each match brings you closer to unlocking new levels and hidden bonuses.
• Strategic Sorting: Use clever tactics and powerful boosters to overcome increasingly challenging layouts. Every level offers a fresh twist—mixing simplicity with brain-teasing puzzles that will test your sorting skills.
• Anytime, Anywhere: Enjoy the game offline for a stress-relieving escape during short breaks or extended play sessions.
Game Features:
Engaging Triple-Match Gameplay: With hundreds of meticulously designed levels, Supermarket Sort 3D combines the ease of casual play with the excitement of strategic challenges.
Stunning 3D Visuals: Immerse yourself in beautifully rendered 3D environments where every item pops with vibrant detail, turning everyday products into works of art.
Relax & Unwind: Designed to be stress-relieving and accessible, this game is perfect for players seeking a calming yet stimulating experience—ideal for unwinding after a long day.
Customized Experience: Unlock new items, power-ups, and organizing challenges as you progress, giving you the freedom to develop your own unique sorting style.
Seasonal Events & Surprises: Keep an eye out for special events and updates that introduce fresh puzzles and exclusive rewards, ensuring your sorting adventure is always evolving.
Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a quick escape or a puzzle enthusiast eager for a new challenge, Supermarket Sort 3D offers a delightful blend of strategy, beauty, and pure fun. Dive in now, organize your world, and join a community of master organizers who turn everyday chaos into spectacular order!
Download Supermarket Sort 3D today and start your journey to becoming the ultimate sorting master!

Extended app features list:
- Discover Movies: now playing, upcoming, search...
- Movie information: ratings, description, cast, budget, actors, release...
- Watch: trailers & related video contents
- Buy or Rent: direct link to the iTunes Store to watch the Full Movie (rates apply) 
- Lists: Browse Curated Movie lists, Organize your own movie database with a watchlist... 
- Download: add your own videos & movies & TV-shows via Dropbox to the app library so you can watch them offline anywhere...
- Video player: fully featured HD video player
- Explore: Search to discover, watch and stream video content related to your favorite movies...
- Available on iPhone and Ipad
- No login or authentification needed (except when you want to add your own content to the app through the Dropbox functionality)
Please note:
Our app is not a full movie streaming service. Full-length movies are not available within the app. 
You need to download your own movies and videos to your device with the app (via Dropbox) to watch them offline anywhere. 
Otherwise, we make it easy for you. For a wide catalog of movies (not playing now in theaters), you will find a direct link to buy in iTunes Store (button is below in the movie information page, rates apply). 
Sources:
- This product uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb
- All movie information and images are from tmdb.org licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
IN-APP PURCHASE, SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS:
We offer non-consumable in-app purchase and auto-renewing subscription options:
- Subscriptions length: weekly, monthly, Yearly
- These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access the full feature of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month" unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
By using our app, you accept our Privacy Policy and Terms of use.
Privacy Policy: https://roundingsquares.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00146886:ios.description:
OtoZen: Drive safer. Stay connected. Protect the people you love.
As seen on Parents Magazine, FOX, USA Today, ABC, and more — OtoZen is the all-in-one family tracker, GPS sharing, teen driving log, and driving safety app built for modern families.
Whether you’re managing carpools, supporting a new teen driver, coordinating busy schedules, or wanting peace of mind when loved ones are on the road, OtoZen helps families stay connected with live location sharing, smart driving alerts, and emergency protection.
LIVE LOCATION SHARING & FAMILY TRACKER
OtoZen is a powerful family tracker and location tracker with real-time GPS sharing.
• Live location sharing for family members
• Arrival, departure, and ETA alerts
• School, home, and carpool notifications
• Battery level monitoring
• Trip start and trip completed alerts
• Find my family and find my kids instantly
• Privacy-first location sharing controls
Instead of repeatedly texting “Where are you?” or “Did you get there safely?”, families stay informed automatically with smart notifications and live GPS tracking.
DRIVE SAFE WITH SMART DRIVING ALERTS
OtoZen helps families encourage safer driving habits with real-time driving insights.
• Speeding and unsafe driving alerts
• Texting while driving detection
• Driving scores after trips
• Weekly driving behavior reports
• Driving history and route tracking
• Teen driving log and trip activity monitoring
• Safe driving challenges and streaks
Whether you’re monitoring a teen driver, a student driver, or improving your own habits, OtoZen helps families drive safe together.
BUILT FOR NEW & TEEN DRIVERS
Learning to drive can feel stressful for both parents and teens. OtoZen helps new drivers become more road ready while giving parents greater peace of mind.
• Teen driving log for DMV requirements
• Track practice driving hours automatically
• Great for drivers ed and driving school
• Supports driving practice and road test prep
• Encourages safer driving habits early
• Driving behavior insights for parents and teens
Perfect for learner permits, DMV practice test preparation, and first-time drivers.
FAMILY SAFETY & EMERGENCY ALERTS
OtoZen goes beyond basic GPS tracking with advanced family safety features.
• Automatic crash detection
• Emergency SOS alerts
• Emergency response support
• Sends GPS location during emergencies
• Safe arrival alerts and trip monitoring
• Works in any vehicle — no hardware needed
Families gain peace of mind knowing loved ones have extra protection whenever they drive, commute, travel, or walk home.
FAMILY COORDINATION MADE EASY
• Carpool coordination and pickup alerts
• Family scheduling and trip sharing
• Parking reminders and parked car finder
• Hands-free voice messaging through car speakers
• Family coordination without constant texting
From school pickups to teen schedules and family errands, OtoZen keeps everyone connected.

bluejetty:00174093:android.description:
Make your dream of having a kitty come true with Cat Time - a super cute pet game filled with fun and joy!
In Cat Time, you will adopt a lovely kitten, take care and purr-lay with cats, then your cat will react with your every touch! It will melt your heart and make your day. Especially, you can unlock a variety of interesting cat toys, collect special items to decorate your warm cat house and level up cat skills by passing the levels of the funny but challenging 3 tile match game. But this matching puzzle with easy gameplay is not as “easy” as you have thought. This classic match 3 game is the newest challenging puzzle for tile master！
Now, are you ready to get your paws on this furry clever magic match-3 puzzle adventure?
【HOW TO PLAY CAT TIME - EASY GAMEPLAY, FULL OF JOY!】
★ SO REAL FOR CAT LOVERS: Adopt, feed, take care and purr-lay with adorable kitten in your spare time, cat reacts with your touch and show love for you! But some accidents will happen and cat really may makes you go crazy!
★ DUET CATS: Perfect mix for cat lover and music enthusiasts! Listen to the rhythm, feed funny cats the falling food and chill out!
★ MORE FUN WITH MINI GAME: Take daily challenge with different levels of difficulty to get cat food and unlock new skills
★ LEVEL UP YOUR PET: Use special boosters to help you pass more and more challenging levels, get extra coins and level up your lovely meow!
★ DECOR CAT HOUSE: Challenge the brain-burning levels to collect limited items, decorate your cat house
★ FUNNY MEMORIES：Share and show off your sweet cat pictures to your friends
【TIPS TO SOLVE DAILY MATCHING PUZZLE - FULL OF CHALLENGE, FULL OF FUN!】
🐾 Click and move the tile into your stack, the same 3 tiles will be matched and cleared. 
😨 After the same 3 tiles removed, they will no longer occupy your stack, and you have room for 7 tiles to match. If the stack is full with 7 tiles, you will fail!
🐱 Tiles will have so many layers and only after the tiles on the upper layer are matched, the tiles on the lower layer can be revealed. Pay attention into every step~
🥇 When there are no tiles on the screen, you have successfully cleared the level!
Don't hesitate! Start your warm journey and play with your furry friend right now!
Email: support@cattime.noxjoy.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cattimegame

bluejetty:00121064:ios.summary: The official mobile app of the Cleveland Browns. Access the latest news, live scores, game schedules, and team updates—all in one place. Watch videos, listen to exclusive podcasts, and stream press conferences directly from the app. Manage
bluejetty:00121064:ios.description:
The official mobile app of the Cleveland Browns. Access the latest news, live scores, game schedules, and team updates—all in one place. Watch videos, listen to exclusive podcasts, and stream press conferences directly from the app. Manage your tickets, switch to Huntington Bank Field Mode for in-stadium info, and track live stats during every game. Your ultimate Browns experience, right at your fingertips.
Reminders:
- For the best experience all season long, enable Automatic App Updates to receive the latest performance improvements and new features.
- Stay informed with Push Notifications for real-time alerts on breaking news, injury updates, exclusive offers, game reminders, and more.
- Enable Location Services to access in-stadium features like seating maps, live radio feeds, and other gameday info.
- Link your Ticketmaster account to seamlessly manage, transfer, and access your tickets, ensuring smooth entry on gameday.
Features include:
- Latest Content: Access to latest news, video, photos and podcasts
- Scores and Stats: Track live scores, stats, and key moments throughout games
- Mobile Tickets: Buy, sell, transfer, and manage tickets directly in the app
- Team Roster and Info: View team roster, player stats and bios, depth chart, injury reports and standings
- Full Game Schedule: View the complete season schedule with game dates, times, and locations
- Live Radio: Tune in to the University Hospitals Cleveland Browns Radio Network for live broadcasts of every game (within 100 miles of Huntington Bank Field)
- Streaming: Stream press conferences and Cleveland Browns Daily
- Huntington Bank Field Mode: Switch to Huntington Bank Field mode for upcoming events and in-stadium features
- Push Notifications: Alerts for breaking news, injury updates, exclusive offers, and game reminders
- Dawg Rewards: Enter to win exclusive prizes and access Season Ticket Member discounts
- Season Ticket Member Hub: Convenient access to account information, ticket management, Dawg Rewards and more
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see https://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information.

Burn your tires on the asphalt and go to the "Grand Car Parking City". Participate in street racing, drifting, drag racing online and become a true racer.
Endless open world
-Resort coastline measuring 20x20km

bluejetty:00030705:ios.description:
Burn your tires on the asphalt and go to the "Grand Car Parking City". Participate in street racing, drifting, drag racing online and become a true racer.
Endless open world
-Resort coastline measuring 20x20km
-City, desert airfield, racing track, airport, highway, beach area, port and many other areas
-Up to 32 players with you online
-Tens of kilometers of roads and hundreds of hidden bonuses on the map
Auto and tuning
-50+ cars including vintage cars, supercars, suvs, hypercars
-30+ body kits for each car. Rims, bumpers, spoilers, bodykits, liveries.
-Free vinyl editor with which you can draw your personal skin of any complexity
-Suspension and camber adjustments to improve vehicle handling and appearance
-The engine and gearbox are pumped, which will help to defeat your rivals
-Each car has a well-designed interior and engine, all doors, hood and trunk open!
Great graphics
-Realistic DZO graphics create the coolest picture in a mobile phone game
-Detailed interior of the car allows you to play in the first person with impressive emotions
-High performance allows you to play not only on powerful devices
-Advanced graphics settings will allow you to choose everything you need
Gameplay
No boundaries. Earn money for new cars not only by participating in races, but also by simply performing stunts and gaining drift points or by selling your cars and skins to other players on the market like a real outbid.
-DRIFT mode - you and other players will compete for the most drift points
-CAR RACE mode - the winner will be the one who crosses the finish line first, avoiding a severe accident
-SKILL TEST mode - race around insane ski jump karts
-Driving school, where you will be taught to drive a car with dignity, will let you test many cars and after passing will be rewarded with special awards.
-Auto market - trade with other players and wager RP to earn or get rare and valuable items
-Hundreds of tasks, quests and achievements with their own rewards
WE DEVELOP THE GAME TOGETHER

bluejetty:00159709:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00159709:ios.description:
The Camp Chef app introduces a bold, new convenient way to cook outdoors.
Control your grill from your phone
Tastiness if only a tap away! Use the Camp Chef app to connect to your WIFI/Bluetooth enabled pellet grill. You’ll be able to set and monitor temperatures, adjust smoke levels, and shut down your grill from your mobile device.
Monitor your cook
Actively monitor the temperature of your grill and meat probes on your phone. Set and enable pop-up notifications for grill timers or once meat probe goal temperatures have been met. Have the ability to connect and monitor your grill from anywhere, as if you were standing beside your grill. 
Your data stored on all your devices
By creating an account through the Camp Chef app, your grill’s cook data is available to you at all times on all your mobile devices. Seamlessly switch between multiple Camp Chef grills. Historical cook graphs (coming soon) will allow you to view the results of a specific cook over time. These graphs will grant you access to information and insights allowing you to view what went well and what you would change. 
Robust help and support
(Coming soon.) Access questions and answers by viewing various FAQ and how-to articles right from the app. Explore topics such as grill maintenance and care, optimal cook temperatures for certain meats, and much more!
Setup your Camp Chef grill
Use the app to connect your Camp Chef pellet grill to your local WIFI network, pair with Bluetooth, and more.

Welcome to RapidTV · Your immersive paradise for short drama lovers!
Explore a diverse library of short dramas
From intriguing modern tales and historical sagas to suspenseful mysteries and relatable campus stories – discover content that brings laughter, touches emotions, or sparks excitement!
Why enjoy RapidTV?
Convenient viewing
1-3 minute episodes fit perfectly into breaks – find satisfying entertainment in small moments!
Fresh content regularly
Weekly updates deliver new stories: urban life, workplace dynamics, campus relationships and more!
Download RapidTV today
Automatic Subscription Service Description
1. VIP Subscription Benefits & Plans: Core benefit is ad removal for a seamless experience. Subscription plans include weekly and annual options; ad removal privilege takes effect immediately upon successful subscription.
2. Payment Process: Once you confirm the purchase and complete the payment, the corresponding amount will be charged directly to your linked iTunes account.
3. Auto-Renewal Rule: Your iTunes account will be automatically charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current subscription period expires. If the payment is successful, your subscription cycle will be extended by one full renewal period (e.g., 1 week for weekly plans, 1 year for annual plans).
4. Subscription Management: To manage auto-renewal or cancel your subscription:Go to your iPhone’s "Settings" → Tap "iTunes Store & App Store" → Click your "Apple ID" → Select "View Apple ID" → Navigate to the "Subscriptions" section.To cancel auto-renewal, turn off the feature at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. If you cancel within the final 24 hours of the period, no additional charges will be incurred after the current cycle ends.
5. Relevant Agreements:
a. Privacy Policy: https://puredramas.com/Privacy_Policy.html
b. Terms of Service: https://puredramas.com/User_Service_Agreement.html
Turn every moment into your personal drama-filled moment!

bluejetty:00157353:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157353:ios.description:
iVault – Secret Photo Vault to hide pictures, videos and files
Keep private photos out of your camera roll. iVault locks your pictures, videos, notes and documents in a secure vault that only you can open – with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode.
► HIDE PHOTOS & VIDEOS
• Move private pictures and videos out of your public gallery in seconds
• Organize them into albums, each with its own passcode
• Relive memories with slideshow mode inside the vault
► STOP SNOOPERS
• Intruder selfie: iVault takes a photo of anyone who enters a wrong passcode
• Fake PIN: a second passcode opens a decoy vault, so the real one stays hidden
• Face-down switch: turn your phone over and iVault jumps to another app
► DISGUISE THE APP
• Change the app icon so your vault doesn't stand out on the Home Screen
► MORE THAN PHOTOS
• Secret notes and private documents, including PDFs
• Private contacts, kept separate from your phonebook
• Built-in password manager for your logins
• Encrypted backup to Dropbox
• Trash & restore for anything deleted by mistake
► MADE FOR EVERY DAY
• Clean, simple design with Dark Mode
• 20+ themes to make your vault feel like yours
Questions or ideas? Email us at sundaylab.apps@gmail.com – we read every message.
iVault Premium
iVault is free to download. Optional premium features are available as monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://bodrya-hardik.blogspot.com/2024/12/terms-of-service-ivault.html
Privacy Policy: https://bodrya-hardik.blogspot.com/2024/12/privacy-policy-ivault.html

bluejetty:00100714:ios.summary:

She
bluejetty:00100714:ios.description:
We love reading, and are ardent fans of Sherlock Holmes, just like you, but we know that we also need FUN and EXCITEMENT. So we created this game to make reading the great Doyle's novel thrilling, spooky and fun. Elementary, Dr Watson!
Sherlock Holmes' IM brings abridged version of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle’s stories presented as interactive short chat conversations. 
An immersive game that brings the legendary detective stories by Arthur Conan Doyle to life. Dive into the mysteries of 221B Baker Street and solve complex cases with the world’s greatest detective.
The stories are retold as chat conversations between YOU, Sherlock Holmes, Watson and other characters. These are gripping, edge-of-your seat conversations that will keep you reading for hours. while the original stories retain their soul and wit with added illustrations and imagery. 
Step into the world of Sherlock Holmes and embark on thrilling adventures!
Key Features:
- Authentic Stories: Experience the original adventures of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson as written by Arthur Conan Doyle.
- Interactive Gameplay: Engage in chat-based interactive fiction where your choices shape the outcome of each case.
- Immersive Graphics: Enjoy beautifully crafted visuals that bring Victorian London to life.
- Character Interaction: Communicate with iconic characters like Sherlock Holmes, Dr. Watson, Inspector Lestrade, and more.
We have complete collection of 12 stories from "The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes" written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. 
Adventures included in the collection:
1. "A Scandal in Bohemia"
2. "The Red-Headed League"
3. "A Case of Identity"
4. "The Boscombe Valley Mystery"
5. "The Five Orange Pips"
6. "The Man with the Twisted Lip"
7. "The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle"
8. "The Adventure of the Speckled Band"
9. "The Adventure of the Engineer's Thumb"
10. "The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor"
11. "The Adventure of the Beryl Coronet"
12. "The Adventure of the Copper Beeches"
Who Is This For?
- Mystery Enthusiasts: Ideal for fans of detective fiction and those who love solving mysteries.
- Sherlock Holmes Fans: Perfect for admirers of Arthur Conan Doyle’s classic tales.
- Interactive Fiction Lovers: A must-play for those who enjoy interactive storytelling and choice-driven narratives.
- Casual Gamers: Accessible to all players, whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to interactive fiction.
Download Sherlock Holmes' IM: Chat Game Today!
Join Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson on their thrilling detective quests. Download now and immerse yourself in the world of one of literature’s greatest detectives!
Questions? Want to write for us? Email sherlock@mysthetic.com

bluejetty:00095749:ios.summary:
