bluejetty:00095749:ios.description:
Ready for a game that relaxes your mind and challenge your logic? Step into the world of screws and captivating mechanical puzzles!
In Screw Twist 3D! Unscrew It, your goal is simple yet satisfying: unscrew every bolt in the correct order and watch as each object falls apart piece by piece. Don't be fooled by simplicity; each level presents a clever logical challenge that will test your brain, patience, and precision.
This calming yet addictive screw puzzle game lets you tap, twist, and unlock your way through beautifully designed 3D objects. With realistic physics and smooth animations, every move feels impactful and rewarding. If you love the satisfaction of sorting puzzles, a good brain challenge, or just enjoy cool mechanical gameplay, then Screw Twist 3D! Unscrew It is for you.
Why You'll Love Screw Twist 3D! Unscrew It:
Perfect for fans of sort puzzles, brain teasers, and satisfying mechanics. Screw Twist 3D! Unscrew It blends mental focus with relaxing gameplay; ideal whether you want to unwind or sharpen your mind. 
 Features of Screw Twist 3D! Unscrew It:
-Strategic Screw Removal: Carefully unscrew screws in the correct order to progress.
-Mind-Bending Puzzles: Engage in clever challenges designed to train your logical thinking.
-Calming & Stress-Relieving: Enjoy a peaceful and satisfying gaming experience. 
-Hundreds of Unique Levels: Explore a vast collection of handcrafted screw challenges.
-Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple mechanics that offer deep strategic depth.
-Satisfying Disassembly: Watch objects gracefully come apart with each correct move.
-Simple Controls: Effortless one-touch controls make it super easy to play anywhere, anytime.
-Immersive Audio: Experience ASMR-like sounds and haptic feedback.
Think you've got what it takes to master the art of unscrewing? Start twisting now and and train your brain, blast through those screws, and master this colorful screw-matching adventure. Let the satisfying unscrewing begin!

bluejetty:00080403:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate pizza party adventure with Timpy Pizza Games for kids and girls! Get ready to join the fun at our pizza restaurant and immerse yourself in the world of pizza maker cooking games. If you're a cooking games enthusiast and love pizza games, you've come to the right place.
Our cooking games for kids offer an exciting journey into the art and joy of pizza making. From crafting the dough to adding your favorite toppings and baking to perfection, you'll experience every step of the pizza making process.
Explore a wonderland of pizza making possibilities at our restaurant. Our pizza games are designed to entertain and educate kids and toddlers 2 to 5 year olds. At any time, you can create a pizza party right on your device, thanks to the variety of pizza maker games we offer. These cooking games come with unique challenges and excitement, allowing you to experiment with different ingredients, sauces, and toppings, making each pizza uniquely yours. Our pizza making games provide hours of entertainment for all ages.
Toddlers 2 to 5 year olds can immerse themselves in the culinary world, gaining essential cooking skills independently. They'll discover dough preparation and vegetable chopping and take their first steps in becoming pizza making pros through our engaging, child-friendly toddler games for kids and girls.
Unleash your inner pizza chef with these engaging toddler games for 2 to 5 year olds. Master the art of pizza making and uncover the secrets of crafting the perfect pizza with Timpy Pizza Games for kids and girls. It's a cooking adventure that promises fun for both kids and adults.
Our pizza games for kids and girls go beyond just creating mouthwatering pizzas; they also boost essential skills and knowledge in a fun manner. These pizza maker games for kids and girls are designed with children in mind, offering a safe and engaging environment for young chefs to learn, experiment, and have a blast.
Prepare to be hooked on the thrill of pizza fun. Once you start playing Timpy pizza maker games, you'll find it hard to put your device down. The excitement of crafting the perfect pizza and serving it to happy customers will keep you coming back for more. You'll be completely immersed in the pizza making process, from ingredient selection to slicing the final product. In our pizza games, the fun and excitement never end.
So, what are you waiting for? Get ready for an unforgettable pizza party with Timpy Pizza Games for kids and girls. Explore the world of pizza maker cooking games and become a true pizza pro. Cooking for kids and girls has never been this enjoyable and educational. Experience the art of pizza making in a way you've never imagined. Download now and let the pizza party begin!

bluejetty:00121357:ios.summary:
Avec l’application GALA 100% gratuite sur iPhone et iPad, suivez les dernières news people et l'actu de vos stars, les tendances mode et beauté ainsi que tous les événements people.
• ACTU
Suivez l’actualité des stars les plus célèbres e
bluejetty:00121357:ios.description:
Avec l’application GALA 100% gratuite sur iPhone et iPad, suivez les dernières news people et l'actu de vos stars, les tendances mode et beauté ainsi que tous les événements people.
• ACTU
Suivez l’actualité des stars les plus célèbres en temps réel.
• PHOTOS et VIDÉOS
Découvrez l'actu people à travers des photos et des vidéos inédites, des interviews et un condensé des plus grands moments de la télévision.
• STORIES 
Directement sur la page d’accueil, retrouvez la sélection de la rédaction avec les Stories pour ne rien rater des événements people
• MES STARS
Personnalisez votre application Gala et ne ratez rien de l’actu people en suivant vos stars favorites (Meghan Markle, Kate Middleton, Brigitte Macron...) directement depuis l’application. 
• MODE BEAUTÉ
Suivez les dernières tendances mode, make up, coiffure et inspirez-vous des astuces beauté de stars. Plongez au milieu des people les plus sélects et suivez les tops modèles féminins dans l’effervescence des défilés des plus grands créateurs.
• CINÉMA
Gala vous fait vivre en direct les événements cinéma les plus prestigieux tout au long de l’année : Festival de Cannes, Cérémonie des César, Cérémonie des Oscars. L’ensemble des people réunis en un seul endroit.
• ÉVÉNEMENT
Pour les grandes occasions (Festival de Cannes, Fashion Week…), Gala crée des rubriques événementielles dédiées, offrant la couverture la plus exhaustive et la plus glamour de ces événements people.
• ROYAUTÉ
Tournées royales, anniversaires, naissances, divorces, retrouvez en exclusivité les actus de toutes les personnalités qui composent la royauté et le gotha.
• LES ALERTES
Soyez alerté en temps réel de l'actu people grâce aux alertes Gala !
• LE MAGAZINE GALA
Retrouvez à la vente chaque semaine la version numérique de votre magazine préféré.
Retrouvez, à tout moment, même sans connexion internet, tous vos numéros téléchargés et archivés dans votre bibliothèque.
Une question, une remarque? Écrivez-nous à mobilite@lefigaro.fr

• Share events, places and your itinerary with friends and family

listings.description:
Rapid City, South Dakota is the place you didn’t know you were searching for until you arrive, embraced by America’s heartland. For millennia, the Black Hills and Badlands have had a magnetic pull for those seeking something more. Here, you’ll feel the significance of these lands, the stories etched in the Hills, and the welcoming energy of the people—past and present—who invite you with open arms. From local life to history carved in stone, Rapid City offers a connection like no other.

The Visit Rapid City app is designed to help you plan the perfect vacation, trip or weekend getaway in Rapid City, SD!
•   Discover activities and attractions that match your interests
•   View upcoming events near you
•   Add events and places to your custom trip
•   Share events, places and your itinerary with friends and family

bluejetty:00179759:ios.description:
壹心理，15年专业心理咨询品牌，国内专业心理健康服务平台。
提供大众心理服务（心理咨询、即时倾诉、心理测评）、心理职业培训、心理体检、组织（学校）心理服务等在内的多形态、立体化综合性心理服务。
壹心理是一个坚持长期价值的团队，创业15年，专注于心理健康的全民普及，为用户的内心烦恼提供可靠解决方案，让专业心理服务可及、可信、可持续。目前壹心理用户覆盖147个国家，5300万用户在壹心理获得心理学帮助。壹心理团队一直在打磨可以放心推荐给朋友和家人的心理服务~
在壹心理APP，我们做到：
【专业】
咨询师入驻筛选通过率仅2%，咨询师70%以上拥有硕博学历。壹心理建立了覆盖心理咨询全流程的专业管理体系，坚持严选咨询师，以制度保障专业，以长期建设保障服务质量。
【可靠】
壹心理作为国家心理测评服务标准起草单位、中国心理服务机构联盟理事单位，凭借15年的专业经验，已累计为400万+人次提供优质且专业的心理服务。
【安心】
壹心理拥有心理咨询隐私保护相关发明专利（专利号：ZL2021 1 0437240.8），连续多年通过国家信息系统安全等级保护三级测评，构建多层次安全保障体系。
【全面】
壹心理心理咨询覆盖300多个咨询细分方向，为用户提供个人成长、婚姻情感、心理健康、人际关系及亲子教育等多个领域的专业心理咨询服务。
在壹心理 App，你可以：
【获得鲸鱼Alice-AI的专业陪伴】 
Alice AI 是壹心理打造的心理支持 AI 助手，依托15 年专业心理服务积累，7×24 小时陪你梳理情绪与困扰。它通过自然对话理解你的状态，推荐适合的支持方式——心理测评、情绪练习、冥想等，并可生成专属情绪报告。Alice 支持跨轮次长期记忆，越用越懂你，全程隐私加密，是你随时在线的轻量心理支持伙伴。
【认识你自己】
通过趣味测评、心理书籍、冥想、免费课程等心理工具，陪伴你的成长，丰沛人生体验，传递生活的勇气和力量；
【入门心理学】
通过科普文章、互助问答、精选专栏等形式，了解心理学知识、社会热点的心理学角度分析，以及大众关心的情感、家庭、人际等话题；
【解决内心困惑】
提供专业的入驻咨询师、倾听师。通过资质审核、咨询时长和督导体验经历把关、现场面试等方式，建立了稳定并严格的审核标准，为你提供专业可靠的心理咨询、即时倾诉服务。
【成为心理咨询师】
如果你想成长为一名具有执业胜任力的心理咨询师，可以在壹心理平台报名『朝阳计划』咨询师培养项目，系统学习心理咨询的基本功和专业技能，在真实咨询场景中持续提升专业能力。
【成为助人倾听师】
如果你想成为专业的助人者，可以在壹心理平台报名『心理倾听师』培养项目，通过专业培训快速入门并实践，为全国及海外华人用户提供及时、温暖、规范的情绪支持服务，让更多人在需要时获得专业陪伴与心理支持。
【心理学人的互动交流】
壹心理通过『心榜』、『咨询师之家』、『问答成长社区』等，帮助普通爱好者/心理学初级人员，成为优质答主、精华答主、专栏作家……给心理从业者提供一个交流互动、互相支持的平台。

bluejetty:00185134:ios.summary: Sydney city and its peak hour traffic, every Sydney sider is well aware of that, nobody would dare to drive to work. Sydney has one of the best public transport system in place. Buses and Ferries are doing a fantastic job, but we need a tra
bluejetty:00185134:ios.description:
Sydney city and its peak hour traffic, every Sydney sider is well aware of that, nobody would dare to drive to work. Sydney has one of the best public transport system in place. Buses and Ferries are doing a fantastic job, but we need a train driver to keep our CityRail operations up and running in this train simulator 2017, by far the best of all train games. Real train game is hard to play, but not this one with all its unique camera angles to check the track-s for adventure, and also get ready for any trainz race any one is looking for. Time is important to get to train stations in time, parking at precise location and racing against time to get the job done.
All the necessary training as a train driver is given at the start of this train simulator, so no need to worry, we have covered it all. A detailed map is given, which can be zoomed in, to find all the necessary direction for the train driver in one of the best train games of the store. Challenge mode will ensure all the real train driving skills along with quick reflexes to make instant decisions in this adventure rail parking game 2017.
Fantastic trainz 3D models with complete interior of passengers buggy and driver compartment on display. Play the real train simulator 2017 game from the driver compartment and enjoy the scenic view from that angles. Keep driving and make instant decisions on the go. Challenge mode may ask you to race at times against the racing clock to get to the stations just in time to cover the morning peak.
Features:
- Fantastic 3d models, with all the interior of passenger and river compartment.
- Breathtaking camera views, so be a rail driver even sitting in the compartment.
- Keep watching the cityrail racing from 360 degrees.
- Door opening and closing real animations on display.
- Lots of challenging levels.
- Real traffic lights system in place.
- Environment accordingly adjusted with the game play
Note: If you choose to join as a Modern Train Driver Game 2023 Pro member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing subscription plan that will automatically be charged through your account as per your choice of plan.
Weekly Plan - $2.99 
Monthly Plan - $6.99 
Privacy Policy - http://monstergamesproductions.com.au/PrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use - http://monstergamesproductions.com.au/TermsAndUse.html

bluejetty:00016606:ios.description:
Jungle Heat is a free cross-platform war game, which you can play on any device or social network.
The tropics full of oil and gold are languishing under the onslaught of General Blood. Your task is to free the native riches, to rip them out of the hands of the bloodthirsty marauders and claim them for yourself! The treasures of the jungle will be safe and sound in your storages. So onward - fortify the walls, hire troops, and onward to battle!
Brutal battles, military bases, wild jungles, and all this displayed with beautiful graphics, weapons, forces, and buildings, which will delight even the most ardent fans of battle games. Download today and join the battle for the treasures of the jungle.
If you want to continue the game on another device or social network, go to the settings section of the game, select "OTHER DEVICE", and follow the instructions. Continue to play on other platforms without losing any progress.
In Jungle Heat, you can develop your military base into an unassailable fortress, battle with other players, raze their bases to ashes, unite into invincible clans, and participate in regular tournaments.
Game features:
> Simplicity and fun: battles are as simple as one, two, three, and what is more, each battle is unique!
> Freedom of maneuver: plan out your base, upgrade buildings and troops, set up an ideal defense, and think up an effective attack!
> Battles with other players: attack blindly, or take revenge on your oppressors!
> Assemble an army of unique heroes, whose different capabilities can change the course of battle! Each battle they fight is saturated with an atmosphere of old school war movies.
> Regular tournaments: Participate in individual and clan tournaments, show the entire world that you and your clan are the best!
> Cross-platform capability: Play on social networks or on any mobile device;
> Bright, colorful graphics: an explosion of color in the jungle!
> Dynamic music: an atmosphere of endless tropical fun!
If you like Jungle Heat, don't forget to give it five stars.
Do you have questions or need help? Write to us, we will help you: support@innova-sol.com
Attention! A reliable internet connection is required for Jungle Heat.

bluejetty:00077787:ios.description:
General details about our math teaser game
This mathematics trivia game brings an unique way to interact with the users by sharing their ideas and have the option to create and to compose their own questions and receive credit for that in our game. 
We want to bring the spirit competition in our game with the global ranking for all devices! Don't wait anymore, get smarter, discover the beauty of maths and come in this numbers adventure to push your mind and stimulate your cells with tricky, enigma, logic, abstract, focus and attention problems! 
Stretch the limits of your intelligence, raise your IQ and challenge your mental boundaries with different levels of logical and maths problems in the most attractive brain teaser game on the store.
Your free time is the most valuable asset! Mathematics is one of the most attractive object! It is more than a science !
You can enjoy yourself and also with your friends with this educational , addictive and funny maths teasers quiz game. If you are a big fan of math , trivia games, IQ Test, mensa, numbers , kenken, blockudoku , teaser, puzzle , quiz, woodoku , nonogram games , riddles , logic , science, enigma, intelligence and intellectual games, sudoku, focus, quizzes, tricky maths and brain games, Math Master is the perfect way for mental stimulation , enjoy your free time, testing your logical skills, train your mind, have fun and relax in the same time!
The game levels are suitable for everyone! Mathematics and education are important for every person !
This teaser puzzle game is suitable for all the people who love math, Sudoku, blockudoku, nonogram games , woodoku, kenken, mental training, mensa test, thinking games with tricky questions . Our game is the best choice for intelligent, smart and intellectual persons to test their basic and complex mathematical knowledge (algebra, geometry, subtraction, addition, arithmetic skills , division , multiplication). Also, the game is appropriate for the students who wants to prepare for their exams and for all people who wants to prepare for work interviews.
What are the benefits of playing Math Master Puzzles & Riddles ?
- Brain Training and Mathematics Training
- Improve your analytical thinking, focusing , attention and level up your IQ
- Manage your stress control in a entertaining way
- Keep your mind sharp and active
- Expand your perception abilities and develop your memory
- Attention questions, science and logical games stimulate different cognitive functions, such as executive function and processing speed
- Quizzes and educational games can help you discover your true potential in school and in daily life
- Great exercise for your intelligence, intellectual skills and your mental health
- Speed up your mental thinking
Main features of the game:
- High quality, minimalist design with 2 themes (dark & light)
- Frequent updates with new questions and features
- 300+ unique logical puzzles / riddles / quizzes in different templates created with a blend and of the most interesting problems common to sudoku games, IQ test, mensa, blockudoku games, trivia games, quiz games, kenken games, nonogram games , tricky brain teasers, woodoku games , numbers games, educational games, enigma games, science games , focus games and mathematics games
- Global ranking across all devices 
- Option to submit your own problems directly in the game and receive credit
- Advanced stats to track your progress
- Multilingual support (English, Romanian, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish and more will come soon). We will be delighted to receive help for other languages(from native speakers) by our users
- We are always receptive to new ideas
- The possibility to play offline (no connection required)
- Detailed solutions for each puzzle
- Step by step instructions on how to play
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00086133:ios.description:
Grandma and grandpa won't let you have fun? Outsmart them and plan your runaway!
It’s so unfair! While your parents are enjoying a sunny vacation by the sea, you’ve been sent to grandma and grandpa’s remote village. And instead of letting you have fun, they’re always piling on chores - weed the garden, paint the fence, feed the chickens! 
You’ve had enough of this boring and exhausting village life. It’s time to make your escape and experience the freedom you deserve! But it won’t be easy, as your grandparents are always watching and suspicious of every move you make.
Step into the shoes of a clever schoolboy who must navigate the tricky paths of his grandparents' house and the surrounding village. 
Your goal? To escape unnoticed. You'll need to gather hidden items, solve complex puzzles, and outwit the villagers and the old folks, who seem determined to keep you locked up. Stealth and strategy are your best friends - use them wisely to avoid detection and escape to freedom.
The village may seem peaceful, but it’s filled with traps, dangers, and surprises. As you sneak through the rooms and backyards, you’ll be faced with eerie sounds, creepy atmospheres, and unexpected challenges.
Keep your wits about you, and don't let the tense environment get the best of you. Interact with unique characters, uncover hidden secrets, and immerse yourself in a thrilling adventure where every move matters!
Key Features:
– Stealth and Hide-and-Seek Gameplay: Sneak through the house and village while avoiding detection. Move quietly, hide in the shadows, and outsmart your pursuers!
– Intelligent Characters: Grandma and grandpa aren't your only challenges - everyone in the village seems to be against you! Be smart and stay one step ahead.
– Challenging Puzzles: Solve a wide variety of brain-teasing puzzles, find hidden objects, and unlock new ways to escape.
– Crafting and Inventory System: Collect items and craft useful tools to help in your escape plan.
– Adventure Action with Horror Elements: Experience heart-pounding tension as you explore creepy environments filled with danger.
– Immersive 3D First-Person Experience: Fully immerse yourself in this high-stakes escape game, where every detail counts and every corner could hold a new surprise.
Can you break free from the clutches of your overbearing grandparents, or will you be stuck in the village forever?
Find out in Schoolboy Escape 2: Village, a thrilling adventure where wits, stealth, and strategy are your keys to freedom!

The app needs the following access permissions when it is running on your device:

bluejetty:00044875:ios.name: Audigo Studio
bluejetty:00044875:ios.summary: Easily record your music and make videos with studio quality sound. Join thousands of musicians who are saving time, creating more often, and having more fun. Start recording in minutes without complex software and equipment, or cumbersome
bluejetty:00044875:ios.description:
Easily record your music and make videos with studio quality sound. Join thousands of musicians who are saving time, creating more often, and having more fun. Start recording in minutes without complex software and equipment, or cumbersome cables.
Powerful App
• Record, mix, edit, add effects, and share anywhere. Mobile content creation like you're in the studio.
Ultimate Portability
• A wireless stereo microphone that fits in your pocket and works with the iPhone already in there.
Effortless Recording
• No cables or wires. No set-up. Auto Soundcheck gets your levels right, so you can just record and go.
FEATURES:
Great Wireless Sound for Video
• Place up to four Audigo microphones right at the sound source then shoot video from anywhere. Adjust EQ and add effects like reverb, compression and delay to easily make great sounding videos.
Multitrack Recording and Editing
• Record up to 16 high quality audio tracks in stereo. Then edit, mix, add effects and share to anywhere, all in the app. Duplicate tracks or entire projects to try new ideas, and add lyrics to see on screen while you record.
Import Then Record
• Import a backing track, beat, or video, then record additional tracks to it.
Export Multitrack Projects
• Use the Audigo mic and app to record anywhere, then export individual .wav files as high quality tracks to share or work with in other music software.
HOW IT WORKS:
Audio on the Mic
• Lossless stereo audio is recorded directly to internal memory on the Audigo microphones and automatically transferred wirelessly to the app after recording.
Video on the Phone
• Audio saved from the mics is perfectly synced with HD or 4K video shot in the Audigo app.
Studio Quality Anywhere
• Audigo's studio quality mics and 4K video with the app puts an audio and video production studio in your pocket.
STUDIO+ SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES:
Vocal Separation
• Pull the vocals out of any track with singing and put them on their own track.
Vocal Tuner
• Tune vocals with Natural, Hard, and Harmonizer modes.
Stem Mixer
• Adjust the drums, bass, vocals, and other elements within a single track.
Unlimited Tracks
• Record as many audio tracks as your song needs, with no 16-track limit.
Advanced effects
• Additional effects options for EQ, compression, reverb, and delay
Multitrack Video
• Capture multiple video tracks, then use the video mixer to easily edit a music video in the app.
Effects Presets
• Save your favorite effects settings as presets and apply them to any track.
Remote Collaboration
• Share projects with other Audigo users through the app to seamlessly record multitrack music from anywhere.
250 GB Cloud Storage
• Keep your projects in the cloud with 250 GB of storage.

bluejetty:00178301:ios.description:
Turn your voice into a hit! Create, record, and mix studio-quality tracks in seconds.
No studio? No problem. VOLMIX is your all-in-one pocket production suite. Whether you want to drop a rap verse, create a catchy pop melody, or experiment with professional vocal effects, VOLMIX gives you the tools to sound like a pro from the first take.
Create unique melodies!
VOLMIX is the ultimate music maker and recording studio app for rappers, singers, DJs, producers, and creators. Record vocals, create trap beats, use autotune effects, and produce professional-quality songs directly from your phone.
Create tracks in seconds with advanced voice tuning, beat maker tools, vocal effects, and professional sample packs inspired by today’s top music genres.
Create professional-quality music anytime, anywhere.
► WHY USE VOLMIX
VOLMIX gives you everything you need to transform your ideas into studio-quality tracks in seconds using powerful vocal effects, professional sounds, and easy-to-use music production tools:
••• Create unique melodies: record, mix, and create studio-quality songs in seconds
••• Transform your voice: use effects and samples to produce music from your mobile
••• Portable music studio: create unique tracks with 3D effects and pro sounds
Start creating hit tracks with professionals tools right now
► CREATE PROFESSIONAL MUSIC
••• Advanced Autotune & Vocal Effects
Transform your voice with professional autotune, pitch correction, voice tune effects, vocal presets, and immersive 3D audio tools. Make your vocals sound clean, polished, and ready for release.
••• Beat Maker & Music Production Tools
Create songs using high-quality loops, drum kits, bass lines, melodies, and instrumentals. Produce tracks inspired by Hip-Hop, Rap, Trap, Drill, EDM, Pop, House, Techno, RnB, and Electronic Music.
••• Easy Music Mixer
Mix vocals, beats, and sound effects with intuitive controls designed for both beginners and experienced music creators. Create professional mixes without needing advanced production knowledge.
••• Mobile Recording Studio
Record vocals with crystal-clear sound quality directly from your smartphone. Apply real-time effects and create professional tracks wherever inspiration strikes.
••• Professional Sound Packs

bluejetty:00175255:ios.description:
Joyful Color is a free color by number game for people of all ages and lifestyles. Featuring tons of inspiring pictures, you will enjoy a relaxing and interesting experience.
What to Color?
Our app offers thousands of exquisite pictures produced by professional artists worldwide and beautiful images are updated every day for you to color them and relax your mind!
There are more than 30 categories for your choice, such as
Animal: You can find cute pets, lovely animals you can only see in zoos, and various animals in the wild.
People: There are attractive and interesting people here.
Flower: You can see beautiful flowers which can relieve your stress and make you happy physically and mentally.
Place: Like traveling over the world, you can see various and impressive styles of architecture.
Nature: You can feel like you are in the splendid nature and witness the beauty of nature.
Mandalas, Hearts, Fashion, Pattern, Vehicle, Holidays, Food and many surprises await you!
How to Color?
Super easy! Just follow the numbers and tap to color. You can create an incredible masterpiece and bring it to life in a short time!
Key Features:
Convenient and user-friendly: Start to color painting anytime and anywhere. No pencil or paper is needed, and no specific skills are required!
Fascinating pictures and daily updated: A large range of pictures to choose from and unique coloring images updated every day!
Various themes for all tastes: Animals, Places, Nature, Mandalas, People, Fashion, Foods, Pattern and many more!
Save as favorite and color later: When you explore to find pics you love, you can save them as favorites first, and color them later when you are available.
Tell others your thoughts: After completing a picture, you can post your comment, like the pic, and reply to others’ comments to express your thoughts and feelings.
Share and save your artwork: You can share your completed pics on social media, like Facebook. Also, you can download and save them to your device.
Recommended coloring pages: Help you choose pictures that you may be interested in and start coloring easily.
Followings and Feeds: You can follow your friends and favorite players to keep track of your following's latest, such as their current coloring page and new achievement.
Stress relief and other benefits: Enjoy art therapy to reduce stress and anxiety. It's also a great way to enhance focus, motor skills and creativity.
Relax and entertain yourself with color therapy now! It's time to explore fabulous paintings and enjoy your coloring journey in Joyful Color!
To ensure that you can save and share pictures successfully, we need to access photos, media and files on your device. To permanently save all your painting progresses, we would recommend you log in and bind your account. You can see more details of app permissions in App info.
We do not sell any personal information you provide, nor do we share your private information without your consent. Thanks for your understanding and we are dedicated to a better coloring experience!
We are willing to hear your feedback: support@agedstudio.com
Privacy Policy: https://agedstudio.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00168868:ios.description:
Hexa Up - Stack Hexagons and Elevate Your Fun!
Welcome to Hexa Up, the ultimate stacking puzzle game where hexagons are your building blocks to endless fun! Dive into the world of sorting and stacking hexagons to create mesmerizing patterns and conquer challenging levels. With intuitive gameplay and a variety of features, Hexa Up promises an addictive experience that will keep you engaged for hours. Get ready to stack, sort, and soar to new heights of enjoyment!
Hexa Up has a unique gameplay of hexagon stacking that goes beyond the classic sort game. Simple touch control of hexagons on the board can be stacked accurately and easily to create colorful and complex patterns. Immerse players into the fun of a puzzle game and the visual art of stacking hexagons on the board. The game interface operates very smoothly, allowing players to find the perfect balance between the fun of exploring the game and relaxing.There are many novel levels here. Each level is more challenging than the previous one. Can you conquer them all?
Hexa Up introduces a unique 3D image of a hexagonal structure that allows players to view the board from different angles, enhancing an additional sense of immersion. With rich color combinations and satisfying and comfortable sound effects, it opens a perfect 3D gaming journey for players.
Hexa Up is more than just a game; it's a fascinating brainteaser that requires smart thinking. Train your brain with stimulating puzzles to improve cognitive skills and retain them for longer. Solve puzzles at your own pace, arrange them in order, and enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.
Unlock new levels to keep your mind sharp and revel in the zen world of this mesmerizing color-stacking game. Stylish home decor items can also be unlocked as you progress through the game. Customize your virtual home with unique furniture and decorations.
FEATURES:
- Unique hexagon stacking and relaxing gameplay
- Bright and colorful graphics
-Smooth 3D gaming experience
-Fashionable home decoration style
-Powerful global social functions
As an excellent hexagon stacking puzzle game, Hexa Up creates a colorful digital puzzle universe, each round brings new hexagon ordering and stunning pattern creation, allowing players to enjoy tranquility and A Zen-like and enjoyable gaming experience.
Invite your friends to join and compete with players around the world, climb the leaderboards, unlock achievements, and share the fun of participating in a fun sort puzzle game.
Join the Hexa Up community:
Share your experiences, tips，and strategies with other players via social media platforms using #Hexa Up. Stay tuned for the latest news and updates from the Hexa Up team and experience exciting new features and challenges!
Download Hexa Up now and embark on a colorful journey filled with hexagonal puzzles and endless fun! Are you ready for the challenge?

bluejetty:00174942:ios.name: Transcribe Audio to Text Notes
bluejetty:00174942:ios.summary: From lectures to meetings, interviews to videos, Transcriber is your smart AI notes taker. With advanced AI transcription audio to text, you can transcribe audio to text, create summaries, or rewrite recordings in seconds—making your Notes
bluejetty:00174942:ios.description:
From lectures to meetings, interviews to videos, Transcriber is your smart AI notes taker. With advanced AI transcription audio to text, you can transcribe audio to text, create summaries, or rewrite recordings in seconds—making your Notes easier to study, share, and remember.
Built for flexibility, Transcriber adapts to your needs: get a full transcript when accuracy matters, or let AI transform long Notes into concise highlights, key points, or polished content. Whether you want to live transcribe conversations, transcribe voice to text, or convert any audio to text, Transcriber adapts to your needs.
Powered by secure speech to text technology, Transcriber helps students, professionals, and creators save time and stay organized. Every Note is encrypted, stored privately, and always accessible when you need it.
Why You’ll Love Transcriber
• Record or import and quickly transcribe with high accuracy
• Summarize or restructure Notes with smart AI tools 
• Chat with your Notes to extract ideas and insights 
• Translate instantly into multiple languages 
• Export anywhere as PDF, TXT, or DOCX
Key Features
AI REWRITES & SUMMARIES
Turn Notes into quick highlights, organize into bullet points, or polish text. Choose from various rewrite options to fit any purpose.
ACCURATE TRANSCRIPTION
Convert speech to text accurately in seconds. Perfect when you need to transcribe audio to text, transcribe voice to text, or live transcribe meetings.
RECORD OR IMPORT AUDIO & VIDEO
Easily record audio and phone calls, import files, or paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and more.
SPEAKER IDENTIFICATION
Automatically detects and labels different speakers in conversations for clearer transcripts.
INSTANT TRANSLATION
Translate Notes between multiple languages in seconds. Ideal for global teams, language learners, and international communication.
BUILT-IN TEXT EDITOR
Refine transcripts with a powerful text editor. Rename speakers, correct typos, and adjust formatting before export.
SEAMLESS SHARING
Export Notes as PDF, TXT, or DOCX formats via Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Skype, Mail, and more.
PRIVATE & SECURE
All Notes are encrypted. Your data stays private, always.
100% AD-FREE
Enjoy a clean, distraction-free experience with no ads—ever.
SUBSCRIPTION:
We offer two subscription options with unlimited access to all Transcriber’s features: Yearly Unlimited and Weekly Unlimited. If you choose to get one of our plans, your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your Subscription Plan. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will remain active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
We’d love your feedback! Please take a moment to rate us on the App Store.

bluejetty:00024641:ios.summary: Transform your videos and images into cinematic masterpieces with VideoLUT, the ultimate color-grading app! With over 6000 presets, you can easily import, edit, and apply LUTs to create stunning videos and photos. Plus, VideoLUT allows you
bluejetty:00024641:ios.description:
Transform your videos and images into cinematic masterpieces with VideoLUT, the ultimate color-grading app! With over 6000 presets, you can easily import, edit, and apply LUTs to create stunning videos and photos. Plus, VideoLUT allows you to record videos and take photos with your imported LUTs, giving you the ultimate creative control.
217 film emulations — Kodak Portra, Kodachrome, Ektar, Fuji Velvia, Provia, Ilford HP5, Tri-X and more.
Import 20+ LUT formats — .cube, .3dl, .look, .csp, .clf, .spi3d, .icc, CDL, Hald PNG, Lightroom .xmp/.lrtemplate — and export float .cube, .3dl, .look.
Whether you're a professional filmmaker or a casual iPad photographer, VideoLUT is the perfect app for you. It comes with powerful editing tools that allow you to color grade your videos and images with ease. You can even create your own LUTs and share them with other users via QR codes or apps like Lumafusion. 
VideoLUT supports a variety of LUT formats, including DaVinci Resolve 3D Cube LUT (.cube) and Autodesk 3D LUT (.3dl). You can import .cube, .3dl, and 512x512 .png LUT tables, and save or import cube files to iCloud, Dropbox, and other storage apps. It also converts Adobe Lightroom preset files (`.xmp` and `.lrtemplate`) into LUTs during import. This feature is currently in beta; only supported colour adjustments and processing versions can be converted.
But that's not all – VideoLUT also lets you visualize LUTs in 3D, export them as LUT images (.png), and share them as .cube 16, 32, or 33 (DaVinci Resolve 3D Cube LUT) with other apps or your desktop. You can also match colors from images and build new LUTs from the result, and use RGB, HSL, CMYK, LAB, and Skin Masks and Curves for added control.
With VideoLUT's auto white balance, Macbeth table detection and correction, split toning, color wheels, and other adjust tools, you have everything you need to perfect your videos and images. Mix multiple LUTs to create new ones, convert Filmic Pro LUTS, and even preprocess RAW photos for added flexibility.
Download VideoLUT today and transform your videos and images into true works of art!

apple-macos:6723866121.name: CosmiCut: Spatial Video Editor
apple-macos:6723866121.description:
Edit spatial videos seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro — and even preview the 3D effect without a headset. Built from the ground-up for Apple platforms in SwiftUI.
• Edit non-destructively. Your original clips are never altered.
• Generate spatial videos from regular 2D clips using custom on-device machine learning models and rendering pipelines.
• Import common packed 3D video formats, including side-by-side and top/bottom, and automatically convert detected clips into spatial videos.
• Convert every 2D video in a project to spatial at once from the Project Inspector.
• Rearrange clips with simple drag-and-drop timeline editing.
• Trim clips, apply filters, and add visual effects.
• Crop ordinary and spatial videos with freeform bounds or built-in aspect ratios, and scrub through the clip to preview the framing before applying it.
• Rotate individual clips left or right in 90-degree increments.
• Add images with automatically applied Ken Burns-style pans and zooms.
• Add Cross Dissolve, Dip to Black, Wipe, and Push transitions between clips, customize their timing, and choose a direction for Wipe and Push.
• Preview the 3D effect of spatial videos on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and view individual clips directly in 3D on Apple Vision Pro.
• View spatial videos in true 3D on Apple Vision Pro.
• Export an animated “spatial GIF” based on a frame from a spatial clip.
• Use the export sheet to choose destination, optional spatial conversion, and output format, including Spatial Video, Side by Side, Side by Side Half, Top/Bottom, and Top/Bottom Half.
• Swap in your own music or audio tracks, then trim and tweak them.
100% Private
CosmiCut never collects or transmits your data. Everything stays on your device, always.
A subscription or one-time purchase is required to export videos without a watermark. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.

Video Controller allows online videos to be sent to VLC player with 1-click. This bypasses advertisements and means no interruptions. It's possible to watch multiple events, from multiple websites, at the same time, whilst using less CPU than it would take to display 1 video and it's corresponding website. Users can record videos directly from VLC, where they would otherwise be unable if the video was viewed online. All of this is achieved with simple and effortless, 1-click operation.
For more information, a list of supported sites and a video example, visit: https://www.videocontroller.info/

fdroid:com.marotoweb.kmemo.name: kMemo
fdroid:com.marotoweb.kmemo.summary: Offline-first block notes with kDrive or WebDAV sync
fdroid:com.marotoweb.kmemo.description:
kMemo is an offline-first, block-based note-taking app built with Flutter and local SQLite (Drift).
Notes are made of independent text blocks and checklists, so you can capture ideas, tasks and long notes in the same place. The app works fully offline: every note is stored locally on your device.
Features:
- Block-based editor with text and checklist blocks.
- Light, dark and system themes, with custom colors per note.
- Archive and trash, with restore and permanent deletion.
- Home screen widget (Android) showing your latest notes, pinned first.
- Optional remote sync with kDrive (Infomaniak) or any WebDAV server, including self-hosted ones. Both use the same format, and only one backend is configured at a time.
- Optional client-side AES-256 encryption. Notes are never uploaded in plain text while encryption is enabled.
- Link previews (Open Graph) with an explicit opt-in fetch; nothing is fetched automatically.
- Export to .docx and share notes through the system share sheet.
- Six languages: Portuguese, English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
- No telemetry and no ads.
kMemo is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Infomaniak. kDrive is a trademark of Infomaniak.
